verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: dehino 'smin yathā dehe kaumāraṃ yauvanaṃ jarā | tathā dehāntaraprāptir dhīras tatra na muhyati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: देहिनो ऽस्मिन्यथा देहे कौमारं यौवनं जरा । तथा देहान्तरप्राप्तिर्धीरस्तत्र न मुह्यति ॥
verses.english: Of an Embodied being, as childhood, youth, and decrepitude are in this body, so (also) is the acquisition of another body. The man, who is wise, is never deluded in this.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mātrāsparśās tu kaunteya śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkhadāḥ | āgamāpāyino 'nityās tāṃs titikṣasva bhārata
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मात्रास्पर्शास्तु कौन्तेय शीतोष्णसुखदुःखदाः । आगमापायिनो ऽनित्यास्तांस्तितिक्षस्व भारत ॥
verses.english: The contacts of the senses with their (respective) objects producing (sensations of) heat and cold, pleasure and pain, are not permanent, having (as they do) a beginning and an end. Do thou, O Bharata, endure them.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yaṃ hi na vyathayanty ete puruṣaṃ puruṣarṣabha | samaduḥkhasukhaṃ dhīraṃ so 'mṛtatvāya kalpate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यं हि न व्यथयन्त्य्एते पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ । समदुःखसुखं धीरं सो ऽमृतत्वाय कल्पते ॥
verses.english: For the man whom these afflict not, O bull among men, who is the same in pain and pleasure and who is firm in mind, is fit for emancipation.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ | ubhayor api dṛṣṭo 'ntas tv anayos tattvadarśibhiḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नासतो विद्यते भावो नाभावो विद्यते सतः । उभयोर्अपि दृष्टो ऽन्तस्त्व्अनयोस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ॥
verses.english: There is no (objective) existence of anything that is distinct from the soul; nor non-existence of anything possessing the virtues of the soul.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: avināśi tu tad viddhi yena sarvam idaṃ tatam | vināśam avyayasyāsya na kaś cit kartum arhati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अविनाशि तु तद्विद्धि येन सर्वम्इदं ततम् । विनाशम्अव्ययस्यास्य न कश्चित्कर्तुम्अर्हति ॥
verses.english: This conclusion in respect of both these hath been arrived at by those that know the truths (of things). Know that the soul to be immortal by which all this universe is pervaded.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: antavanta ime dehā nityasyoktāḥ śarīriṇaḥ | anāśino 'prameyasya tasmād yudhyasva bhārata
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अन्तवन्त इमे देहा नित्यस्योक्ताः शरीरिणः । अनाशिनो ऽप्रमेयस्य तस्माद्युध्यस्व भारत ॥
verses.english: No one can compass the destruction of that which is imperishable. It hath been said that those bodies of the Embodied (soul) which is eternal, indestructible and infinite, have an end. Do thou, therefore, fight, O Bharata.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ya enaṃ vetti hantāraṃ yaś cainaṃ manyate hatam | ubhau tau na vijānīto nāyaṃ hanti na hanyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: य एनं वेत्ति हन्तारं यश्चैनं मन्यते हतम् । उभौ तौ न विजानीतो नायं हन्ति न हन्यते ॥
verses.english: He who thinks it (the soul) to be the slayer and he who thinks it to be the slain, both of them know nothing; for it neither slays nor is slain.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na jāyate mriyate vā kadā cin | nāyaṃ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ | ajo nityaḥ śāśvato 'yaṃ purāṇo | na hanyate hanyamāne śarīre
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न जायते म्रियते वा कदा चिन् । नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः । अजो नित्यः शाश्वतो ऽयं पुराणो । न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे ॥
verses.english: It is never born, nor doth it ever die; nor, having existed, will it exist no more. Unborn, unchangeable, eternal, and ancient, it is not slain upon the body being perished.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: vedāvināśinaṃ nityaṃ ya enam ajam avyayam | kathaṃ sa puruṣaḥ pārtha kaṃ ghātayati hanti kam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: वेदाविनाशिनं नित्यं य एनम्अजम्अव्ययम् । कथं स पुरुषः पार्थ कं घातयति हन्ति कम् ॥
verses.english: That man who knoweth it to be indestructible, unchangeable, without decay, how and whom can he slay or cause to be slain?

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: vāsāṃsi jīrṇāni yathā vihāya | navāni gṛhṇāti naro 'parāṇi | tathā śarīrāṇi vihāya jīrṇāni | anyāni saṃyāti navāni dehī
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहाय । नवानि गृह्णाति नरो ऽपराणि । तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णानि । अन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही ॥
verses.english: As a man, casting off robes that are worn out, putteth on others that are new, so the Embodied (soul), casting off bodies that are worn out, entereth other bodies that are new.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: nainaṃ chindanti śastrāṇi nainaṃ dahati pāvakaḥ | na cainaṃ kledayanty āpo na śoṣayati mārutaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नैनं छिन्दन्ति शस्त्राणि नैनं दहति पावकः । न चैनं क्लेदयन्त्य्आपो न शोषयति मारुतः ॥
verses.english: Weapons cleave it not, fire consumeth it not; the waters do not drench it, nor doth the wind waste it.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: acchedyo 'yam adāhyo 'yam akledyo 'śoṣya eva ca | nityaḥ sarvagataḥ sthāṇur acalo 'yaṃ sanātanaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अच्छेद्यो ऽयम्अदाह्यो ऽयम्अक्लेद्यो ऽशोष्य एव च । नित्यः सर्वगतः स्थाणुर्अचलो ऽयं सनातनः ॥
verses.english: It is incapable of being cut, burnt, drenched, or dried up. It is unchangeable, all-pervading, stable, firm, and eternal.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: avyakto 'yam acintyo 'yam avikāryo 'yam ucyate | tasmād evaṃ viditvainaṃ nānuśocitum arhasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अव्यक्तो ऽयम्अचिन्त्यो ऽयम्अविकार्यो ऽयम्उच्यते । तस्माद्एवं विदित्वैनं नानुशोचितुम्अर्हसि ॥
verses.english: It is said to be imperceivable, inconceivable and unchangeable. Therefore, knowing it to be such, it behoveth thee not to mourn (for it).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: atha cainaṃ nityajātaṃ nityaṃ vā manyase mṛtam | tathāpi tvaṃ mahābāho naivaṃ śocitum arhasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अथ चैनं नित्यजातं नित्यं वा मन्यसे मृतम् । तथापि त्वं महाबाहो नैवं शोचितुम्अर्हसि ॥
verses.english: Then again even if thou regardest it as constantly born and constantly dead, it behoveth thee not yet, O mighty-armed one, to mourn (for it) thus.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: jātasya hi dhruvo mṛtyur dhruvaṃ janma mṛtasya ca | tasmād aparihārye 'rthe na tvaṃ śocitum arhasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च । तस्माद्अपरिहार्ये ऽर्थे न त्वं शोचितुम्अर्हसि ॥
verses.english: For, of one that is born, death is certain; and of one that is dead, birth is certain. Therefore it behoveth thee not to mourn in a matter that is unavoidable.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: avyaktādīni bhūtāni vyaktamadhyāni bhārata | avyaktanidhanāny eva tatra kā paridevanā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अव्यक्तादीनि भूतानि व्यक्तमध्यानि भारत । अव्यक्तनिधनान्य्एव तत्र का परिदेवना ॥
verses.english: All beings (before birth) were unmanifest. Only during an interval (between birth and death), O Bharata, are they manifest; and then again, when death comes, they become (once more) unmanifest.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: āścaryavat paśyati kaś cid enam | āścaryavad vadati tathaiva cānyaḥ | āścaryavac cainam anyaḥ śṛṇoti | śrutvāpy enaṃ veda na caiva kaś cit
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: आश्चर्यवत्पश्यति कश्चिद्एनम् । आश्चर्यवद्वदति तथैव चान्यः । आश्चर्यवच्चैनम्अन्यः शृणोति । श्रुत्वाप्य्एनं वेद न चैव कश्चित् ॥
verses.english: What grief then is there in this? One looks upon it as a marvel; another speaks of it as a marvel. Yet even after having heard of it, no one apprehends it truly.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: dehī nityam avadhyo 'yaṃ dehe sarvasya bhārata | tasmāt sarvāṇi bhūtāni na tvaṃ śocitum arhasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: देही नित्यम्अवध्यो ऽयं देहे सर्वस्य भारत । तस्मात्सर्वाणि भूतानि न त्वं शोचितुम्अर्हसि ॥
verses.english: The Embodied (soul), O Bharata, is ever indestructible in everyone's body. Therefore, it behoveth thee not to grieve for all (those) creatures.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: svadharmam api cāvekṣya na vikampitum arhasi | dharmyād dhi yuddhāc chreyo 'nyat kṣatriyasya na vidyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: स्वधर्मम्अपि चावेक्ष्य न विकम्पितुम्अर्हसि । धर्म्याद्धि युद्धाच्छ्रेयो ऽन्यत्क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते ॥
verses.english: Casting thy eyes on the (prescribed) duties of thy order, it behoveth thee not to waver, for there is nothing else that is better for a Kshatriya than a battle fought fairly.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yadṛcchayā copapannaṃ svargadvāram apāvṛtam | sukhinaḥ kṣatriyāḥ pārtha labhante yuddham īdṛśam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यदृच्छया चोपपन्नं स्वर्गद्वारम्अपावृतम् । सुखिनः क्षत्रियाः पार्थ लभन्ते युद्धम्ईदृशम् ॥
verses.english: Arrived of itself and (like unto) an open gate of heaven, happy are those Kshatriyas, O Partha, that obtain such a fight.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: atha cet tvam imaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ na kariṣyasi | tataḥ svadharmaṃ kīrtiṃ ca hitvā pāpam avāpsyasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अथ चेत्त्वम्इमं धर्म्यं संग्रामं न करिष्यसि । ततः स्वधर्मं कीर्तिं च हित्वा पापम्अवाप्स्यसि ॥
verses.english: But if thou dost not fight such a just battle, thou shalt then incur sin by abandoning the duties of thy order and thy fame.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: akīrtiṃ cāpi bhūtāni kathayiṣyanti te 'vyayām | saṃbhāvitasya cākīrtir maraṇād atiricyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अकीर्तिं चापि भूतानि कथयिष्यन्ति ते ऽव्ययाम् । संभावितस्य चाकीर्तिर्मरणाद्अतिरिच्यते ॥
verses.english: People will then proclaim thy eternal infamy, and to one that is held in respect, infamy is greater (as an evil) than death itself.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: bhayād raṇād uparataṃ maṃsyante tvāṃ mahārathāḥ | yeṣāṃ ca tvaṃ bahumato bhūtvā yāsyasi lāghavam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: भयाद्रणाद्उपरतं मंस्यन्ते त्वां महारथाः । येषां च त्वं बहुमतो भूत्वा यास्यसि लाघवम् ॥
verses.english: All great car-warriors will regard thee as abstaining from battle from fear, and thou wilt be thought lightly by those that had (hitherto) esteemed thee highly.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: avācyavādāṃś ca bahūn vadiṣyanti tavāhitāḥ | nindantas tava sāmarthyaṃ tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अवाच्यवादांश्च बहून्वदिष्यन्ति तवाहिताः । निन्दन्तस्तव सामर्थ्यं ततो दुःखतरं नु किम् ॥
verses.english: Thy enemies, decrying thy prowess, will say many words which should not be said. What can be more painful than that?

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: hato vā prāpsyasi svargaṃ jitvā vā bhokṣyase mahīm | tasmād uttiṣṭha kaunteya yuddhāya kṛtaniścayaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: हतो वा प्राप्स्यसि स्वर्गं जित्वा वा भोक्ष्यसे महीम् । तस्माद्उत्तिष्ठ कौन्तेय युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः ॥
verses.english: Slain, thou wilt attain to heaven; or victorious, thou wilt enjoy the Earth. Therefore, arise, O son of Kunti, resolved for battle.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sukhaduḥkhe same kṛtvā lābhālābhau jayājayau | tato yuddhāya yujyasva naivaṃ pāpam avāpsyasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ । ततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैवं पापम्अवाप्स्यसि ॥
verses.english: Regarding pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat, as equal, do battle for battle's sake and sin will not be thine.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: eṣā te 'bhihitā sāṃkhye buddhir yoge tv imāṃ śṛṇu | buddhyā yukto yayā pārtha karmabandhaṃ prahāsyasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एषा ते ऽभिहिता सांख्ये बुद्धिर्योगे त्व्इमां शृणु । बुद्ध्या युक्तो यया पार्थ कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यसि ॥
verses.english: This knowledge, that hath been communicated to thee is (taught) in the Sankhya (system). Listen now to that (inculcated) in Yoga (system). Possessed of that knowledge, thou, O Partha, wilt cast off the bonds of action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: nehābhikramanāśo 'sti pratyavāyo na vidyate | svalpam apy asya dharmasya trāyate mahato bhayāt
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नेहाभिक्रमनाशो ऽस्ति प्रत्यवायो न विद्यते । स्वल्पम्अप्य्अस्य धर्मस्य त्रायते महतो भयात् ॥
verses.english: In this (the Yoga system) there is no waste of even the first attempt. There are no impediments. Even a little of this (form of) piety delivers from great fear.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: vyavasāyātmikā buddhir ekeha kurunandana | bahuśākhā hy anantāś ca buddhayo 'vyavasāyinām
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिर्एकेह कुरुनन्दन । बहुशाखा ह्य्अनन्ताश्च बुद्धयो ऽव्यवसायिनाम् ॥
verses.english: Here in this path, O son of Kuru, there is only one state of mind, consisting in firm devotion (to one object, viz., securing emancipation). The minds of those, however, that are not firmly devoted (to this), are many-branched (un-settled) and attached to endless pursuits.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yām imāṃ puṣpitāṃ vācaṃ pravadanty avipaścitaḥ | vedavādaratāḥ pārtha nānyad astīti vādinaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: याम्इमां पुष्पितां वाचं प्रवदन्त्य्अविपश्चितः । वेदवादरताः पार्थ नान्यद्अस्तीति वादिनः ॥
verses.english: That flowery talk which, they that are ignorant, they that delight in the words of the Vedas, they, O Partha, that say that there is nothing else, they whose minds are attached to worldly pleasures,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kāmātmānaḥ svargaparā janmakarmaphalapradām | kriyāviśeṣabahulāṃ bhogaiśvaryagatiṃ prati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कामात्मानः स्वर्गपरा जन्मकर्मफलप्रदाम् । क्रियाविशेषबहुलां भोगैश्वर्यगतिं प्रति ॥
verses.english: they that regard (a) heaven (of pleasures and enjoyments) as the highest object of acquisition,—utter and promises birth as the fruit of action and concerns itself with multifarious rites of specific characters for the attainment of pleasures and power,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: bhogaiśvaryaprasaktānāṃ tayāpahṛtacetasām | vyavasāyātmikā buddhiḥ samādhau na vidhīyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: भोगैश्वर्यप्रसक्तानां तयापहृतचेतसाम् । व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिः समाधौ न विधीयते ॥
verses.english: delude their hearts and the minds of these men who are attached to pleasures and power cannot be directed to contemplation (of the divine being) regarding it as the sole means of emancipation. The Vedas are concerned with three qualities, (viz., religion, profit, and pleasure).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: traiguṇyaviṣayā vedā nistraiguṇyo bhavārjuna | nirdvandvo nityasattvastho niryogakṣema ātmavān
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: त्रैगुण्यविषया वेदा निस्त्रैगुण्यो भवार्जुन । निर्द्वन्द्वो नित्यसत्त्वस्थो निर्योगक्षेम आत्मवान् ॥
verses.english: Be thou, O Arjuna, free from them, unaffected by pairs of contraries (such as pleasure and pain, heat and cold, etc.), ever adhering to patience without anxiety for new acquisitions or protection of those already acquired, and self-possessed, whatever objects are served by a tank or well,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yāvān artha udapāne sarvataḥ saṃplutodake | tāvān sarveṣu vedeṣu brāhmaṇasya vijānataḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यावान्अर्थ उदपाने सर्वतः संप्लुतोदके । तावान्सर्वेषु वेदेषु ब्राह्मणस्य विजानतः ॥
verses.english: may all be served by a vast sheet of water extending all around; so whatever objects may be served by all the Vedas, may all be had by a Brahmana having knowledge (of self or Brahma).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: karmaṇy evādhikāras te mā phaleṣu kadā cana | mā karmaphalahetur bhūr mā te saṅgo 'stv akarmaṇi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कर्मण्य्एवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदा चन । मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गो ऽस्त्व्अकर्मणि ॥
verses.english: Thy concern is with work only, but not with the fruit (of work). Let not the fruit be thy motive for work; nor let thy inclination be for inaction.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yogasthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā dhanaṃjaya | siddhyasiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṃ yoga ucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनंजय । सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते ॥
verses.english: Staying in devotion, apply thyself to work, casting off attachment (to it), O Dhananjaya, and being the same in success or unsuccess. This equanimity is called Yoga (devotion).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: dūreṇa hy avaraṃ karma buddhiyogād dhanaṃjaya | buddhau śaraṇam anviccha kṛpaṇāḥ phalahetavaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: दूरेण ह्य्अवरं कर्म बुद्धियोगाद्धनंजय । बुद्धौ शरणम्अन्विच्छ कृपणाः फलहेतवः ॥
verses.english: Work (with desire of fruit) is far inferior to devotion, O Dhananjaya. Seek thou the protection of devotion. They that work for the sake of fruit are miserable.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: buddhiyukto jahātīha ubhe sukṛtaduṣkṛte | tasmād yogāya yujyasva yogaḥ karmasu kauśalam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते । तस्माद्योगाय युज्यस्व योगः कर्मसु कौशलम् ॥
verses.english: He also that hath devotion throws off, even in this world, both good actions and bad actions. Therefore, apply thyself to devotion. Devotion is only cleverness in action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: karmajaṃ buddhiyuktā hi phalaṃ tyaktvā manīṣiṇaḥ | janmabandhavinirmuktāḥ padaṃ gacchanty anāmayam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कर्मजं बुद्धियुक्ता हि फलं त्यक्त्वा मनीषिणः । जन्मबन्धविनिर्मुक्ताः पदं गच्छन्त्य्अनामयम् ॥
verses.english: The wise, possessed of devotion, cast off the fruit born of action, and freed from the obligation of (repeated) birth, attain to that region where there is no unhappiness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yadā te mohakalilaṃ buddhir vyatitariṣyati | tadā gantāsi nirvedaṃ śrotavyasya śrutasya ca
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यदा ते मोहकलिलं बुद्धिर्व्यतितरिष्यति । तदा गन्तासि निर्वेदं श्रोतव्यस्य श्रुतस्य च ॥
verses.english: When thy mind shall have crossed the maze of delusion, then shalt thou attain to an indifference as regards the hearable and the heard.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śrutivipratipannā te yadā sthāsyati niścalā | samādhāv acalā buddhis tadā yogam avāpsyasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: श्रुतिविप्रतिपन्ना ते यदा स्थास्यति निश्चला । समाधाव्अचला बुद्धिस्तदा योगम्अवाप्स्यसि ॥
verses.english: When thy mind, distracted (now) by what thou hast heard (about the means of acquiring the diverse objects of life), will be firmly and immovably fixed on contemplation, then wilt thou attain to devotion.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sthitaprajñasya kā bhāṣā samādhisthasya keśava | sthitadhīḥ kiṃ prabhāṣeta kim āsīta vrajeta kim
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: स्थितप्रज्ञस्य का भाषा समाधिस्थस्य केशव । स्थितधीः किं प्रभाषेत किम्आसीत व्रजेत किम् ॥
verses.english: What, O Kesava, are the indications of one whose mind is fixed on contemplation? How should one of steady mind speak, how sit, how move?

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: prajahāti yadā kāmān sarvān pārtha manogatān | ātmany evātmanā tuṣṭaḥ sthitaprajñas tadocyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्रजहाति यदा कामान्सर्वान्पार्थ मनोगतान् । आत्मन्य्एवात्मना तुष्टः स्थितप्रज्ञस्तदोच्यते ॥
verses.english: When one casts off all the desires of his heart and is pleased within (his) self with self, then is one said to be of steady mind.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: duḥkheṣv anudvignamanāḥ sukheṣu vigataspṛhaḥ | vītarāgabhayakrodhaḥ sthitadhīr munir ucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: दुःखेष्व्अनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः । वीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिर्उच्यते ॥
verses.english: He whose mind is not agitated amid calamities, whose craving for pleasure is gone, who is freed from attachment (to worldly objects), fear and wrath, is said to be a Muni of steady mind.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yaḥ sarvatrānabhisnehas tat tat prāpya śubhāśubham | nābhinandati na dveṣṭi tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यः सर्वत्रानभिस्नेहस्तत्तत्प्राप्य शुभाशुभम् । नाभिनन्दति न द्वेष्टि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता ॥
verses.english: His is steadiness of mind who is without affection everywhere, and who feeleth no exultation and no aversion on obtaining diverse objects that are agreeable and disagreeable.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yadā saṃharate cāyaṃ kūrmo 'ṅgānīva sarvaśaḥ | indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyas tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यदा संहरते चायं कूर्मो ऽङ्गानीव सर्वशः । इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता ॥
verses.english: When one withdraws his senses from the objects of (those) senses as the tortoise its limbs from all sides, even his is steadiness of mind.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: viṣayā vinivartante nirāhārasya dehinaḥ | rasavarjaṃ raso 'py asya paraṃ dṛṣṭvā nivartate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: विषया विनिवर्तन्ते निराहारस्य देहिनः । रसवर्जं रसो ऽप्य्अस्य परं दृष्ट्वा निवर्तते ॥
verses.english: Objects of senses fall back from an abstinent person, but not so the passion (for those objects). Even the passion recedes from one who has beheld the Supreme (being).

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yatato hy api kaunteya puruṣasya vipaścitaḥ | indriyāṇi pramāthīni haranti prasabhaṃ manaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यततो ह्य्अपि कौन्तेय पुरुषस्य विपश्चितः । इन्द्रियाणि प्रमाथीनि हरन्ति प्रसभं मनः ॥
verses.english: The agitating senses, O son of Kunti, forcibly draw away the mind of even a wise man striving hard to keep himself aloof from them.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tāni sarvāṇi saṃyamya yukta āsīta matparaḥ | vaśe hi yasyendriyāṇi tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तानि सर्वाणि संयम्य युक्त आसीत मत्परः । वशे हि यस्येन्द्रियाणि तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता ॥
verses.english: Restraining them all, one should stay in contemplation, making me his sole refuge. For his is steadiness of mind whose senses are under control.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: dhyāyato viṣayān puṃsaḥ saṅgas teṣūpajāyate | saṅgāt saṃjāyate kāmaḥ kāmāt krodho 'bhijāyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते । सङ्गात्संजायते कामः कामात्क्रोधो ऽभिजायते ॥
verses.english: Thinking of the objects of sense, a person's attachment is begotten towards them.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: krodhād bhavati saṃmohaḥ saṃmohāt smṛtivibhramaḥ | smṛtibhraṃśād buddhināśo buddhināśāt praṇaśyati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: क्रोधाद्भवति संमोहः संमोहात्स्मृतिविभ्रमः । स्मृतिभ्रंशाद्बुद्धिनाशो बुद्धिनाशात्प्रणश्यति ॥
verses.english: From attachment springeth wrath; from wrath ariseth want of discrimination; from want of discrimination, loss of memory; from loss of memory, loss of understanding; and from loss of understanding (he) is utterly ruined.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: rāgadveṣaviyuktais tu viṣayān indriyaiś caran | ātmavaśyair vidheyātmā prasādam adhigacchati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: रागद्वेषवियुक्तैस्तु विषयान्इन्द्रियैश्चरन् । आत्मवश्यैर्विधेयात्मा प्रसादम्अधिगच्छति ॥
verses.english: But the self-restrained man, enjoying objects (of sense) with senses freed from attachment and aversion under his own control, attaineth to peace (of mind).

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: prasāde sarvaduḥkhānāṃ hānir asyopajāyate | prasannacetaso hy āśu buddhiḥ paryavatiṣṭhate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्रसादे सर्वदुःखानां हानिर्अस्योपजायते । प्रसन्नचेतसो ह्य्आशु बुद्धिः पर्यवतिष्ठते ॥
verses.english: On peace (of mind) being attained, the annihilation of all his miseries taketh place, since the mind of him whose heart is peaceful soon becometh steady.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: nāsti buddhir ayuktasya na cāyuktasya bhāvanā | na cābhāvayataḥ śāntir aśāntasya kutaḥ sukham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नास्ति बुद्धिर्अयुक्तस्य न चायुक्तस्य भावना । न चाभावयतः शान्तिर्अशान्तस्य कुतः सुखम् ॥
verses.english: He who is not self-restrained hath no contemplation (of self). He who hath no contemplation hath no peace (of mind). Whence can there be happiness for him who hath no peace (of mind)?

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: indriyāṇāṃ hi caratāṃ yan mano 'nuvidhīyate | tad asya harati prajñāṃ vāyur nāvam ivāmbhasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इन्द्रियाणां हि चरतां यन्मनो ऽनुविधीयते । तद्अस्य हरति प्रज्ञां वायुर्नावम्इवाम्भसि ॥
verses.english: For the heart that follows in the wake of the sense moving (among their objects) destroys his understanding like the wind destroying a boat in the waters.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tasmād yasya mahābāho nigṛhītāni sarvaśaḥ | indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyas tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तस्माद्यस्य महाबाहो निगृहीतानि सर्वशः । इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता ॥
verses.english: Therefore, O thou of mighty arms, his is steadiness of mind whose senses are restrained on all sides from the objects of sense.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yā niśā sarvabhūtānāṃ tasyāṃ jāgarti saṃyamī | yasyāṃ jāgrati bhūtāni sā niśā paśyato muneḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: या निशा सर्वभूतानां तस्यां जागर्ति संयमी । यस्यां जाग्रति भूतानि सा निशा पश्यतो मुनेः ॥
verses.english: The restrained man is awake when it is night for all creatures; and when other creatures are awake that is night to a discerning Muni.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: āpūryamāṇam acalapratiṣṭhaṃ | samudram āpaḥ praviśanti yadvat | tadvat kāmā yaṃ praviśanti sarve | sa śāntim āpnoti na kāmakāmī
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: आपूर्यमाणम्अचलप्रतिष्ठं । समुद्रम्आपः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत् । तद्वत्कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे । स शान्तिम्आप्नोति न कामकामी ॥
verses.english: He into whom all objects of desire enter, even as the waters enter the ocean which (though) constantly replenished still maintains its water-mark unchanged—(he) obtains peace (of mind) and not one that longeth for objects of desire.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: vihāya kāmān yaḥ sarvān pumāṃś carati niḥspṛhaḥ | nirmamo nirahaṃkāraḥ sa śāntim adhigacchati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: विहाय कामान्यः सर्वान्पुमांश्चरति निःस्पृहः । निर्ममो निरहंकारः स शान्तिम्अधिगच्छति ॥
verses.english: That man who moveth about, giving up all objects of desire, who is free from craving (for enjoyments) and who hath no affection and no pride, attaineth to peace (of mind).

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: eṣā brāhmī sthitiḥ pārtha naināṃ prāpya vimuhyati | sthitvāsyām antakāle 'pi brahmanirvāṇam ṛcchati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एषा ब्राह्मी स्थितिः पार्थ नैनां प्राप्य विमुह्यति । स्थित्वास्याम्अन्तकाले ऽपि ब्रह्मनिर्वाणम्ऋच्छति ॥
verses.english: This, O Partha, is the divine state. Attaining to it, one is never deluded. Abiding in it one obtains, on death, absorption into the Supreme Self.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: jyāyasī cet karmaṇas te matā buddhir janārdana | tat kiṃ karmaṇi ghore māṃ niyojayasi keśava
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ज्यायसी चेत्कर्मणस्ते मता बुद्धिर्जनार्दन । तत्किं कर्मणि घोरे मां नियोजयसि केशव ॥
verses.english: If devotion, O Janardana, is regarded by thee as superior to work, why then, O Kesava, dost thou engage me in such dreadful work?

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: vyāmiśreṇaiva vākyena buddhiṃ mohayasīva me | tad ekaṃ vada niścitya yena śreyo 'ham āpnuyām
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: व्यामिश्रेणैव वाक्येन बुद्धिं मोहयसीव मे । तद्एकं वद निश्चित्य येन श्रेयो ऽहम्आप्नुयाम् ॥
verses.english: By equivocal words thou seemest to confound my understanding. Therefore, tell (me) one thing definitely by which I may attain to what is good.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: loke 'smin dvividhā niṣṭhā purā proktā mayānagha | jñānayogena sāṃkhyānāṃ karmayogena yoginām
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: लोके ऽस्मिन्द्विविधा निष्ठा पुरा प्रोक्ता मयानघ । ज्ञानयोगेन सांख्यानां कर्मयोगेन योगिनाम् ॥
verses.english: It hath already been said by me, O sinless one, that here are, in this world, two kinds of devotion; that of the Sankhyas through knowledge and that of the yogins through work.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na karmaṇām anārambhān naiṣkarmyaṃ puruṣo 'śnute | na ca saṃnyasanād eva siddhiṃ samadhigacchati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न कर्मणाम्अनारम्भान्नैष्कर्म्यं पुरुषो ऽश्नुते । न च संन्यसनाद्एव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति ॥
verses.english: A man doth not acquire freedom from work from (only) the non-performance of work.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na hi kaś cit kṣaṇam api jātu tiṣṭhaty akarmakṛt | kāryate hy avaśaḥ karma sarvaḥ prakṛtijair guṇaiḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न हि कश्चित्क्षणम्अपि जातु तिष्ठत्य्अकर्मकृत् । कार्यते ह्य्अवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः ॥
verses.english: Nor doth he acquire final emancipation from only renunciation (of work). No one can abide even for a moment without doing work.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: karmendriyāṇi saṃyamya ya āste manasā smaran | indriyārthān vimūḍhātmā mithyācāraḥ sa ucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन् । इन्द्रियार्थान्विमूढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते ॥
verses.english: That man of deluded soul who, curbing the organs of sense, liveth mentally cherishing the objects of sense, is said to be a dissembler.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yas tv indriyāṇi manasā niyamyārabhate 'rjuna | karmendriyaiḥ karmayogam asaktaḥ sa viśiṣyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यस्त्व्इन्द्रियाणि मनसा नियम्यारभते ऽर्जुन । कर्मेन्द्रियैः कर्मयोगम्असक्तः स विशिष्यते ॥
verses.english: He however, O Arjuna, who restraining (his) senses by his mind, engageth in devotion (in the form) of work with the organs of work, and is free from attachment, is distinguished (above all).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: niyataṃ kuru karma tvaṃ karma jyāyo hy akarmaṇaḥ | śarīrayātrāpi ca te na prasidhyed akarmaṇaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्य्अकर्मणः । शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिध्येद्अकर्मणः ॥
verses.english: (Therefore), do thou always apply yourself to work, for action is better than inaction. Even the support of thy body cannot be accomplished without work.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yajñārthāt karmaṇo 'nyatra loko 'yaṃ karmabandhanaḥ | tadarthaṃ karma kaunteya muktasaṅgaḥ samācara
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यज्ञार्थात्कर्मणो ऽन्यत्र लोको ऽयं कर्मबन्धनः । तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसङ्गः समाचर ॥
verses.english: This world is fettered by all work other than that which is (performed) for Sacrifice. (Therefore), O son of Kunti, perform work for the sake of that, freed from attachment.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sahayajñāḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā purovāca prajāpatiḥ | anena prasaviṣyadhvam eṣa vo 'stv iṣṭakāmadhuk
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सहयज्ञाः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः । अनेन प्रसविष्यध्वम्एष वो ऽस्त्व्इष्टकामधुक् ॥
verses.english: In olden times, the Lord of Creation, creating men and sacrifice together, said,—flourish by means of this (Sacrifice).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: devān bhāvayatānena te devā bhāvayantu vaḥ | parasparaṃ bhāvayantaḥ śreyaḥ param avāpsyatha
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: देवान्भावयतानेन ते देवा भावयन्तु वः । परस्परं भावयन्तः श्रेयः परम्अवाप्स्यथ ॥
verses.english: Let this (Sacrifice) be to you (all) the dispenser of all objects cherished by you. Rear the gods with this, and let the gods (in return) rear you.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: iṣṭān bhogān hi vo devā dāsyante yajñabhāvitāḥ | tair dattān apradāyaibhyo yo bhuṅkte stena eva saḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इष्टान्भोगान्हि वो देवा दास्यन्ते यज्ञभाविताः । तैर्दत्तान्अप्रदायैभ्यो यो भुङ्क्ते स्तेन एव सः ॥
verses.english: Thus fulfilling the mutual interest you will obtain that which is beneficial (to you). Propitiated with sacrifices the gods will bestow on you the pleasures you desire.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yajñaśiṣṭāśinaḥ santo mucyante sarvakilbiṣaiḥ | bhuñjate te tv aghaṃ pāpā ye pacanty ātmakāraṇāt
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः सन्तो मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः । भुञ्जते ते त्व्अघं पापा ये पचन्त्य्आत्मकारणात् ॥
verses.english: He who enjoyeth (himself) without giving them what they have given, is assuredly a thief. The good who eat the remnant of sacrifices are freed from all sins.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: annād bhavanti bhūtāni parjanyād annasaṃbhavaḥ | yajñād bhavati parjanyo yajñaḥ karmasamudbhavaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अन्नाद्भवन्ति भूतानि पर्जन्याद्अन्नसंभवः । यज्ञाद्भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः ॥
verses.english: Those unrighteous ones incur sin who dress food for their own sake.—From food are all creatures; and sacrifice is the outcome of work.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: karma brahmodbhavaṃ viddhi brahmākṣarasamudbhavam | tasmāt sarvagataṃ brahma nityaṃ yajñe pratiṣṭhitam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कर्म ब्रह्मोद्भवं विद्धि ब्रह्माक्षरसमुद्भवम् । तस्मात्सर्वगतं ब्रह्म नित्यं यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
verses.english: Know that work proceeds from the Vedas; Vedas have proceeded from Him who hath no decay. Therefore, the all-pervading Supreme Being is installed in sacrifice.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: evaṃ pravartitaṃ cakraṃ nānuvartayatīha yaḥ | aghāyur indriyārāmo moghaṃ pārtha sa jīvati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एवं प्रवर्तितं चक्रं नानुवर्तयतीह यः । अघायुर्इन्द्रियारामो मोघं पार्थ स जीवति ॥
verses.english: He who conformeth not to this wheel that is thus revolving, that man of sinful life delighting (the indulgence of) his senses, liveth in vain, O Partha.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yas tv ātmaratir eva syād ātmatṛptaś ca mānavaḥ | ātmany eva ca saṃtuṣṭas tasya kāryaṃ na vidyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यस्त्व्आत्मरतिर्एव स्याद्आत्मतृप्तश्च मानवः । आत्मन्य्एव च संतुष्टस्तस्य कार्यं न विद्यते ॥
verses.english: The man, however, that is attached to self only, that is contented with self, and that is pleased in his self,—hath no work (to do).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: naiva tasya kṛtenārtho nākṛteneha kaś cana | na cāsya sarvabhūteṣu kaś cid arthavyapāśrayaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नैव तस्य कृतेनार्थो नाकृतेनेह कश्चन । न चास्य सर्वभूतेषु कश्चिद्अर्थव्यपाश्रयः ॥
verses.english: He hath no concern whatever with action nor with any omission here. Nor, amongst all creatures, is there any upon whom his interest dependeth.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tasmād asaktaḥ satataṃ kāryaṃ karma samācara | asakto hy ācaran karma param āpnoti pūruṣaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तस्माद्असक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर । असक्तो ह्य्आचरन्कर्म परम्आप्नोति पूरुषः ॥
verses.english: Therefore, always do work that should be done, without attachment. The man who performeth work without attachment, attaineth to the Supreme.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: karmaṇaiva hi saṃsiddhim āsthitā janakādayaḥ | lokasaṃgraham evāpi saṃpaśyan kartum arhasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कर्मणैव हि संसिद्धिम्आस्थिता जनकादयः । लोकसंग्रहम्एवापि संपश्यन्कर्तुम्अर्हसि ॥
verses.english: By work alone, Janaka and others, attained the accomplishment of their objects. Having regard also to the observance by men of their duties, it behoveth thee to work.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yad yad ācarati śreṣṭhas tat tad evetaro janaḥ | sa yat pramāṇaṃ kurute lokas tad anuvartate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यद्यद्आचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तद्एवेतरो जनः । स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तद्अनुवर्तते ॥
verses.english: Whatever a great man doth, is also done by vulgar people. Ordinary men follow the ideal set by them (the great).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na me pārthāsti kartavyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kiṃ cana | nānavāptam avāptavyaṃ varta eva ca karmaṇi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न मे पार्थास्ति कर्तव्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु किं चन । नानवाप्तम्अवाप्तव्यं वर्त एव च कर्मणि ॥
verses.english: There is nothing whatever for me, O Partha, to do in the three worlds, (since I have) nothing for me which hath not been acquired; still I engage in action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yadi hy ahaṃ na varteyaṃ jātu karmaṇy atandritaḥ | mama vartmānuvartante manuṣyāḥ pārtha sarvaśaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यदि ह्य्अहं न वर्तेयं जातु कर्मण्य्अतन्द्रितः । मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः ॥
verses.english: Because if at any time I do not, without sloth, engage in action, men would follow my path, O Partha, on all sides.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: utsīdeyur ime lokā na kuryāṃ karma ced aham | saṃkarasya ca kartā syām upahanyām imāḥ prajāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: उत्सीदेयुर्इमे लोका न कुर्यां कर्म चेद्अहम् । संकरस्य च कर्ता स्याम्उपहन्याम्इमाः प्रजाः ॥
verses.english: The worlds would perish if I did not perform work, and I should cause intermixture of castes and ruin these people.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: saktāḥ karmaṇy avidvāṃso yathā kurvanti bhārata | kuryād vidvāṃs tathāsaktaś cikīrṣur lokasaṃgraham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सक्ताः कर्मण्य्अविद्वांसो यथा कुर्वन्ति भारत । कुर्याद्विद्वांस्तथासक्तश्चिकीर्षुर्लोकसंग्रहम् ॥
verses.english: As the ignorant work, O Bharata, having attachment to the performer, so should a wise man work without being attached, desiring to make men observant of their duties.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na buddhibhedaṃ janayed ajñānāṃ karmasaṅginām | joṣayet sarvakarmāṇi vidvān yuktaḥ samācaran
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न बुद्धिभेदं जनयेद्अज्ञानां कर्मसङ्गिनाम् । जोषयेत्सर्वकर्माणि विद्वान्युक्तः समाचरन् ॥
verses.english: A wise man should not cause confusion of understanding amongst ignorant persons, who have attachment to work itself; (on the other hand) he should (himself) acting with devotion engage them to all (kinds of) work.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: prakṛteḥ kriyamāṇāni guṇaiḥ karmāṇi sarvaśaḥ | ahaṃkāravimūḍhātmā kartāham iti manyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्रकृतेः क्रियमाणानि गुणैः कर्माणि सर्वशः । अहंकारविमूढात्मा कर्ताहम्इति मन्यते ॥
verses.english: All works are, in every way, done by the qualities of nature. He, whose mind is deluded by egoism, however, regards himself as the actor.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tattvavit tu mahābāho guṇakarmavibhāgayoḥ | guṇā guṇeṣu vartanta iti matvā na sajjate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तत्त्ववित्तु महाबाहो गुणकर्मविभागयोः । गुणा गुणेषु वर्तन्त इति मत्वा न सज्जते ॥
verses.english: But he, O mighty-armed one, who knoweth the distinction (of self) from qualities and work, is not attached to work, considering that it is his senses alone (and not his self) that engage in their objects.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: prakṛter guṇasaṃmūḍhāḥ sajjante guṇakarmasu | tān akṛtsnavido mandān kṛtsnavin na vicālayet
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्रकृतेर्गुणसंमूढाः सज्जन्ते गुणकर्मसु । तान्अकृत्स्नविदो मन्दान्कृत्स्नविन्न विचालयेत् ॥
verses.english: Those who are deluded by the qualities of nature, become attached to the works done by the qualities. A person of perfect knowledge should not bewilder those men of imperfect knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi saṃnyasyādhyātmacetasā | nirāśīr nirmamo bhūtvā yudhyasva vigatajvaraḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मयि सर्वाणि कर्माणि संन्यस्याध्यात्मचेतसा । निराशीर्निर्ममो भूत्वा युध्यस्व विगतज्वरः ॥
verses.english: Devoting all work to me, with (thy) mind directed to self, engage in battle, without desire, without affection and with thy (heart's) weakness dispelled.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ye me matam idaṃ nityam anutiṣṭhanti mānavāḥ | śraddhāvanto 'nasūyanto mucyante te 'pi karmabhiḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ये मे मतम्इदं नित्यम्अनुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः । श्रद्धावन्तो ऽनसूयन्तो मुच्यन्ते ते ऽपि कर्मभिः ॥
verses.english: Those men who always follow this opinion of mine with faith and without cavil attain to final emancipation even by work.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ye tv etad abhyasūyanto nānutiṣṭhanti me matam | sarvajñānavimūḍhāṃs tān viddhi naṣṭān acetasaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ये त्व्एतद्अभ्यसूयन्तो नानुतिष्ठन्ति मे मतम् । सर्वज्ञानविमूढांस्तान्विद्धि नष्टान्अचेतसः ॥
verses.english: But they who cavil at and do not follow this opinion of mine, know, that, bereft of all knowledge and without discrimination, they are ruined.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sadṛśaṃ ceṣṭate svasyāḥ prakṛter jñānavān api | prakṛtiṃ yānti bhūtāni nigrahaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सदृशं चेष्टते स्वस्याः प्रकृतेर्ज्ञानवान्अपि । प्रकृतिं यान्ति भूतानि निग्रहः किं करिष्यति ॥
verses.english: Even a wise man acts according to his own nature. All living beings follow (their own) nature. What then would restraint avail?

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: indriyasyendriyasyārthe rāgadveṣau vyavasthitau | tayor na vaśam āgacchet tau hy asya paripanthinau
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इन्द्रियस्येन्द्रियस्यार्थे रागद्वेषौ व्यवस्थितौ । तयोर्न वशम्आगच्छेत्तौ ह्य्अस्य परिपन्थिनौ ॥
verses.english: The senses have, as regards the objects of the senses, either affection or aversion fixed. One should not submit to these, for they are obstacles in one's way.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śreyān svadharmo viguṇaḥ paradharmāt svanuṣṭhitāt | svadharme nidhanaṃ śreyaḥ paradharmo bhayāvahaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् । स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः ॥
verses.english: One's own duty, even if imperfectly performed, is better than being done by other even if well performed. Death in (performance of) one's own duty is preferable. (The adoption of) the duty of another carries fear (with it).

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: atha kena prayukto 'yaṃ pāpaṃ carati pūruṣaḥ | anicchann api vārṣṇeya balād iva niyojitaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अथ केन प्रयुक्तो ऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः । अनिच्छन्न्अपि वार्ष्णेय बलाद्इव नियोजितः ॥
verses.english: Impelled by whom, O son of the Vrishni race, doth a man commit sin, even though unwilling and as if constrained by force?

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kāma eṣa krodha eṣa rajoguṇasamudbhavaḥ | mahāśano mahāpāpmā viddhy enam iha vairiṇam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: काम एष क्रोध एष रजोगुणसमुद्भवः । महाशनो महापाप्मा विद्ध्य्एनम्इह वैरिणम् ॥
verses.english: It is desire, it is wrath, born of the attribute of passion; it is all devouring, it is very sinful.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: dhūmenāvriyate vahnir yathādarśo malena ca | yatholbenāvṛto garbhas tathā tenedam āvṛtam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: धूमेनाव्रियते वह्निर्यथादर्शो मलेन च । यथोल्बेनावृतो गर्भस्तथा तेनेदम्आवृतम् ॥
verses.english: Know this to be the foe in this world. As fire is enveloped by smoke, a mirror by dust, the foetus by the womb, so is this enveloped by desire.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: āvṛtaṃ jñānam etena jñānino nityavairiṇā | kāmarūpeṇa kaunteya duṣpūreṇānalena ca
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: आवृतं ज्ञानम्एतेन ज्ञानिनो नित्यवैरिणा । कामरूपेण कौन्तेय दुष्पूरेणानलेन च ॥
verses.english: Knowledge, O son of Kunti, is enveloped by this constant foe of the wise in the form of desire which is insatiable and like a fire.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: indriyāṇi mano buddhir asyādhiṣṭhānam ucyate | etair vimohayaty eṣa jñānam āvṛtya dehinam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिर्अस्याधिष्ठानम्उच्यते । एतैर्विमोहयत्य्एष ज्ञानम्आवृत्य देहिनम् ॥
verses.english: The senses, the mind and the understanding are said to be its abode. With these it deludeth the embodied self, enveloping (his) knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tasmāt tvam indriyāṇy ādau niyamya bharatarṣabha | pāpmānaṃ prajahi hy enaṃ jñānavijñānanāśanam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तस्मात्त्वम्इन्द्रियाण्य्आदौ नियम्य भरतर्षभ । पाप्मानं प्रजहि ह्य्एनं ज्ञानविज्ञाननाशनम् ॥
verses.english: Therefore, restraining (thy) senses first, O bull of Bharata's race, cast off this wicked thing, for it destroyeth knowledge derived from instruction and meditation.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: indriyāṇi parāṇy āhur indriyebhyaḥ paraṃ manaḥ | manasas tu parā buddhir yo buddheḥ paratas tu saḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इन्द्रियाणि पराण्य्आहुर्इन्द्रियेभ्यः परं मनः । मनसस्तु परा बुद्धिर्यो बुद्धेः परतस्तु सः ॥
verses.english: It hath been said that the senses are superior (to the body which is inert). Superior to the senses is the mind.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: evaṃ buddheḥ paraṃ buddhvā saṃstabhyātmānam ātmanā | jahi śatruṃ mahābāho kāmarūpaṃ durāsadam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एवं बुद्धेः परं बुद्ध्वा संस्तभ्यात्मानम्आत्मना । जहि शत्रुं महाबाहो कामरूपं दुरासदम् ॥
verses.english: Superior to the mind is the knowledge. But which is superior to knowledge is He. Thus knowing that which is superior to knowledge and restraining (thy) self by self, slay, O mighty-armed one, the enemy in the shape of desire which is difficult to conquer.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: imaṃ vivasvate yogaṃ proktavān aham avyayam | vivasvān manave prāha manur ikṣvākave 'bravīt
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवान्अहम्अव्ययम् । विवस्वान्मनवे प्राह मनुर्इक्ष्वाकवे ऽब्रवीत् ॥
verses.english: This imperishable (system of) devotion I declared to Vivaswat; Vivaswat declared it to Manu; and Manu communicated it to Ikshaku.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: evaṃ paramparāprāptam imaṃ rājarṣayo viduḥ | sa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣṭaḥ paraṃtapa
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एवं परम्पराप्राप्तम्इमं राजर्षयो विदुः । स कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परंतप ॥
verses.english: Descending thus from generation, the Royal sages came to know it. But, O chastiser of foes, by (lapse of a) long time that devotion became lost to the world.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sa evāyaṃ mayā te 'dya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ | bhakto 'si me sakhā ceti rahasyaṃ hy etad uttamam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: स एवायं मया ते ऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः । भक्तो ऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्य्एतद्उत्तमम् ॥
verses.english: Even the same (system of) devotion hath today been declared by me to thee, for thou art my devotee and friend, (and) this is a great mystery.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: aparaṃ bhavato janma paraṃ janma vivasvataḥ | katham etad vijānīyāṃ tvam ādau proktavān iti
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः । कथम्एतद्विजानीयां त्वम्आदौ प्रोक्तवान्इति ॥
verses.english: Thy birth is posterior; Vivaswat's birth is prior. How shall I understand then that thou hadst first declared (it)?

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: bahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava cārjuna | tāny ahaṃ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṃ vettha paraṃtapa
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन । तान्य्अहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परंतप ॥
verses.english: Many births of mine have passed away, O Arjuna, as also of thine. These all I know, but thou dost not, O chastiser of foes.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ajo 'pi sann avyayātmā bhūtānām īśvaro 'pi san | prakṛtiṃ svām adhiṣṭhāya saṃbhavāmy ātmamāyayā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अजो ऽपि सन्न्अव्ययात्मा भूतानाम्ईश्वरो ऽपि सन् । प्रकृतिं स्वाम्अधिष्ठाय संभवाम्य्आत्ममायया ॥
verses.english: Though (I am) unborn and of essence that knoweth no deterioration, though (I am) the lord of all creatures, still, relying on my own (material) nature I take birth by my own (powers) of illusion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati bhārata | abhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjāmy aham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत । अभ्युत्थानम्अधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्य्अहम् ॥
verses.english: Whenever, O Bharata, loss of piety and the rise of impiety occurreth, on those occasions do I create myself.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṃ vināśāya ca duṣkṛtām | dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya saṃbhavāmi yuge yuge
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम् । धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय संभवामि युगे युगे ॥
verses.english: For the protection of the righteous and for the destruction of the evil doers, for the sake of establishing Piety, I am born age after age.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: janma karma ca me divyam evaṃ yo vetti tattvataḥ | tyaktvā dehaṃ punarjanma naiti mām eti so 'rjuna
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यम्एवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः । त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति माम्एति सो ऽर्जुन ॥
verses.english: He who truly knoweth my divine birth and work to be such, casting off (his body) is not born again; (on the other hand) he cometh to me, O Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: vītarāgabhayakrodhā manmayā mām upāśritāḥ | bahavo jñānatapasā pūtā madbhāvam āgatāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया माम्उपाश्रिताः । बहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावम्आगताः ॥
verses.english: Many who have been freed from attachment, fear, wrath, who were full of me, and who relied on me, have, cleansed by knowledge and asceticism, attained to my essence.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃs tathaiva bhajāmy aham | mama vartmānuvartante manuṣyāḥ pārtha sarvaśaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्य्अहम् । मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः ॥
verses.english: In whatsoever manner men come to me, in the selfsame manner do I accept them. It is my way, O Partha, that men follow on all sides.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kāṅkṣantaḥ karmaṇāṃ siddhiṃ yajanta iha devatāḥ | kṣipraṃ hi mānuṣe loke siddhir bhavati karmajā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः । क्षिप्रं हि मानुषे लोके सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा ॥
verses.english: Those in this world who are desirous of the success of action worship the gods, for in this world of men success resulting from action is soon attained.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: cāturvarṇyaṃ mayā sṛṣṭaṃ guṇakarmavibhāgaśaḥ | tasya kartāram api māṃ viddhy akartāram avyayam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: चातुर्वर्ण्यं मया सृष्टं गुणकर्मविभागशः । तस्य कर्तारम्अपि मां विद्ध्य्अकर्तारम्अव्ययम् ॥
verses.english: The quadruple division of castes was created by me according to the distinction of qualities and duties. Though I am the author thereof, (yet) know me to be not their author and undecaying. Actions do not touch me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na māṃ karmāṇi limpanti na me karmaphale spṛhā | iti māṃ yo 'bhijānāti karmabhir na sa badhyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा । इति मां यो ऽभिजानाति कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते ॥
verses.english: I have no longing for the fruits of actions. He that knoweth me thus is not impeded by actions.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: evaṃ jñātvā kṛtaṃ karma pūrvair api mumukṣubhiḥ | kuru karmaiva tasmāt tvaṃ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṃ kṛtam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैर्अपि मुमुक्षुभिः । कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात्त्वं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम् ॥
verses.english: Knowing this, even men of old who were desirous of emancipation performed work. Therefore, do thou also perform work as was done by ancients of the remote past.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kiṃ karma kimakarmeti kavayo 'py atra mohitāḥ | tat te karma pravakṣyāmi yaj jñātvā mokṣyase 'śubhāt
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: किं कर्म किमकर्मेति कवयो ऽप्य्अत्र मोहिताः । तत्ते कर्म प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसे ऽशुभात् ॥
verses.english: What is action and what is inaction,—even the learned are perplexed at this. Therefore, I will tell thee about action (so that) knowing it thou mayst be freed from evil.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: karmaṇo hy api boddhavyaṃ boddhavyaṃ ca vikarmaṇaḥ | akarmaṇaś ca boddhavyaṃ gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कर्मणो ह्य्अपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः । अकर्मणश्च बोद्धव्यं गहना कर्मणो गतिः ॥
verses.english: One should have knowledge of action, and one should have knowledge of forbidden actions: one should also know of inaction. The course of action is incomprehensible.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: karmaṇy akarma yaḥ paśyed akarmaṇi ca karma yaḥ | sa buddhimān manuṣyeṣu sa yuktaḥ kṛtsnakarmakṛt
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कर्मण्य्अकर्म यः पश्येद्अकर्मणि च कर्म यः । स बुद्धिमान्मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत् ॥
verses.english: He, who sees inaction in action and action in inaction, is wise among men; he is possessed of devotion; and he is a doer of all actions.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yasya sarve samārambhāḥ kāmasaṃkalpavarjitāḥ | jñānāgnidagdhakarmāṇaṃ tam āhuḥ paṇḍitaṃ budhāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यस्य सर्वे समारम्भाः कामसंकल्पवर्जिताः । ज्ञानाग्निदग्धकर्माणं तम्आहुः पण्डितं बुधाः ॥
verses.english: The learned call him wise whose efforts are all free from desire (of fruit) and (consequent) will, and whose actions have all been consumed by the fire of knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tyaktvā karmaphalāsaṅgaṃ nityatṛpto nirāśrayaḥ | karmaṇy abhipravṛtto 'pi naiva kiṃ cit karoti saḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: त्यक्त्वा कर्मफलासङ्गं नित्यतृप्तो निराश्रयः । कर्मण्य्अभिप्रवृत्तो ऽपि नैव किं चित्करोति सः ॥
verses.english: Whoever, resigning all attachment to the fruit of action, is ever contented and is dependent on none, doth nought, indeed, although engaged in action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: nirāśīr yatacittātmā tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ | śārīraṃ kevalaṃ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: निराशीर्यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः । शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् ॥
verses.english: He who, without desire, with mind and the senses under control, and casting off all concerns, performeth action only for the preservation of the body, incurreth no sin.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yadṛcchālābhasaṃtuṣṭo dvandvātīto vimatsaraḥ | samaḥ siddhāv asiddhau ca kṛtvāpi na nibadhyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यदृच्छालाभसंतुष्टो द्वन्द्वातीतो विमत्सरः । समः सिद्धाव्असिद्धौ च कृत्वापि न निबध्यते ॥
verses.english: He who is contented with what is earned without exertion, who hath risen superior to the pairs of opposites, who is without jealousy, who is equable in success and failure, is not fettered (by action) even though he works.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: gatasaṅgasya muktasya jñānāvasthitacetasaḥ | yajñāyācarataḥ karma samagraṃ pravilīyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: गतसङ्गस्य मुक्तस्य ज्ञानावस्थितचेतसः । यज्ञायाचरतः कर्म समग्रं प्रविलीयते ॥
verses.english: All his actions perish who acts for the sake of sacrifice, who is without affections, who is free (from attachments), and whose mind is fixed upon knowledge. Brahma is the vessel (with which the libation is poured);

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: brahmārpaṇaṃ brahma havir brahmāgnau brahmaṇā hutam | brahmaiva tena gantavyaṃ brahmakarmasamādhinā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्म हविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम् । ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना ॥
verses.english: Brahma is the libation (that is offered); Brahma is the fire on which by Brahma is poured (the libation); Brahma is the goal to which he proceedeth by fixing his mind on Brahma itself which is the action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: daivam evāpare yajñaṃ yoginaḥ paryupāsate | brahmāgnāv apare yajñaṃ yajñenaivopajuhvati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: दैवम्एवापरे यज्ञं योगिनः पर्युपासते । ब्रह्माग्नाव्अपरे यज्ञं यज्ञेनैवोपजुह्वति ॥
verses.english: Some devotees perform sacrifice to the gods. Others, by means of sacrifice, offer up sacrifices to the fire of Brahma. Others offer up (as sacrificial libation) the senses of which hearing is the first to the fire of restraint.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śrotrādīnīndriyāṇy anye saṃyamāgniṣu juhvati | śabdādīn viṣayān anya indriyāgniṣu juhvati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाण्य्अन्ये संयमाग्निषु जुह्वति । शब्दादीन्विषयान्अन्य इन्द्रियाग्निषु जुह्वति ॥
verses.english: Others (again) offer up (as libations) the objects of sense of which sound is the first to the fire of the senses.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sarvāṇīndriyakarmāṇi prāṇakarmāṇi cāpare | ātmasaṃyamayogāgnau juhvati jñānadīpite
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वाणीन्द्रियकर्माणि प्राणकर्माणि चापरे । आत्मसंयमयोगाग्नौ जुह्वति ज्ञानदीपिते ॥
verses.english: Others (again) offer up all the functions of the senses and the functions of the vital winds to the fire of devotion by self-restraint kindled by knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: dravyayajñās tapoyajñā yogayajñās tathāpare | svādhyāyajñānayajñāś ca yatayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: द्रव्ययज्ञास्तपोयज्ञा योगयज्ञास्तथापरे । स्वाध्यायज्ञानयज्ञाश्च यतयः संशितव्रताः ॥
verses.english: Others again perform the sacrifice of wealth, the sacrifice of ascetic austerities, the sacrifice of meditation, the sacrifice of (Vedic) study, the sacrifice of knowledge, and others are ascetics of rigid vows.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: apāne juhvati prāṇaṃ prāṇe 'pānaṃ tathāpare | prāṇāpānagatī ruddhvā prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अपाने जुह्वति प्राणं प्राणे ऽपानं तथापरे । प्राणापानगती रुद्ध्वा प्राणायामपरायणाः ॥
verses.english: Some offer up the upward vital wind (Prana) to the downward vital wind (apana); and others, the downward vital wind to the upward vital wind; some, arresting the course of (both) the upward and the downward vital winds, are devoted to the restraint of the vital winds.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: apare niyatāhārāḥ prāṇān prāṇeṣu juhvati | sarve 'py ete yajñavido yajñakṣapitakalmaṣāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अपरे नियताहाराः प्राणान्प्राणेषु जुह्वति । सर्वे ऽप्य्एते यज्ञविदो यज्ञक्षपितकल्मषाः ॥
verses.english: Others of restricted rations, offer the vital winds to the vital winds. Even all these who are conversant with sacrifice, whose sins have been consumed by sacrifice, and who eat the remnants of sacrifice which are amrita, attain to the eternal Brahma.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yajñaśiṣṭāmṛtabhujo yānti brahma sanātanam | nāyaṃ loko 'sty ayajñasya kuto 'nyaḥ kurusattama
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यज्ञशिष्टामृतभुजो यान्ति ब्रह्म सनातनम् । नायं लोको ऽस्त्य्अयज्ञस्य कुतो ऽन्यः कुरुसत्तम ॥
verses.english: (Even) this world is not for him who doth not perform sacrifice. Whence then the other, O best of Kuru's race?

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: evaṃ bahuvidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe | karmajān viddhi tān sarvān evaṃ jñātvā vimokṣyase
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे । कर्मजान्विद्धि तान्सर्वान्एवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे ॥
verses.english: Thus diverse are the sacrifices occurring in the Vedas. Know that all of them result from action, and knowing this thou wilt be emancipated.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śreyān dravyamayād yajñāj jñānayajñaḥ paraṃtapa | sarvaṃ karmākhilaṃ pārtha jñāne parisamāpyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: श्रेयान्द्रव्यमयाद्यज्ञाज्ज्ञानयज्ञः परंतप । सर्वं कर्माखिलं पार्थ ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यते ॥
verses.english: The sacrifice of knowledge, O chastiser of foes, is superior to every sacrifice involving (the attainment of) fruits of action, for all action, O Partha, is wholly comprehended in knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tad viddhi praṇipātena paripraśnena sevayā | upadekṣyanti te jñānaṃ jñāninas tattvadarśinaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया । उपदेक्ष्यन्ति ते ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः ॥
verses.english: Learn that (Knowledge) by prostration, enquiry, and service. They who are possessed of knowledge and can see the truth, will teach thee that knowledge, knowing which,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yaj jñātvā na punar moham evaṃ yāsyasi pāṇḍava | yena bhūtāny aśeṣeṇa drakṣyasy ātmany atho mayi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यज्ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्मोहम्एवं यास्यसि पाण्डव । येन भूतान्य्अशेषेण द्रक्ष्यस्य्आत्मन्य्अथो मयि ॥
verses.english: O son of Pandu, thou wilt not again come by such delusion, and by which thou wilt see the endless creatures (of the universe) in thyself (first) and then in me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: api ced asi pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ | sarvaṃ jñānaplavenaiva vṛjinaṃ saṃtariṣyasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अपि चेद्असि पापेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पापकृत्तमः । सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं संतरिष्यसि ॥
verses.english: Even if thou be the greatest sinner among all that are sinful, thou shalt yet cross over all transgressions by the raft of knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yathaidhāṃsi samiddho 'gnir bhasmasāt kurute 'rjuna | jñānāgniḥ sarvakarmāṇi bhasmasāt kurute tathā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यथैधांसि समिद्धो ऽग्निर्भस्मसात्कुरुते ऽर्जुन । ज्ञानाग्निः सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा ॥
verses.english: As a blazing fire, O Arjuna, reduceth fuel to ashes, so doth the fire of knowledge reduce all actions to ashes.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na hi jñānena sadṛśaṃ pavitram iha vidyate | tat svayaṃ yogasaṃsiddhaḥ kālenātmani vindati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रम्इह विद्यते । तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति ॥
verses.english: For there is nothing here that is so cleansing as knowledge. One who hath attained to success by devotion finds it without effort within his own self in time.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śraddhāvāṁl labhate jñānaṃ tatparaḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ | jñānaṃ labdhvā parāṃ śāntim acireṇādhigacchati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: श्रद्धावाꣳल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः । ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिम्अचिरेणाधिगच्छति ॥
verses.english: He obtaineth knowledge, who hath faith and is intent on it and who hath his senses under control; obtaining knowledge one findeth the highest tranquillity in no length of time.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ajñaś cāśraddadhānaś ca saṃśayātmā vinaśyati | nāyaṃ loko 'sti na paro na sukhaṃ saṃśayātmanaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अज्ञश्चाश्रद्दधानश्च संशयात्मा विनश्यति । नायं लोको ऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः ॥
verses.english: One who hath no knowledge and no faith, and whose minds is full of doubt, is lost. Neither this world, nor the next, nor happiness, is for him whose mind is full of doubt.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yogasaṃnyastakarmāṇaṃ jñānasaṃchinnasaṃśayam | ātmavantaṃ na karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanaṃjaya
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: योगसंन्यस्तकर्माणं ज्ञानसंछिन्नसंशयम् । आत्मवन्तं न कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनंजय ॥
verses.english: Actions do not fetter him, O Dhananjaya, who hath cast off action by devotion, whose doubts have been dispelled by knowledge, and who is self-restrained.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tasmād ajñānasaṃbhūtaṃ hṛtsthaṃ jñānāsinātmanaḥ | chittvainaṃ saṃśayaṃ yogam ātiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhārata
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तस्माद्अज्ञानसंभूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनात्मनः । छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगम्आतिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत ॥
verses.english: Therefore, destroying, by the sword of knowledge, this doubt of thine that is born of ignorance and that dwelleth in thy mind, betake to devotion, (and) arise, O son of Bharata.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: saṃnyāsaṃ karmaṇāṃ kṛṣṇa punar yogaṃ ca śaṃsasi | yac chreya etayor ekaṃ tan me brūhi suniścitam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि । यच्छ्रेय एतयोर्एकं तन्मे ब्रूहि सुनिश्चितम् ॥
verses.english: Thou applaudest, O Krishna, the abandonment of actions, and again the application (to them). Tell me definitely which one of these two is superior.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: saṃnyāsaḥ karmayogaś ca niḥśreyasakarāv ubhau | tayos tu karmasaṃnyāsāt karmayogo viśiṣyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: संन्यासः कर्मयोगश्च निःश्रेयसकराव्उभौ । तयोस्तु कर्मसंन्यासात्कर्मयोगो विशिष्यते ॥
verses.english: Both abandonment of actions and application to actions lead to emancipation. But of these, application to action is superior to abandonment.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: jñeyaḥ sa nityasaṃnyāsī yo na dveṣṭi na kāṅkṣati | nirdvandvo hi mahābāho sukhaṃ bandhāt pramucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति । निर्द्वन्द्वो हि महाबाहो सुखं बन्धात्प्रमुच्यते ॥
verses.english: He should always be known to be an ascetic who hath no aversion nor desire. For, being free from pairs of opposites, O thou of mighty arms, he is easily released from the bonds (of action).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sāṃkhyayogau pṛthag bālāḥ pravadanti na paṇḍitāḥ | ekam apy āsthitaḥ samyag ubhayor vindate phalam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सांख्ययोगौ पृथग्बालाः प्रवदन्ति न पण्डिताः । एकम्अप्य्आस्थितः सम्यग्उभयोर्विन्दते फलम् ॥
verses.english: Fools say, but not those that are wise, that Sankhya and Yoga are distinct. One who stayeth in even one (of the two) reapeth the fruit of both.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yat sāṃkhyaiḥ prāpyate sthānaṃ tad yogair api gamyate | ekaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यत्सांख्यैः प्राप्यते स्थानं तद्योगैर्अपि गम्यते । एकं सांख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति ॥
verses.english: Whatever seat is attained by those who profess the Sankhya system, that too is reached by those who profess the Yoga. He seeth truly who seeth Sankhya and Yoga as one.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: saṃnyāsas tu mahābāho duḥkham āptum ayogataḥ | yogayukto munir brahma nacireṇādhigacchati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखम्आप्तुम्अयोगतः । योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति ॥
verses.english: But renunciation, O mighty-armed one, without devotion (to action), is difficult to attain. The ascetic who is engaged in devotion (by action) reacheth the Supreme Being without delay.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yogayukto viśuddhātmā vijitātmā jitendriyaḥ | sarvabhūtātmabhūtātmā kurvann api na lipyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: योगयुक्तो विशुद्धात्मा विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः । सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा कुर्वन्न्अपि न लिप्यते ॥
verses.english: He who is engaged in devotion (by action) and is of pure soul, who hath conquered his body and subdued his senses, and who indentifieth himself with all creatures, is not fettered though performing (action).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: naiva kiṃ cit karomīti yukto manyeta tattvavit | paśyañ śṛṇvan spṛśañ jighrann aśnan gacchan svapañ śvasan
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नैव किं चित्करोमीति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित् । पश्यञ्शृण्वन्स्पृशञ्जिघ्रन्न्अश्नन्गच्छन्स्वपञ्श्वसन् ॥
verses.english: The man of devotion, who knoweth truth, thinking—I am doing nothing—When seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, moving, sleeping, breathing,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: pralapan visṛjan gṛhṇann unmiṣan nimiṣann api | indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣu vartanta iti dhārayan
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्रलपन्विसृजन्गृह्णन्न्उन्मिषन्निमिषन्न्अपि । इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्त इति धारयन् ॥
verses.english: talking, excreting, taking, opening the eyelids or closing them; he regardeth that it is the senses that are engaged in the objects of senses.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇy ādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ | lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatram ivāmbhasā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ब्रह्मण्य्आधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः । लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रम्इवाम्भसा ॥
verses.english: He who renouncing attachment engageth in actions, resigning them to Brahma, is not touched by sin as the lotus-leaf (is not touched) by water.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kāyena manasā buddhyā kevalair indriyair api | yoginaḥ karma kurvanti saṅgaṃ tyaktvātmaśuddhaye
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैर्इन्द्रियैर्अपि । योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वात्मशुद्धये ॥
verses.english: Those who are devotees, casting off attachment, perform actions (attaining) purity of self, with the body, the mind, the understanding, and even the senses (free from desire).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yuktaḥ karmaphalaṃ tyaktvā śāntim āpnoti naiṣṭhikīm | ayuktaḥ kāmakāreṇa phale sakto nibadhyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिम्आप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम् । अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते ॥
verses.english: He who is possessed of devotion, renouncing the fruit of action, attaineth to the highest tranquillity. He, who is not possessed of devotion and is attached to the fruit of action, is fettered by action performed from desire.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sarvakarmāṇi manasā saṃnyasyāste sukhaṃ vaśī | navadvāre pure dehī naiva kurvan na kārayan
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वकर्माणि मनसा संन्यस्यास्ते सुखं वशी । नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन् ॥
verses.english: The self-restrained embodied (self), renouncing all actions by the mind, remains at ease within the house of nine gates, neither acting himself nor causing (anything) to act.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na kartṛtvaṃ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛjati prabhuḥ | na karmaphalasaṃyogaṃ svabhāvas tu pravartate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः । न कर्मफलसंयोगं स्वभावस्तु प्रवर्तते ॥
verses.english: The Lord is not the cause of the capacity for action, or of the actions of men, or of the connection of actions and (their) fruit.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: nādatte kasya cit pāpaṃ na caiva sukṛtaṃ vibhuḥ | ajñānenāvṛtaṃ jñānaṃ tena muhyanti jantavaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नादत्ते कस्य चित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः । अज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः ॥
verses.english: It is nature that engages (in action). The Lord receiveth no one's sin, nor also merit. By ignorance, knowledge is shrouded. It is for this that creatures are deluded.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: jñānena tu tad ajñānaṃ yeṣāṃ nāśitam ātmanaḥ | teṣām ādityavaj jñānaṃ prakāśayati tatparam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ज्ञानेन तु तद्अज्ञानं येषां नाशितम्आत्मनः । तेषाम्आदित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम् ॥
verses.english: But of whomsoever that ignorance hath been destroyed by knowledge of self, that knowledge (which is) like the Sun discloseth the Supreme Being.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tadbuddhayas tadātmānas tanniṣṭhās tatparāyaṇāḥ | gacchanty apunarāvṛttiṃ jñānanirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तद्बुद्धयस्तदात्मानस्तन्निष्ठास्तत्परायणाः । गच्छन्त्य्अपुनरावृत्तिं ज्ञाननिर्धूतकल्मषाः ॥
verses.english: Those whose mind is on Him, whose very soul is He, who abide in Him, and who have Him for their goal, depart never more to return, their sins being all destroyed by knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: vidyāvinayasaṃpanne brāhmaṇe gavi hastini | śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: विद्याविनयसंपन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि । शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः ॥
verses.english: Those, who are wise cast an equal eye on a Brahmana endued with learning and modesty, on a cow, an elephant, a dog, and a chandala.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ihaiva tair jitaḥ sargo yeṣāṃ sāmye sthitaṃ manaḥ | nirdoṣaṃ hi samaṃ brahma tasmād brahmaṇi te sthitāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः । निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद्ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः ॥
verses.english: Even here has birth been conquered by them whose minds rest on equality; and since Brahma is faultless and equable, therefore, they (are said to) abide in Brahma.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na prahṛṣyet priyaṃ prāpya nodvijet prāpya cāpriyam | sthirabuddhir asaṃmūḍho brahmavid brahmaṇi sthitaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राप्य नोद्विजेत्प्राप्य चाप्रियम् । स्थिरबुद्धिर्असंमूढो ब्रह्मविद्ब्रह्मणि स्थितः ॥
verses.english: He whose mind is steady, who is not deluded, who knows Brahma, and who rests in Brahma, doth not exult on obtaining anything that is agreeable, nor doth he grieve on obtaining that is disagreeable.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: bāhyasparśeṣv asaktātmā vindaty ātmani yat sukham | sa brahmayogayuktātmā sukham akṣayam aśnute
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: बाह्यस्पर्शेष्व्असक्तात्मा विन्दत्य्आत्मनि यत्सुखम् । स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा सुखम्अक्षयम्अश्नुते ॥
verses.english: He whose mind is not attached to external objects of sense, obtaineth that happiness which is in self; and by concentrating his mind on the contemplation of Brahma, he enjoyeth a happiness that is imperishable.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ye hi saṃsparśajā bhogā duḥkhayonaya eva te | ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣu ramate budhaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते । आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः ॥
verses.english: The enjoyments born of the contact (of the senses with their objects) are productive of sorrow. He who is wise, O son of Kunti, never taketh pleasure in these that have a beginning and an end.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śaknotīhaiva yaḥ soḍhuṃ prāk śarīravimokṣaṇāt | kāmakrodhodbhavaṃ vegaṃ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: शक्नोतीहैव यः सोढुं प्राक्शरीरविमोक्षणात् । कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः ॥
verses.english: That man whoever here, before the dissolution of the body, is able to endure the agitations resulting from desire and wrath, is fixed on contemplation, and is happy.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yo 'ntaḥsukho 'ntarārāmas tathāntarjyotir eva yaḥ | sa yogī brahmanirvāṇaṃ brahmabhūto 'dhigacchati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यो ऽन्तःसुखो ऽन्तरारामस्तथान्तर्ज्योतिर्एव यः । स योगी ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतो ऽधिगच्छति ॥
verses.english: He who findeth happiness within himself, (and) who sporteth within himself, he whose light (of knowledge) is deprived from within himself, is a devotee, and becoming one with Brahma attaineth to absorption into Brahma.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: labhante brahmanirvāṇam ṛṣayaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ | chinnadvaidhā yatātmānaḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणम्ऋषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः । छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः ॥
verses.english: Those saintly personages whose sins have been destroyed, whose doubts have been dispelled, who are self-restrained, and who are engaged in the good of all creatures, obtain absorption into Brahma.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kāmakrodhaviyuktānāṃ yatīnāṃ yatacetasām | abhito brahmanirvāṇaṃ vartate viditātmanām
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कामक्रोधवियुक्तानां यतीनां यतचेतसाम् । अभितो ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं वर्तते विदितात्मनाम् ॥
verses.english: For these devotees who are freed from desire and wrath, whose minds are under control, and who have knowledge of self, absorption into Brahma exists both here and thereafter.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sparśān kṛtvā bahir bāhyāṃś cakṣuś caivāntare bhruvoḥ | prāṇāpānau samau kṛtvā nāsābhyantaracāriṇau
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: स्पर्शान्कृत्वा बहिर्बाह्यांश्चक्षुश्चैवान्तरे भ्रुवोः । प्राणापानौ समौ कृत्वा नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ ॥
verses.english: Excluding (from his mind) all external objects of sense, directing the visual glance between the brows, mingling (into one) the upward and the downward life-breaths and making them pass through the nostrils,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yatendriyamanobuddhir munir mokṣaparāyaṇaḥ | vigatecchābhayakrodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यतेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिर्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायणः । विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः ॥
verses.english: the devotee, who has restrained the senses, the mind, and the understanding, being intent on emancipation, and who is freed from desire, fear, and wrath, is emancipated, indeed.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: bhoktāraṃ yajñatapasāṃ sarvalokamaheśvaram | suhṛdaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jñātvā māṃ śāntim ṛcchati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम् । सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिम्ऋच्छति ॥
verses.english: Knowing me to be enjoyer of all sacrifices and ascetic austerities, the great Lord of all the worlds, and friend of all creatures, such a one obtaineth tranquillity.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: anāśritaḥ karmaphalaṃ kāryaṃ karma karoti yaḥ | sa saṃnyāsī ca yogī ca na niragnir na cākriyaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अनाश्रितः कर्मफलं कार्यं कर्म करोति यः । स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः ॥
verses.english: Regardless of fruit of action, he that performs the actions which should be performed, is a renouncer and devotee, and not one who discards the (sacrificial) fire, nor one that abstains from action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yaṃ saṃnyāsam iti prāhur yogaṃ taṃ viddhi pāṇḍava | na hy asaṃnyastasaṃkalpo yogī bhavati kaś cana
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यं संन्यासम्इति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव । न ह्य्असंन्यस्तसंकल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन ॥
verses.english: That which has been called renunciation, know that, O son of Pandu, to be devotion, since nobody can be a devotee who has not renounced (all) resolves.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ārurukṣor muner yogaṃ karma kāraṇam ucyate | yogārūḍhasya tasyaiva śamaḥ kāraṇam ucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: आरुरुक्षोर्मुनेर्योगं कर्म कारणम्उच्यते । योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणम्उच्यते ॥
verses.english: To the sage desirous of rising to devotion, action is said to be the means; and when he has risen to devotion, cessation of action is said to be the means.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yadā hi nendriyārtheṣu na karmasv anuṣajjate | sarvasaṃkalpasaṃnyāsī yogārūḍhas tadocyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्व्अनुषज्जते । सर्वसंकल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते ॥
verses.english: When one is no longer attached to the objects of the senses, nor to actions, and when one renounces all resolves, then is one said to have risen to devotion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: uddhared ātmanātmānaṃ nātmānam avasādayet | ātmaiva hy ātmano bandhur ātmaiva ripur ātmanaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: उद्धरेद्आत्मनात्मानं नात्मानम्अवसादयेत् । आत्मैव ह्य्आत्मनो बन्धुर्आत्मैव रिपुर्आत्मनः ॥
verses.english: One should raise (his) self by self; one should not degrade (his) self; for one's own self is one's friend, and one's own self is one's enemy.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: bandhur ātmātmanas tasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ | anātmanas tu śatrutve vartetātmaiva śatruvat
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: बन्धुर्आत्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः । अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत् ॥
verses.english: To him (only) who has subjugated his self by his self is self a friend. But to him who has not subjugated his self, his self behaves inimically like an enemy.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: jitātmanaḥ praśāntasya paramātmā samāhitaḥ | śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkheṣu tathā mānāpamānayoḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः । शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः ॥
verses.english: The soul of one who has subjugated his self and who is in the enjoyment of tranquillity, is steadily fixed (on itself) amid cold and heat, pleasure and pain, and also honour and dishonour.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: jñānavijñānatṛptātmā kūṭastho vijitendriyaḥ | yukta ity ucyate yogī samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः । युक्त इत्य्उच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः ॥
verses.english: That ascetic is said to be devoted whose mind is satisfied with knowledge and experience, who hath no affection, who hath subjugated his senses, and to whom a sod, a stone and gold are alike.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: suhṛnmitrāryudāsīnamadhyasthadveṣyabandhuṣu | sādhuṣv api ca pāpeṣu samabuddhir viśiṣyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु । साधुष्व्अपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते ॥
