verses.english: He, who views equally well-wishers, friends, foes, strangers that are indifferent to him, those who take part with both sides,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yogī yuñjīta satatam ātmānaṃ rahasi sthitaḥ | ekākī yatacittātmā nirāśīr aparigrahaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: योगी युञ्जीत सततम्आत्मानं रहसि स्थितः । एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीर्अपरिग्रहः ॥
verses.english: those who are objects of aversion, those who are related (to him), those who are good, and those who are wicked, is distinguished (above all others).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiram āsanam ātmanaḥ | nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ cailājinakuśottaram
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरम्आसनम्आत्मनः । नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम् ॥
verses.english: A devotee should always fix his mind on contemplation, remaining in a secluded place alone, restraining both mind and body, without expectations (of any kind), and without concern (with anything).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tatraikāgraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā yatacittendriyakriyaḥ | upaviśyāsane yuñjyād yogam ātmaviśuddhaye
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः । उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगम्आत्मविशुद्धये ॥
verses.english: Erecting his seat immovably on a clean spot, not too high nor too low, and spreading over it a piece of cloth, a deer-skin, or blades of Kusa grass, and there seated on that seat, with mind fixed on one object, and restraining the functions of the heart and the senses, one should practise contemplation for the purification of self.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: samaṃ kāyaśirogrīvaṃ dhārayann acalaṃ sthiraḥ | saṃprekṣya nāsikāgraṃ svaṃ diśaś cānavalokayan
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्न्अचलं स्थिरः । संप्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन् ॥
verses.english: Holding body, head, and neck even, unmoved and steady, and casting his glance on the tip of his nose, and without looking about in any of the different directions,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: praśāntātmā vigatabhīr brahmacārivrate sthitaḥ | manaḥ saṃyamya maccitto yukta āsīta matparaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः । मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः ॥
verses.english: with mind in tranquillity, freed from fear, observant of the practices of Brahmacharins, restraining the mind, with heart fixed on me, the devotee should sit down, regarding me as the object of his attainment.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yuñjann evaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī niyatamānasaḥ | śāntiṃ nirvāṇaparamāṃ matsaṃsthām adhigacchati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: युञ्जन्न्एवं सदात्मानं योगी नियतमानसः । शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थाम्अधिगच्छति ॥
verses.english: Thus applying his soul constantly, the devotee whose heart is restrained, attains to that tranquillity which culminates in final absorption and assimilation with me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: nātyaśnatas tu yogo 'sti na caikāntam anaśnataḥ | na cātisvapnaśīlasya jāgrato naiva cārjuna
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नात्यश्नतस्तु योगो ऽस्ति न चैकान्तम्अनश्नतः । न चातिस्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन ॥
verses.english: Devotion is not one's, O Arjuna, who eateth much, nor one's who doth not eat at all; nor one's who is addicted to too much sleep,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yuktāhāravihārasya yuktaceṣṭasya karmasu | yuktasvapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkhahā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु । युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा ॥
verses.english: nor one's who is always awake, devotion that is destructive of misery is his who is temperate in food and amusements, who duly exerts himself temperately in all his works, and who is temperate in sleep and vigils.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yadā viniyataṃ cittam ātmany evāvatiṣṭhate | niḥspṛhaḥ sarvakāmebhyo yukta ity ucyate tadā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यदा विनियतं चित्तम्आत्मन्य्एवावतिष्ठते । निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्य्उच्यते तदा ॥
verses.english: When one's heart, properly restrained, is fixed on one's own self, then, indifferent to all objects of desire, he is one called a devotee.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā | yogino yatacittasya yuñjato yogam ātmanaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता । योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगम्आत्मनः ॥
verses.english: As a lamp in a windless spot doth not flicker, even that is the resemblance declared of a devotee whose heart hath been restrained and who applieth his self to abstraction.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yatroparamate cittaṃ niruddhaṃ yogasevayā | yatra caivātmanātmānaṃ paśyann ātmani tuṣyati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया । यत्र चैवात्मनात्मानं पश्यन्न्आत्मनि तुष्यति ॥
verses.english: That (condition) in which the mind, restrained by practice of abstraction, taketh rest, in which beholding self by self,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sukham ātyantikaṃ yat tad buddhigrāhyam atīndriyam | vetti yatra na caivāyaṃ sthitaś calati tattvataḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सुखम्आत्यन्तिकं यत्तद्बुद्धिग्राह्यम्अतीन्द्रियम् । वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः ॥
verses.english: one is gratified within self; in which one experienceth that highest felicity which is beyond the (sphere of the) senses and which the understanding (only) can grasp, and fixed on which one never swerveth from the truth; acquiring which one regards no other acquisition greater than it,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yaṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ tataḥ | yasmin sthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vicālyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः । यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते ॥
verses.english: and abiding in which one is never moved by even the heaviest sorrow; that (Condition) should be known to be what is called devotion in which there is a severance of connection with pain.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: taṃ vidyād duḥkhasaṃyogaviyogaṃ yogasaṃjñitam | sa niścayena yoktavyo yogo 'nirviṇṇacetasā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तं विद्याद्दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम् । स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगो ऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा ॥
verses.english: That devotion should be practised with perseverance and with an undesponding heart.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: saṃkalpaprabhavān kāmāṃs tyaktvā sarvān aśeṣataḥ | manasaivendriyagrāmaṃ viniyamya samantataḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: संकल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वान्अशेषतः । मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः ॥
verses.english: Renouncing all desires without exception that are born of resolves, restraining the group of the senses on all sides by mind alone,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śanaiḥ śanair uparamed buddhyā dhṛtigṛhītayā | ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiṃ cid api cintayet
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: शनैः शनैर्उपरमेद्बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया । आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किं चिद्अपि चिन्तयेत् ॥
verses.english: one should, by slow degrees, become quiescent (aided) by (his) understanding controlled by patience, and then directing his mind to self should think of nothing.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yato yato niścarati manaś cañcalam asthiram | tatas tato niyamyaitad ātmany eva vaśaṃ nayet
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलम्अस्थिरम् । ततस्ततो नियम्यैतद्आत्मन्य्एव वशं नयेत् ॥
verses.english: Wheresoever the mind, which is (by nature) restless and unsteady, may run, restraining it from those, one should direct it to self alone.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: praśāntamanasaṃ hy enaṃ yoginaṃ sukham uttamam | upaiti śāntarajasaṃ brahmabhūtam akalmaṣam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्रशान्तमनसं ह्य्एनं योगिनं सुखम्उत्तमम् । उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतम्अकल्मषम् ॥
verses.english: Indeed, unto such a devotee whose mind is in tranquillity, whose passions have been suppressed, who hath become one with Brahma and who is free from sin, the highest felicity cometh (of his own accord).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yuñjann evaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī vigatakalmaṣaḥ | sukhena brahmasaṃsparśam atyantaṃ sukham aśnute
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: युञ्जन्न्एवं सदात्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः । सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शम्अत्यन्तं सुखम्अश्नुते ॥
verses.english: Thus applying his soul constantly (to abstraction), the devotee, freed from sin, easily obtaineth that highest happiness, viz., with Brahma.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sarvabhūtastham ātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani | īkṣate yogayuktātmā sarvatra samadarśanaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वभूतस्थम्आत्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि । ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः ॥
verses.english: He who hath devoted his self to abstraction casting an equal eye everywhere, beholdeth his self in all creatures and all creatures in his self.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati | tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति । तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति ॥
verses.english: Unto him who beholdeth me in everything and beholdeth everything in me, I am never lost and he also is never lost to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sarvabhūtasthitaṃ yo māṃ bhajaty ekatvam āsthitaḥ | sarvathā vartamāno 'pi sa yogī mayi vartate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्य्एकत्वम्आस्थितः । सर्वथा वर्तमानो ऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते ॥
verses.english: He who worshippeth me as abiding in all creatures, holding yet that all is one, is a devotee, and whatever mode of life he may lead, he liveth in me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṃ paśyati yo 'rjuna | sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ sa yogī paramo mataḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति यो ऽर्जुन । सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः ॥
verses.english: That devotee, O Arjuna, who casteth an equal eye everywhere, regarding all things as his own self and the happiness and misery of others as his own, is deemed to be the best.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yo 'yaṃ yogas tvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana | etasyāhaṃ na paśyāmi cañcalatvāt sthitiṃ sthirām
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यो ऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन । एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात्स्थितिं स्थिराम् ॥
verses.english: This devotion by means of equanimity which thou hast declared, O slayer of Madhu,—on account of restlessness of the mind I do not see its stable presence.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: cañcalaṃ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavad dṛḍham | tasyāhaṃ nigrahaṃ manye vāyor iva suduṣkaram
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्दृढम् । तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोर्इव सुदुष्करम् ॥
verses.english: O Krishna, the mind is restless, boisterous, perverse, and obstinate. Its restraint I regard to be as difficult of accomplishment as the restraint of the wind.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: asaṃśayaṃ mahābāho mano durṇigrahaṃ calam | abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्णिग्रहं चलम् । अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते ॥
verses.english: Without doubt, O thou of mighty arms the mind is difficult of subjugation and is restless. With practice, however, O son of Kunti, and with the abandonment of desire, it can be controlled.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: asaṃyatātmanā yogo duṣprāpa iti me matiḥ | vaśyātmanā tu yatatā śakyo 'vāptum upāyataḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः । वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्यो ऽवाप्तुम्उपायतः ॥
verses.english: It is my belief that by him whose mind is not restrained, devotion is difficult of acquisition. But by one whose mind is restrained and who is assiduous, it is capable of acquisition with the aid of means.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ayatiḥ śraddhayopeto yogāc calitamānasaḥ | aprāpya yogasaṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gatiṃ kṛṣṇa gacchati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः । अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति ॥
verses.english: Without assiduity, though endued with faith, and with mind shaken off from devotion, what is the end of him, O Krishna, who hath not earned success in devotion?

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kac cin nobhayavibhraṣṭaś chinnābhram iva naśyati | apratiṣṭho mahābāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रम्इव नश्यति । अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि ॥
verses.english: Fallen off from both, is he lost like a separated cloud or not, being as he is without refuge, O thou of mighty arms, and deluded on the path leading to Brahma?

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: etan me saṃśayaṃ kṛṣṇa chettum arhasy aśeṣataḥ | tvadanyaḥ saṃśayasyāsya chettā na hy upapadyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुम्अर्हस्य्अशेषतः । त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्य्उपपद्यते ॥
verses.english: This my doubt, O Krishna, it behoveth thee to remove without leaving anything. Besides thee, no dispeller of this doubt is to be had.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśas tasya vidyate | na hi kalyāṇakṛt kaś cid durgatiṃ tāta gacchati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते । न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद्दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति ॥
verses.english: O son of Pritha, neither here, nor hereafter, doth ruin exist for him, since none, O sire, who performs good (acts) comes by an evil end.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: prāpya puṇyakṛtāṃ lokān uṣitvā śāśvatīḥ samāḥ | śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yogabhraṣṭo 'bhijāyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकान्उषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः । शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टो ऽभिजायते ॥
verses.english: Attaining to the regions reserved for those that perform meritorious acts and living there for many many years, he that hath fallen off from devotion taketh birth in the abode of those that art pious and endued with prosperity,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: atha vā yoginām eva kule bhavati dhīmatām | etad dhi durlabhataraṃ loke janma yad īdṛśam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अथ वा योगिनाम्एव कुले भवति धीमताम् । एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यद्ईदृशम् ॥
verses.english: or, he is born even in the family of devotees endued with intelligence. Indeed, a birth such as this is more difficult of acquisition in this world.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tatra taṃ buddhisaṃyogaṃ labhate paurvadehikam | yatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsiddhau kurunandana
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम् । यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन ॥
verses.english: There in those births he obtaineth contact with that Brahmic knowledge which was his in his former life; and from that point he striveth again, O descendant of Kuru, towards perfection.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hy avaśo 'pi saḥ | jijñāsur api yogasya śabdabrahmātivartate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्य्अवशो ऽपि सः । जिज्ञासुर्अपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते ॥
verses.english: And although unwilling, he still worketh on in consequence of that same former practice of his. Even one that enquireth of devotion riseth above (the fruits of) the Divine Word.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: prayatnād yatamānas tu yogī saṃśuddhakilbiṣaḥ | anekajanmasaṃsiddhas tato yāti parāṃ gatim
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः । अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
verses.english: Striving with great efforts, the devotee, cleaned of all his sins, attaineth to perfection after many births, and then reacheth the supreme goal.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tapasvibhyo 'dhiko yogī jñānibhyo 'pi mato 'dhikaḥ | karmibhyaś cādhiko yogī tasmād yogī bhavārjuna
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तपस्विभ्यो ऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्यो ऽपि मतो ऽधिकः । कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन ॥
verses.english: The devotee is superior to ascetics engaged in austerities; he is esteemed to be superior to even the man of knowledge. The devotee is superior to those that are engaged in action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yoginām api sarveṣāṃ madgatenāntarātmanā | śraddhāvān bhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: योगिनाम्अपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना । श्रद्धावान्भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः ॥
verses.english: Therefore, become a devotee, O Arjuna. Even amongst all the devotees, he who, full of faith and with inner self resting on me, worshippeth me, is regarded by me to be the most devout.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mayy āsaktamanāḥ pārtha yogaṃ yuñjan madāśrayaḥ | asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tac chṛṇu
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मय्य्आसक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः । असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु ॥
verses.english: Listen, O son of Pritha, how, without doubt, thou mayst know me fully, fixing thy mind on me, practising devotion, and taking refuge in me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: jñānaṃ te 'haṃ savijñānam idaṃ vakṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ | yaj jñātvā neha bhūyo 'nyaj jñātavyam avaśiṣyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ज्ञानं ते ऽहं सविज्ञानम्इदं वक्ष्याम्य्अशेषतः । यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयो ऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यम्अवशिष्यते ॥
verses.english: I will now, without leaving anything out speak to thee about knowledge and experience, knowing which there would be left nothing in this world (for thee) to know.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: manuṣyāṇāṃ sahasreṣu kaś cid yatati siddhaye | yatatām api siddhānāṃ kaś cin māṃ vetti tattvataḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद्यतति सिद्धये । यतताम्अपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ॥
verses.english: One among thousands of men striveth for perfection. Of those even that are assiduous and have attained to perfection, only some one knoweth me truly.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: bhūmir āpo 'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhir eva ca | ahaṃkāra itīyaṃ me bhinnā prakṛtir aṣṭadhā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: भूमिर्आपो ऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिर्एव च । अहंकार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिर्अष्टधा ॥
verses.english: Earth, water, fire, air, space, mind, also understanding, and consciousness,—thus hath my nature been divided eight-fold. This is a lower (form of my) nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: apareyam itas tv anyāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi me parām | jīvabhūtāṃ mahābāho yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अपरेयम्इतस्त्व्अन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम् । जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत् ॥
verses.english: Different from this, know there is a higher (form of my) nature which is animate, O thou of mighty arms, and by which this universe is held.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: etadyonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇīty upadhāraya | ahaṃ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayas tathā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्य्उपधारय । अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा ॥
verses.english: Know that all creatures have these for their source. I am the source of evolution and also of the dissolution of the entire universe.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mattaḥ parataraṃ nānyat kiṃ cid asti dhanaṃjaya | mayi sarvam idaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किं चिद्अस्ति धनंजय । मयि सर्वम्इदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव ॥
verses.english: There is nothing else, O Dhananjaya, that is higher than myself. Upon me is all this like a row of pearls on a string.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: raso 'ham apsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śaśisūryayoḥ | praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: रसो ऽहम्अप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः । प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु ॥
verses.english: Taste I am in the waters, O son of Kunti, (and) I am the splendour of both the moon and the sun, I am the Om in all the Vedas, the sound in space, and the manliness in men.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca tejaś cāsmi vibhāvasau | jīvanaṃ sarvabhūteṣu tapaś cāsmi tapasviṣu
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ । जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु ॥
verses.english: I am the fragrant odour in earth, the splendour in fire, the life in all (living) creatures, and penance in ascetics.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam | buddhir buddhimatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम् । बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमताम्अस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनाम्अहम् ॥
verses.english: Know me, O son of Pritha, to be the eternal seed of all beings. I am the intelligence of all creatures endued with intelligence, the glory of all glorious objects.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: balaṃ balavatāṃ cāhaṃ kāmarāgavivarjitam | dharmāviruddho bhūteṣu kāmo 'smi bharatarṣabha
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम् । धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामो ऽस्मि भरतर्षभ ॥
verses.english: I am also the strength of all that are endued with strength, (myself) freed from desire and thirst, and, O bull of Bharata's race, am the desire, consistent with duty, in all creatures.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasās tāmasāś ca ye | matta eveti tān viddhi na tv ahaṃ teṣu te mayi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये । मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि न त्व्अहं तेषु ते मयि ॥
verses.english: And all existences which are of the quality of goodness, and which are of the quality of passion and quality of darkness, know that they are, indeed, from me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tribhir guṇamayair bhāvair ebhiḥ sarvam idaṃ jagat | mohitaṃ nābhijānāti mām ebhyaḥ param avyayam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैर्एभिः सर्वम्इदं जगत् । मोहितं नाभिजानाति माम्एभ्यः परम्अव्ययम् ॥
verses.english: I am, however, not in them, but they are in me. This entire universe, deluded by these three entities consisting of (these) three qualities knoweth not me that am beyond them and undecaying; since this illusion of mine,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: daivī hy eṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā | mām eva ye prapadyante māyām etāṃ taranti te
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: दैवी ह्य्एषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया । माम्एव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायाम्एतां तरन्ति ते ॥
verses.english: depending on the (three) qualities, is exceedingly marvellous and highly difficult of being transcended. They that resort to me alone cross this illusion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ | māyayāpahṛtajñānā āsuraṃ bhāvam āśritāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः । माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावम्आश्रिताः ॥
verses.english: Doers of evil, ignorant men, the worst of their species, robbed of their knowledge by (my) illusion and wedded to the state of demons, do not resort to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: caturvidhā bhajante māṃ janāḥ sukṛtino 'rjuna | ārto jijñāsur arthārthī jñānī ca bharatarṣabha
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनो ऽर्जुन । आर्तो जिज्ञासुर्अर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ ॥
verses.english: Four classes of doers of good deeds worship me, O Arjuna, viz., he that is distressed, that is possessed of knowledge, being always devoted and having his faith in only One,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ jñānī nityayukta ekabhaktir viśiṣyate | priyo hi jñānino 'tyartham ahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिर्विशिष्यते । प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनो ऽत्यर्थम्अहं स च मम प्रियः ॥
verses.english: is superior to the rest, for unto the man of knowledge I am dear above everything, and he also is dear to me. All these are noble.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tv ātmaiva me matam | āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā mām evānuttamāṃ gatim
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्व्आत्मैव मे मतम् । आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा माम्एवानुत्तमां गतिम् ॥
verses.english: But the man of knowledge is regarded (by me) to be my very self, since he, with soul fixed on abstraction, taketh refuge in me as the highest goal.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: bahūnāṃ janmanām ante jñānavān māṃ prapadyate | vāsudevaḥ sarvam iti sa mahātmā sudurlabhaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: बहूनां जन्मनाम्अन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते । वासुदेवः सर्वम्इति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः ॥
verses.english: At the end of many births, the man possessed of knowledge attaineth to me, (thinking) that Vasudeva is all this. Such a high-souled person, however, is exceedingly rare.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kāmais tais tair hṛtajñānāḥ prapadyante 'nyadevatāḥ | taṃ taṃ niyamam āsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्ते ऽन्यदेवताः । तं तं नियमम्आस्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया ॥
verses.english: They who have been robbed of knowledge by desire, resort to their godheads, observant of diverse regulations and controlled by their own nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitum icchati | tasya tasyācalāṃ śraddhāṃ tām eva vidadhāmy aham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुम्इच्छति । तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां ताम्एव विदधाम्य्अहम् ॥
verses.english: Whatever form, (of godhead or myself) any worshipper desireth to worship with faith, that faith of his unto that (form) I render steady.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sa tayā śraddhayā yuktas tasyā rādhanam īhate | labhate ca tataḥ kāmān mayaiva vihitān hi tān
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्या राधनम्ईहते । लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान् ॥
verses.english: Endued with that faith, he payeth his adorations to that (form), and obtaineth from that all his desire, since all those are ordained by me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: antavat tu phalaṃ teṣāṃ tad bhavaty alpamedhasām | devān devayajo yānti madbhaktā yānti mām api
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्य्अल्पमेधसाम् । देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति माम्अपि ॥
verses.english: The fruits, however, of those persons endued with little intelligence are perishable. They that worship the divinities, go to the divinities, (while) they that worship me come even to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: avyaktaṃ vyaktim āpannaṃ manyante mām abuddhayaḥ | paraṃ bhāvam ajānanto mamāvyayam anuttamam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिम्आपन्नं मन्यन्ते माम्अबुद्धयः । परं भावम्अजानन्तो ममाव्ययम्अनुत्तमम् ॥
verses.english: They that have no discernment, regard me who am (really) unmanifest to have become manifest, because they do not know the transcendent and undecaying state of mine than which there is nothing higher.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: nāhaṃ prakāśaḥ sarvasya yogamāyāsamāvṛtaḥ | mūḍho 'yaṃ nābhijānāti loko mām ajam avyayam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः । मूढो ऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको माम्अजम्अव्ययम् ॥
verses.english: Shrouded by the illusion of my inconceivable power, I am not manifest to all. This deluded world knoweth not me that I am unborn and undecaying.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: vedāhaṃ samatītāni vartamānāni cārjuna | bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaś cana
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन । भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन ॥
verses.english: I know, O Arjuna, all things that have been past, and all things that are present, and all things that are to be. But there is nobody that knoweth me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: icchādveṣasamutthena dvandvamohena bhārata | sarvabhūtāni saṃmohaṃ sarge yānti paraṃtapa
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत । सर्वभूतानि संमोहं सर्गे यान्ति परंतप ॥
verses.english: All creatures, O chastiser of foes, are deluded at the time of their birth by the delusion, O Bharata, of pairs of opposites arising from desire and aversion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yeṣāṃ tv antagataṃ pāpaṃ janānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām | te dvandvamohanirmuktā bhajante māṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: येषां त्व्अन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् । ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः ॥
verses.english: But those persons of meritorious deeds whose sins have attained their end, being freed from the delusion of pairs of opposites, worship me, firm in their vow (of that worship).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: jarāmaraṇamokṣāya mām āśritya yatanti ye | te brahma tad viduḥ kṛtsnam adhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: जरामरणमोक्षाय माम्आश्रित्य यतन्ति ये । ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नम्अध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम् ॥
verses.english: Those who, taking refuge in me, strive for release from decay and death, know Brahman, the entire Adhyatma, and action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ | prayāṇakāle 'pi ca māṃ te vidur yuktacetasaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः । प्रयाणकाले ऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः ॥
verses.english: And they who know me with the Adhibhuta, the Adhidaiva, and the Adhiyajna, having minds fixed on abstraction, know me at the time of their departure (from this world).

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kiṃ tad brahma kim adhyātmaṃ kiṃ karma puruṣottama | adhibhūtaṃ ca kiṃ proktam adhidaivaṃ kim ucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: किं तद्ब्रह्म किम्अध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम । अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तम्अधिदैवं किम्उच्यते ॥
verses.english: What is that Brahman, what is Adhyatma, what is action, O best of male beings? What also has been said to be Adhibhuta, and what is called Adhidaiva?

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: adhiyajñaḥ kathaṃ ko 'tra dehe 'smin madhusūdana | prayāṇakāle ca kathaṃ jñeyo 'si niyatātmabhiḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अधियज्ञः कथं को ऽत्र देहे ऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन । प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयो ऽसि नियतात्मभिः ॥
verses.english: Who is here Adhiyajna, and how, in this body, O slayer of Madhu? And how at the time of departure art thou to be known by those that have restrained their self'?

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ svabhāvo 'dhyātmam ucyate | bhūtabhāvodbhavakaro visargaḥ karmasaṃjñitaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावो ऽध्यात्मम्उच्यते । भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः ॥
verses.english: Brahman is the Supreme and indestructible. Adhyatma is said to be its own manifestation.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: adhibhūtaṃ kṣaro bhāvaḥ puruṣaś cādhidaivatam | adhiyajño 'ham evātra dehe dehabhṛtāṃ vara
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम् । अधियज्ञो ऽहम्एवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर ॥
verses.english: The offering (to any godhead in a sacrifice) which causeth the production and development of all—this is called action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: antakāle ca mām eva smaran muktvā kalevaram | yaḥ prayāti sa madbhāvaṃ yāti nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अन्तकाले च माम्एव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम् । यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्य्अत्र संशयः ॥
verses.english: Remembering me alone in (his) last moments, he that, casting off his body, departeth (hence), cometh into my essence. There is no doubt in this.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaran bhāvaṃ tyajaty ante kalevaram | taṃ tam evaiti kaunteya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्य्अन्ते कलेवरम् । तं तम्एवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः ॥
verses.english: Whichever form (of godhead) one remembereth when one casteth off, at the end, (his) body, unto that one he goeth, O son of Kunti, having habitually meditated on it always.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tasmāt sarveṣu kāleṣu mām anusmara yudhya ca | mayy arpitamanobuddhir mām evaiṣyasy asaṃśayaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु माम्अनुस्मर युध्य च । मय्य्अर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्माम्एवैष्यस्य्असंशयः ॥
verses.english: Therefore, think of me at all times, and engage in battle. Fixing thy mind and understanding on me, thou wilt, without doubt, come even to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: abhyāsayogayuktena cetasā nānyagāminā | paramaṃ puruṣaṃ divyaṃ yāti pārthānucintayan
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना । परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन् ॥
verses.english: Thinking (of the Supreme) with a mind not running to other objects and endued with abstraction in the form of uninterrupted application, one goeth, O son of Pritha, unto the Divine and Supreme male Being.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kaviṃ purāṇam anuśāsitāram | aṇor aṇīyāṃsam anusmared yaḥ | sarvasya dhātāram acintyarūpam | ādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कविं पुराणम्अनुशासितारम् । अणोर्अणीयांसम्अनुस्मरेद्यः । सर्वस्य धातारम्अचिन्त्यरूपम् । आदित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् ॥
verses.english: He who at the time of his departure, with a steady mind, endued with reverence, with power of abstraction, and directing the life-breath called Prana between the eye-brows, thinketh of that ancient seer, who is the ruler (of all),

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: prayāṇakāle manasācalena | bhaktyā yukto yogabalena caiva | bhruvor madhye prāṇam āveśya samyak | sa taṃ paraṃ puruṣam upaiti divyam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्रयाणकाले मनसाचलेन । भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव । भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणम्आवेश्य सम्यक् । स तं परं पुरुषम्उपैति दिव्यम् ॥
verses.english: who is minuter than the minutest atom, who is the ordainer of all, who is inconceivable in form, and who is beyond all darkness, cometh unto that Divine and Supreme Male Being.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yad akṣaraṃ vedavido vadanti | viśanti yad yatayo vītarāgāḥ | yad icchanto brahmacaryaṃ caranti | tat te padaṃ saṃgraheṇa pravakṣye
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यद्अक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति । विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः । यद्इच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति । तत्ते पदं संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये ॥
verses.english: I will tell thee in brief about that seat which persons conversant with the Vedas declare to be indestructible, which is entered by ascetics freed from all longings, and in expectation of which (people) practise the vows of Brahmacharins.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sarvadvārāṇi saṃyamya mano hṛdi nirudhya ca | mūrdhny ādhāyātmanaḥ prāṇam āsthito yogadhāraṇām
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च । मूर्ध्न्य्आधायात्मनः प्राणम्आस्थितो योगधारणाम् ॥
verses.english: Casting off (this) body, he who departeth, stopping up all the doors, confining the mind within the heart, placing his own life-breath called Prana between the eye-brows,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: om ity ekākṣaraṃ brahma vyāharan mām anusmaran | yaḥ prayāti tyajan dehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ॐ इत्य्एकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्माम्अनुस्मरन् । यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम् ॥
verses.english: resting on continued meditation, uttering this one syllable Om which is Brahman, and thinking of me, attaineth to the highest goal.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ananyacetāḥ satataṃ yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ | tasyāhaṃ sulabhaḥ pārtha nityayuktasya yoginaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः । तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः ॥
verses.english: He who always thinketh of me with mind ever withdrawn from all other objects, unto that devotee always engaged on meditation, I am, O Partha, easy of access.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mām upetya punarjanma duḥkhālayam aśāśvatam | nāpnuvanti mahātmānaḥ saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: माम्उपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयम्अशाश्वतम् । नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः ॥
verses.english: High-souled persons who have achieved the highest perfection, attaining to me, do not incur re-birth which is the abode of sorrow and which is transient.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ā brahmabhuvanāl lokāḥ punarāvartino 'rjuna | mām upetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na vidyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: आ ब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनो ऽर्जुन । माम्उपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते ॥
verses.english: All the worlds, O Arjuna, from the abode of Brahman downwards have to go through a round of births; on attaining to me, however, O son of Kunti, there is no re-birth.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sahasrayugaparyantam ahar yad brahmaṇo viduḥ | rātriṃ yugasahasrāntāṃ te 'horātravido janāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तम्अहर्यद्ब्रह्मणो विदुः । रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां ते ऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः ॥
verses.english: They who know a day of Brahman to end after a thousand Yugas, and a night (of his) to terminate after a thousand Yugas are persons that know day and night.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: avyaktād vyaktayaḥ sarvāḥ prabhavanty aharāgame | rātryāgame pralīyante tatraivāvyaktasaṃjñake
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्य्अहरागमे । रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके ॥
verses.english: On the advent of (Brahman's) day everything that is manifest springeth from the unmanifest; and when (his) night cometh, into that same which is called unmanifest all things disappear.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: bhūtagrāmaḥ sa evāyaṃ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate | rātryāgame 'vaśaḥ pārtha prabhavaty aharāgame
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते । रात्र्यागमे ऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्य्अहरागमे ॥
verses.english: That same assemblage of creatures, springing forth again and again, dissolveth on the advent of night, and springeth forth (again), O son of Pritha, when day cometh, constrained (by the force of action, etc.).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: paras tasmāt tu bhāvo 'nyo 'vyakto 'vyaktāt sanātanaḥ | yaḥ sa sarveṣu bhūteṣu naśyatsu na vinaśyati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: परस्तस्मात्तु भावो ऽन्यो ऽव्यक्तो ऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः । यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति ॥
verses.english: There is, however, another entity, unmanifest and eternal, which is beyond that unmanifest, and which is not destroyed when all the entities are destroyed.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: avyakto 'kṣara ity uktas tam āhuḥ paramāṃ gatim | yaṃ prāpya na nivartante tad dhāma paramaṃ mama
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अव्यक्तो ऽक्षर इत्य्उक्तस्तम्आहुः परमां गतिम् । यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ॥
verses.english: It is said to be unmanifest and indestructible. They call it the highest goal, attaining which no one hath to come back. That is my Supreme seat.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyas tv ananyayā | yasyāntaḥsthāni bhūtāni yena sarvam idaṃ tatam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्व्अनन्यया । यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वम्इदं ततम् ॥
verses.english: That Supreme Being, O son of Pritha, He within whom are all entities, and by whom all this is permeated, is to be attained by reverence undirected to any other object.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yatra kāle tv anāvṛttim āvṛttiṃ caiva yoginaḥ | prayātā yānti taṃ kālaṃ vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यत्र काले त्व्अनावृत्तिम्आवृत्तिं चैव योगिनः । प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ ॥
verses.english: I will tell thee the times, O bull of Bharata's race, in which devotees departing (from this life) go, never to return, or to return.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: agnir jyotir ahaḥ śuklaḥ ṣaṇmāsā uttarāyaṇam | tatra prayātā gacchanti brahma brahmavido janāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अग्निर्ज्योतिर्अहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम् । तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः ॥
verses.english: The fire, the Light, the day, the lighted fortnight, the six months of the northern solstice, departing from here, the persons knowing Brahma go through this path to Brahma.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: dhūmo rātris tathā kṛṣṇaḥ ṣaṇmāsā dakṣiṇāyanam | tatra cāndramasaṃ jyotir yogī prāpya nivartate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम् । तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते ॥
verses.english: Smoke, night, also the dark-fortnight (and) the six months of the southern solstice, (departing) through this path, devotee, attaining to the lunar light, returneth.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hy ete jagataḥ śāśvate mate | ekayā yāty anāvṛttim anyayāvartate punaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्य्एते जगतः शाश्वते मते । एकया यात्य्अनावृत्तिम्अन्ययावर्तते पुनः ॥
verses.english: The bright and the dark, these two paths, are regarded to be the eternal (two paths) of the universe. By the one, (one) goeth never to return; by the other, one (going) cometh back.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: naite sṛtī pārtha jānan yogī muhyati kaś cana | tasmāt sarveṣu kāleṣu yogayukto bhavārjuna
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन । तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन ॥
verses.english: Knowing these two paths, O son of Pritha, no devotee is deluded. Therefore, at all times, be endued with devotion, O Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: vedeṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva | dāneṣu yat puṇyaphalaṃ pradiṣṭam | atyeti tat sarvam idaṃ viditvā | yogī paraṃ sthānam upaiti cādyam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव । दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम् । अत्येति तत्सर्वम्इदं विदित्वा । योगी परं स्थानम्उपैति चाद्यम् ॥
verses.english: The meritorious fruit that is prescribed for the (study of the) Vedas, for sacrifices, for ascetic austerities and for gifts, a devotee knowing all this (that hath been said here), attaineth to it all, and (also) attaineth the Supreme and Primeval seat.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: idaṃ tu te guhyatamaṃ pravakṣyāmy anasūyave | jñānaṃ vijñānasahitaṃ yaj jñātvā mokṣyase 'śubhāt
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्य्अनसूयवे । ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसे ऽशुभात् ॥
verses.english: Now I will tell thee that art without envy that most mysterious knowledge along with experience, knowing which thou wilt be freed from evil.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: rājavidyā rājaguhyaṃ pavitram idam uttamam | pratyakṣāvagamaṃ dharmyaṃ susukhaṃ kartum avyayam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रम्इदम्उत्तमम् । प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुम्अव्ययम् ॥
verses.english: This is royal science, a royal mystery, highly cleansing, directly apprehensible, consistent with the sacred laws, easy to practise, (and) imperishable.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā dharmasyāsya paraṃtapa | aprāpya māṃ nivartante mṛtyusaṃsāravartmani
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परंतप । अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि ॥
verses.english: Those persons, O chastiser of foes, who have no faith in this sacred doctrine, not attaining to me, return to the path of this world that is subject to destruction.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mayā tatam idaṃ sarvaṃ jagad avyaktamūrtinā | matsthāni sarvabhūtāni na cāhaṃ teṣv avasthitaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मया ततम्इदं सर्वं जगद्अव्यक्तमूर्तिना । मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्व्अवस्थितः ॥
verses.english: This entire universe is pervaded by me in my unmanifest form. All entities are in me, but I do not reside in them.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogam aiśvaram | bhūtabhṛn na ca bhūtastho mamātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगम्ऐश्वरम् । भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः ॥
verses.english: Nor yet are all entities in me. Behold my divine power. Supporting all entities and producing all entities, myself doth not (yet) reside in (those) entities.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yathākāśasthito nityaṃ vāyuḥ sarvatrago mahān | tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni matsthānīty upadhāraya
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यथाकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान् । तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्य्उपधारय ॥
verses.english: As the great and obiquitious atmosphere always occupieth space, understand that all entities reside in me in the same way.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sarvabhūtāni kaunteya prakṛtiṃ yānti māmikām | kalpakṣaye punas tāni kalpādau visṛjāmy aham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम् । कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्य्अहम् ॥
verses.english: All entities, O son of Kunti, attain to my nature at the close of a Kalpa. I create them again at the beginning of a Kalpa.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: prakṛtiṃ svām avaṣṭabhya visṛjāmi punaḥ punaḥ | bhūtagrāmam imaṃ kṛtsnam avaśaṃ prakṛter vaśāt
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्रकृतिं स्वाम्अवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः । भूतग्रामम्इमं कृत्स्नम्अवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात् ॥
verses.english: Regulating my own (independent) nature I create again and in this whole assemblage of entities which is plastic in consequence of its subjection to nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na ca māṃ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanaṃjaya | udāsīnavad āsīnam asaktaṃ teṣu karmasu
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनंजय । उदासीनवद्आसीनम्असक्तं तेषु कर्मसु ॥
verses.english: Those acts, however, O Dhananjaya, do not fetter me who sitteth as one unconcerned, being unattached to those acts (of creation).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mayādhyakṣeṇa prakṛtiḥ sūyate sacarācaram | hetunānena kaunteya jagad viparivartate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मयाध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम् । हेतुनानेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते ॥
verses.english: Through me, the overlooker, primal nature produceth the (universe of) mobiles and immobiles. For the reason, O son of Kunti, the universe passeth through its rounds (of birth and destruction).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: avajānanti māṃ mūḍhā mānuṣīṃ tanum āśritam | paraṃ bhāvam ajānanto mama bhūtamaheśvaram
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुम्आश्रितम् । परं भावम्अजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम् ॥
verses.english: Not knowing my supreme nature of the great lord of all entities, ignorant people of vain hopes, vain acts,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: moghāśā moghakarmāṇo moghajñānā vicetasaḥ | rākṣasīm āsurīṃ caiva prakṛtiṃ mohinīṃ śritāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः । राक्षसीम्आसुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः ॥
verses.english: vain knowledge, confounded minds, wedded to the delusive nature of Asuras and Rakshasas, disregard me (as one) that hath assumed a human body.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mahātmānas tu māṃ pārtha daivīṃ prakṛtim āśritāḥ | bhajanty ananyamanaso jñātvā bhūtādim avyayam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिम्आश्रिताः । भजन्त्य्अनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिम्अव्ययम् ॥
verses.english: But high-souled ones, O son of Pritha, possessed of divine nature, and with minds directed to nothing else, worship me, knowing (me) to be the origin of all entities and undestructible.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: satataṃ kīrtayanto māṃ yatantaś ca dṛḍhavratāḥ | namasyantaś ca māṃ bhaktyā nityayuktā upāsate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः । नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ॥
verses.english: Always glorifying me, (or) striving with firm vows, (or) bowing down to me, with reverence and ever devoted, (they) worship me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: jñānayajñena cāpy anye yajanto mām upāsate | ekatvena pṛthaktvena bahudhā viśvatomukham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्य्अन्ये यजन्तो माम्उपासते । एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम् ॥
verses.english: Others again, performing the sacrifice of knowledge, worship me, (some) as one, (some) as distinct, (some) as pervading the universe, in many forms.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ahaṃ kratur ahaṃ yajñaḥ svadhāham aham auṣadham | mantro 'ham aham evājyam aham agnir ahaṃ hutam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अहं क्रतुर्अहं यज्ञः स्वधाहम्अहम्औषधम् । मन्त्रो ऽहम्अहम्एवाज्यम्अहम्अग्निर्अहं हुतम् ॥
verses.english: I am the Vedic sacrifice, I am the sacrifice enjoined in the Smritis, I am Swadha, I am the medicament produced from herbs; I am the mantra, I am the sacrificial libation, I am the fire, and I am the (sacrificial) offering.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: pitāham asya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ | vedyaṃ pavitram oṃkāra ṛk sāma yajur eva ca
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: पिताहम्अस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः । वेद्यं पवित्रम्ओंकार ऋक्साम यजुर्एव च ॥
verses.english: I am the father of this universe, the mother, the creator, grandsire; (I am) the thing to be known, the means by which everything is cleaned, the syllable Om, the Rik, the Saman and the Yajus,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: gatir bhartā prabhuḥ sākṣī nivāsaḥ śaraṇaṃ suhṛt | prabhavaḥ pralayaḥ sthānaṃ nidhānaṃ bījam avyayam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत् । प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजम्अव्ययम् ॥
verses.english: (I am) the goal, the supporter, the lord, the on-looker, the abode, the refuge, the friend, the source, the destruction, the support, the receptacle, and the undestructible seed.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tapāmy aham ahaṃ varṣaṃ nigṛhṇāmy utsṛjāmi ca | amṛtaṃ caiva mṛtyuś ca sad asac cāham arjuna
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तपाम्य्अहम्अहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्य्उत्सृजामि च । अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सद्असच्चाहम्अर्जुन ॥
verses.english: I give heat, I produce and suspend rain; I am immortality, and also death; and I am the existent and the non-existent, O Arjuna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: traividyā māṃ somapāḥ pūtapāpā | yajñair iṣṭvā svargatiṃ prārthayante | te puṇyam āsādya surendralokam | aśnanti divyān divi devabhogān
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा । यज्ञैर्इष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते । ते पुण्यम्आसाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोकम् । अश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान् ॥
verses.english: They who know the three branches of knowledge, also drink the Soma juice, and whose sins have been cleansed worshipping me by sacrifices, seek admission into heaven; and these attaining to the sacred region of the chief of the gods, enjoy in heaven the celestial pleasure of the gods.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: te taṃ bhuktvā svargalokaṃ viśālaṃ | kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ viśanti | evaṃ trayīdharmam anuprapannā | gatāgataṃ kāmakāmā labhante
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं । क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति । एवं त्रयीधर्मम्अनुप्रपन्ना । गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते ॥
verses.english: Having enjoyed that celestial world of vast extent, upon exhaustion of their merit they re-enter the mortal world. It is thus that they who accept the doctrines of the three Vedas and wish for objects of desires, obtain going and coming.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ananyāś cintayanto māṃ ye janāḥ paryupāsate | teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ yogakṣemaṃ vahāmy aham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते । तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्य्अहम् ॥
verses.english: Those persons who, thinking (of me) without directing their minds to anything else, worship me, of those who are (thus) always devoted (to me)—I make them gifts and preserve what they have.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ye 'py anyadevatābhaktā yajante śraddhayānvitāḥ | te 'pi mām eva kaunteya yajanty avidhipūrvakam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ये ऽप्य्अन्यदेवताभक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः । ते ऽपि माम्एव कौन्तेय यजन्त्य्अविधिपूर्वकम् ॥
verses.english: Even those devotees who, endued with faith, worship other godheads, even they, O son of Kunti, worship me alone, (though) irregularly.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhur eva ca | na tu mām abhijānanti tattvenātaś cyavanti te
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुर्एव च । न तु माम्अभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते ॥
verses.english: I am the enjoyer, as also the lord, of all sacrifices. They, however, do not know me truly; hence they fall off (from heaven).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yānti devavratā devān pitṝn yānti pitṛvratāḥ | bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti madyājino 'pi mām
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यान्ति देवव्रता देवान्पितॄन्यान्ति पितृव्रताः । भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनो ऽपि माम् ॥
verses.english: They whose vows are directed to the Pitris attain to the Pitris; who direct (their) worship to the inferior spirits called Bhutas attain to Bhutas; they who worship me, attain even to myself.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati | tad ahaṃ bhaktyupahṛtam aśnāmi prayatātmanaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति । तद्अहं भक्त्युपहृतम्अश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः ॥
verses.english: They who offer me with reverence, leaf, flower, fruit, water—that offered with reverence, I accept from him whose self is pure.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yat karoṣi yad aśnāsi yaj juhoṣi dadāsi yat | yat tapasyasi kaunteya tat kuruṣva madarpaṇam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यत्करोषि यद्अश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत् । यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम् ॥
verses.english: Whatever thou dost, whatever eatest, whatever drinkest, whatever givest, whatever austerities thou performest, manage it in such a way, O son of Kunti, that it may be an offering to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śubhāśubhaphalair evaṃ mokṣyase karmabandhanaiḥ | saṃnyāsayogayuktātmā vimukto mām upaiṣyasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: शुभाशुभफलैर्एवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः । संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो माम्उपैष्यसि ॥
verses.english: Thus mayst thou be freed from the fetters of action having good and evil fruits. With self endued with renunciation and devotion, thou wilt be released and will come to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: samo 'haṃ sarvabhūteṣu na me dveṣyo 'sti na priyaḥ | ye bhajanti tu māṃ bhaktyā mayi te teṣu cāpy aham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: समो ऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्यो ऽस्ति न प्रियः । ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्य्अहम् ॥
verses.english: I am alike to all creatures; there is none hateful to me, none dear. They, however, who worship me with reverence are in me and I also am in them.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: api cet sudurācāro bhajate mām ananyabhāk | sādhur eva sa mantavyaḥ samyag vyavasito hi saḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते माम्अनन्यभाक् । साधुर्एव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः ॥
verses.english: If even a person of exceedingly wicked conduct worshippeth me, without worshipping any one else, he should certainly be regard as good, for his efforts are well-directed.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kṣipraṃ bhavati dharmātmā śaśvacchāntiṃ nigacchati | kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति । कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति ॥
verses.english: (Such a person) soon becometh of virtuous soul, and attaineth to eternal tranquillity. Know, O son of Kunti, that none devoted to me is ever lost.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: māṃ hi pārtha vyapāśritya ye 'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ | striyo vaiśyās tathā śūdrās te 'pi yānti parāṃ gatim
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य ये ऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः । स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्ते ऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम् ॥
verses.english: For, O son of Pritha, even they who may be of sinful birth, women, Vaisyas, and also Sudras, even they, resorting to me, attain to the supreme goal.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kiṃ punar brāhmaṇāḥ puṇyā bhaktā rājarṣayas tathā | anityam asukhaṃ lokam imaṃ prāpya bhajasva mām
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा । अनित्यम्असुखं लोकम्इमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम् ॥
verses.english: What then (shall I say) of holy Brahmanas and saints who are my devotees? Having come to this transient and miserable world, be engaged in my worship.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru | mām evaiṣyasi yuktvaivam ātmānaṃ matparāyaṇaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु । माम्एवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवम्आत्मानं मत्परायणः ॥
verses.english: Fix thy mind on me; be my devotee, my worshipper; bow to me; and thus making me thy refuge and applying thy self to abstraction, thou wilt certainly come to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: bhūya eva mahābāho śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ | yat te 'haṃ prīyamāṇāya vakṣyāmi hitakāmyayā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: भूय एव महाबाहो शृणु मे परमं वचः । यत्ते ऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया ॥
verses.english: Once more still, O mighty-armed one, listen to my supernal words which, from desire of (thy) good, I say unto thee that wouldst be pleased (therewith).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na me viduḥ suragaṇāḥ prabhavaṃ na maharṣayaḥ | aham ādir hi devānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः । अहम्आदिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः ॥
verses.english: The hosts of gods know not my origin, nor the great Rishis, since I am, in every way, the source of the gods and the great Rishis.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yo mām ajam anādiṃ ca vetti lokamaheśvaram | asaṃmūḍhaḥ sa martyeṣu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यो माम्अजम्अनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम् । असंमूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
verses.english: He that knoweth me as the Supreme Lord of the worlds, without birth and beginning, (he), undeluded among mortals, is free from all sins.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: buddhir jñānam asaṃmohaḥ kṣamā satyaṃ damaḥ śamaḥ | sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhavo 'bhāvo bhayaṃ cābhayam eva ca
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: बुद्धिर्ज्ञानम्असंमोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः । सुखं दुःखं भवो ऽभावो भयं चाभयम्एव च ॥
verses.english: Intelligence, knowledge, the absence of delusion, forgiveness, truth, self-restraint, and tranquillity, pleasure, pain, birth, death, fear, and also security, abstention from harm,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ahiṃsā samatā tuṣṭis tapo dānaṃ yaśo 'yaśaḥ | bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthagvidhāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशो ऽयशः । भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः ॥
verses.english: evenness of mind, contentment, ascetic austerities, gift, fame, infamy, these several attributes of creatures arise from me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: maharṣayaḥ sapta pūrve catvāro manavas tathā | madbhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣāṃ loka imāḥ prajāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा । मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः ॥
verses.english: The Seven great Rishis, the four Maharishis before (them), and the Manus, partaking of my nature, were born from my mind, of whom in this world are these offsprings.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ | so 'vikampena yogena yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः । सो ऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः ॥
verses.english: He that knoweth truly this pre-eminence and mystic power of mine, becometh possessed of unswerving devotion. Of this (there is) no doubt.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate | iti matvā bhajante māṃ budhā bhāvasamanvitāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते । इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः ॥
verses.english: I am the origin of all things, from me all things proceed. Thinking thus, the wise, endued with my nature, worship me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: maccittā madgataprāṇā bodhayantaḥ parasparam | kathayantaś ca māṃ nityaṃ tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम् । कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च ॥
verses.english: Their hearts on me, their lives devoted to me, instructing one another, and glorifying me they are ever contented and happy.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ satatayuktānāṃ bhajatāṃ prītipūrvakam | dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena mām upayānti te
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् । ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन माम्उपयान्ति ते ॥
verses.english: Unto them always devoted, and worshipping (me) with love, I give that devotion in the form of knowledge by which they come to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: teṣām evānukampārtham aham ajñānajaṃ tamaḥ | nāśayāmy ātmabhāvastho jñānadīpena bhāsvatā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तेषाम्एवानुकम्पार्थम्अहम्अज्ञानजं तमः । नाशयाम्य्आत्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता ॥
verses.english: Of them, for compassion's sake, I destroy the darkness born of ignorance, by the brilliant lamp of knowledge, (myself) dwelling in their souls.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramaṃ bhavān | puruṣaṃ śāśvataṃ divyam ādidevam ajaṃ vibhum
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान् । पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यम्आदिदेवम्अजं विभुम् ॥
verses.english: Thou art the Supreme Brahma, the Supreme Abode, the Holiest of the Holy, the eternal Male Being Divine, the First of gods Unborn, the Lord.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: āhus tvām ṛṣayaḥ sarve devarṣir nāradas tathā | asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva bravīṣi me
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: आहुस्त्वाम्ऋषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा । असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे ॥
verses.english: All the Rishis proclaim thee thus, and also the celestial Rishi Narada; and Asita, Devala, (and) Vyasa; thyself also tellest me (so).

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sarvam etad ṛtaṃ manye yan māṃ vadasi keśava | na hi te bhagavan vyaktiṃ vidur devā na dānavāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वम्एतद्ऋतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव । न हि ते भगवन्व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः ॥
verses.english: All this that thou tellest me, O Kesava, I regard as true since, O Holy One, neither the gods nor the Danavas understand thy manifestation.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: svayam evātmanātmānaṃ vettha tvaṃ puruṣottama | bhūtabhāvana bhūteśa devadeva jagatpate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: स्वयम्एवात्मनात्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम । भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते ॥
verses.english: Thou only knowest thyself by thyself. O Best of Male Beings, O Creator of all things;

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: vaktum arhasy aśeṣeṇa divyā hy ātmavibhūtayaḥ | yābhir vibhūtibhir lokān imāṃs tvaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: वक्तुम्अर्हस्य्अशेषेण दिव्या ह्य्आत्मविभूतयः । याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकान्इमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि ॥
verses.english: O Lord of all things, O God of gods, O Lord of the Universe, it behoveth thee to declare without any reservation, those divine perfections of thine by which perfections pervading these worlds thou abidest.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kathaṃ vidyām ahaṃ yogiṃs tvāṃ sadā paricintayan | keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu cintyo 'si bhagavan mayā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कथं विद्याम्अहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन् । केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्यो ऽसि भगवन्मया ॥
verses.english: How shall I, ever meditating, know thee, O thou of mystic powers, in what particular states mayst thou, O Holy One, be meditated upon by me?

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: vistareṇātmano yogaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca janārdana | bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛptir hi śṛṇvato nāsti me 'mṛtam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन । भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि शृण्वतो नास्ति मे ऽमृतम् ॥
verses.english: Do thou again, O Janardana, copiously declare thy mystic powers and (thy) perfections, for I am never satiated with hearing thy nectar-like words.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: hanta te kathayiṣyāmi divyā hy ātmavibhūtayaḥ | prādhānyataḥ kuruśreṣṭha nāsty anto vistarasya me
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्य्आत्मविभूतयः । प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्य्अन्तो विस्तरस्य मे ॥
verses.english: Well, unto thee I will declare my divine perfections, by means of the principal ones (among them), O chief of the Kurus, for there is no end to the extent of my (perfections).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: aham ātmā guḍākeśa sarvabhūtāśayasthitaḥ | aham ādiś ca madhyaṃ ca bhūtānām anta eva ca
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अहम्आत्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः । अहम्आदिश्च मध्यं च भूतानाम्अन्त एव च ॥
verses.english: I am the soul, O thou of curly hair, seated in the heart of every being, I am the beginning, and the middle, and the end also of all beings.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ādityānām ahaṃ viṣṇur jyotiṣāṃ ravir aṃśumān | marīcir marutām asmi nakṣatrāṇām ahaṃ śaśī
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: आदित्यानाम्अहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविर्अंशुमान् । मरीचिर्मरुताम्अस्मि नक्षत्राणाम्अहं शशी ॥
verses.english: I am Vishnu among the Adityas, the resplendent Sun among all luminous bodies; I am Marichi among the Maruts, and the Moon among constellations.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: vedānāṃ sāmavedo 'smi devānām asmi vāsavaḥ | indriyāṇāṃ manaś cāsmi bhūtānām asmi cetanā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: वेदानां सामवेदो ऽस्मि देवानाम्अस्मि वासवः । इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानाम्अस्मि चेतना ॥
verses.english: I am the Sama Veda among the Vedas; I am Vasava among the gods; I am the mind among the senses; I am the intellect in (living) beings.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: rudrāṇāṃ śaṃkaraś cāsmi vitteśo yakṣarakṣasām | vasūnāṃ pāvakaś cāsmi meruḥ śikhariṇām aham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: रुद्राणां शंकरश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम् । वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणाम्अहम् ॥
verses.english: I am Sankara among the Rudras, the Lord of treasures among the Yakshas and the Rakshasas; I am Pavaka among the Vasus, and Meru among the peaked (mountains).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: purodhasāṃ ca mukhyaṃ māṃ viddhi pārtha bṛhaspatim | senānīnām ahaṃ skandaḥ sarasām asmi sāgaraḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम् । सेनानीनाम्अहं स्कन्दः सरसाम्अस्मि सागरः ॥
verses.english: Know me, O son of Pritha, to be Vrihaspati, the chief of household priests. I am Skanda among commanders of forces. I am Ocean among receptacles of water.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: maharṣīṇāṃ bhṛgur ahaṃ girām asmy ekam akṣaram | yajñānāṃ japayajño 'smi sthāvarāṇāṃ himālayaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: महर्षीणां भृगुर्अहं गिराम्अस्म्य्एकम्अक्षरम् । यज्ञानां जपयज्ञो ऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः ॥
verses.english: I am Bhrigu among the great Rishis, I am the One, undestructible (syllable Om) among words. Of sacrifices I am the Japa-sacrifice. Of immobiles I am the Himavat.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: aśvatthaḥ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ | gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः । गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः ॥
verses.english: I am the figtree among all trees, I am Narada among the celestial Rishis. I am Chitraratha among the Gandharvas and the ascetic Kapila among ascetics crowned with Yoga success.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: uccaiḥśravasam aśvānāṃ viddhi mām amṛtodbhavam | airāvataṃ gajendrāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca narādhipam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: उच्चैःश्रवसम्अश्वानां विद्धि माम्अमृतोद्भवम् । ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम् ॥
verses.english: Know me to be Uchchaisravas among horses, brought forth by (the churning for) nectar, Airavata among princely elephants, and the king among men.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: āyudhānām ahaṃ vajraṃ dhenūnām asmi kāmadhuk | prajanaś cāsmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇām asmi vāsukiḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: आयुधानाम्अहं वज्रं धेनूनाम्अस्मि कामधुक् । प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणाम्अस्मि वासुकिः ॥
verses.english: Among weapons I am the thunderbolt, among cows I am (she called) Kamadhuk. I am Kandarpa the cause of reproduction, I am Vasuki among serpents.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: anantaś cāsmi nāgānāṃ varuṇo yādasām aham | pitṝṇām aryamā cāsmi yamaḥ saṃyamatām aham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसाम्अहम् । पितॄणाम्अर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमताम्अहम् ॥
verses.english: I am Ananta among Nagas, I am Varuna among aquatic beings, I am Aryaman among the Pitris, and Yama among those that judge and punish.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: prahlādaś cāsmi daityānāṃ kālaḥ kalayatām aham | mṛgāṇāṃ ca mṛgendro 'haṃ vainateyaś ca pakṣiṇām
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयताम्अहम् । मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रो ऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम् ॥
verses.english: I am Prahlada among the Daityas, and Time among things that count. I am the lion among the beasts, and Vinata's son among winged creatures.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: pavanaḥ pavatām asmi rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtām aham | jhaṣāṇāṃ makaraś cāsmi srotasām asmi jāhnavī
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: पवनः पवताम्अस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृताम्अहम् । झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसाम्अस्मि जाह्नवी ॥
verses.english: Of purifiers I am the wind. I am Rama among wielders of weapons. I am the Makara among fishes, and I am Jahnavi (Ganga) among streams.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sargāṇām ādir antaś ca madhyaṃ caivāham arjuna | adhyātmavidyā vidyānāṃ vādaḥ pravadatām aham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्गाणाम्आदिर्अन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहम्अर्जुन । अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदताम्अहम् ॥
verses.english: Of created things I am the beginning and the end and also the middle, O Arjuna. I am the knowledge of Supreme Spirit among all kinds of knowledge, and the disputation among disputants.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: akṣarāṇām akāro 'smi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca | aham evākṣayaḥ kālo dhātāhaṃ viśvatomukhaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अक्षराणाम्अकारो ऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च । अहम्एवाक्षयः कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुखः ॥
verses.english: Among all letters I am the letter A, and (the compound called) Dwanda among all compounds. I am also Time Eternal, and I am the Ordainer with face turned on every side.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mṛtyuḥ sarvaharaś cāham udbhavaś ca bhaviṣyatām | kīrtiḥ śrīr vāk ca nārīṇāṃ smṛtir medhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहम्उद्भवश्च भविष्यताम् । कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा ॥
verses.english: I am Death that seizeth all, and the source of all, that is to be. Among females, I am Fame, Fortune, Speech, Memory, Intelligence, Constancy, Forgiveness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: bṛhatsāma tathā sāmnāṃ gāyatrī chandasām aham | māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo 'ham ṛtūnāṃ kusumākaraḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसाम्अहम् । मासानां मार्गशीर्षो ऽहम्ऋतूनां कुसुमाकरः ॥
verses.english: Of the Sama hymns, I am the Vrihat-sama and Gayatri among metres. Of the months, I am Margasirsha, of the seasons (I am) that which is productive of flowers.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: dyūtaṃ chalayatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham | jayo 'smi vyavasāyo 'smi sattvaṃ sattvavatām aham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: द्यूतं छलयताम्अस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनाम्अहम् । जयो ऽस्मि व्यवसायो ऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववताम्अहम् ॥
verses.english: I am the game of dice of them that cheat, and the splendour of those that are splendid. I am Victory, I am Exertion, I am the goodness of the good.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: vṛṣṇīnāṃ vāsudevo 'smi pāṇḍavānāṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ | munīnām apy ahaṃ vyāsaḥ kavīnām uśanā kaviḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: वृष्णीनां वासुदेवो ऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनंजयः । मुनीनाम्अप्य्अहं व्यासः कवीनाम्उशना कविः ॥
verses.english: I am Vasudeva among the Vrishnis, I am Dhananjaya among the sons of Pandu. I am even Vyasa among the ascetics, and Usanas among seers.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: daṇḍo damayatām asmi nītir asmi jigīṣatām | maunaṃ caivāsmi guhyānāṃ jñānaṃ jñānavatām aham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: दण्डो दमयताम्अस्मि नीतिर्अस्मि जिगीषताम् । मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवताम्अहम् ॥
verses.english: I am the Rod of those that chastise, I am the Policy of those that seek victory. I am silence among those that are secret. I am the Knowledge of those that are possessed of Knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yac cāpi sarvabhūtānāṃ bījaṃ tad aham arjuna | na tad asti vinā yat syān mayā bhūtaṃ carācaram
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तद्अहम्अर्जुन । न तद्अस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम् ॥
verses.english: That which is the Seed of all things, I am that, O Arjuna. There is nothing mobile or immobile, which can exist without me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: nānto 'sti mama divyānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ paraṃtapa | eṣa tūddeśataḥ prokto vibhūter vistaro mayā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नान्तो ऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परंतप । एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया ॥
verses.english: There is no end, O chastiser of foes, of my divine perfections. This recital of the extent of (those) perfections hath been uttered by me by way (only) of instancing them.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yad yad vibhūtimat sattvaṃ śrīmad ūrjitam eva vā | tat tad evāvagaccha tvaṃ mama tejo 'ṃśasaṃbhavam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमद्ऊर्जितम्एव वा । तत्तद्एवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजो ऽंशसंभवम् ॥
verses.english: Whatever of exalted things (there is) or glorious, or strong, understand thou that everything is born of a portion of my energy.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: atha vā bahunaitena kiṃ jñātena tavārjuna | viṣṭabhyāham idaṃ kṛtsnam ekāṃśena sthito jagat
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अथ वा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन । विष्टभ्याहम्इदं कृत्स्नम्एकांशेन स्थितो जगत् ॥
verses.english: Or rather, what hast thou to do, by knowing all this in detail, O Arjuna? Supporting this entire universe with only a portion (of myself), I stand.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: madanugrahāya paramaṃ guhyam adhyātmasaṃjñitam | yat tvayoktaṃ vacas tena moho 'yaṃ vigato mama
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यम्अध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् । यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहो ऽयं विगतो मम ॥
verses.english: This discourse about the supreme mystery, called Adhyatman, which thou hast uttered for my welfare, hath dispelled my delusion.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṃ śrutau vistaraśo mayā | tvattaḥ kamalapatrākṣa māhātmyam api cāvyayam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया । त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यम्अपि चाव्ययम् ॥
verses.english: For I have heard at large from thee of the creation and dissolution of beings, O thou of eyes like lotus petals, and also of thy greatness that knoweth no deterioration.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: evam etad yathāttha tvam ātmānaṃ parameśvara | draṣṭum icchāmi te rūpam aiśvaraṃ puruṣottama
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एवम्एतद्यथात्थ त्वम्आत्मानं परमेश्वर । द्रष्टुम्इच्छामि ते रूपम्ऐश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम ॥
verses.english: What thou hast said about thyself, O great Lord, is even so. O best of Male Beings, I desire to behold thy sovereign form.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: manyase yadi tac chakyaṃ mayā draṣṭum iti prabho | yogeśvara tato me tvaṃ darśayātmānam avyayam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुम्इति प्रभो । योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयात्मानम्अव्ययम् ॥
verses.english: If, O Lord, thou thinkest that I am competent to behold that (form), then, O Lord of mystic power, show me thy eternal Self.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: paśya me pārtha rūpāṇi śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ | nānāvidhāni divyāni nānāvarṇākṛtīni ca
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः । नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च ॥
verses.english: Behold, O son of Pritha, my forms by hundreds and thousands, various, divine, diverse in hue and shape.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: paśyādityān vasūn rudrān aśvinau marutas tathā | bahūny adṛṣṭapūrvāṇi paśyāścaryāṇi bhārata
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रान्अश्विनौ मरुतस्तथा । बहून्य्अदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याश्चर्याणि भारत ॥
verses.english: Behold the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the Aswins, and the Maruts. Behold, O Bharata, innumerable marvels unseen before (by thee).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ihaikasthaṃ jagat kṛtsnaṃ paśyādya sacarācaram | mama dehe guḍākeśa yac cānyad draṣṭum icchasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम् । मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद्द्रष्टुम्इच्छसि ॥
verses.english: Behold, O thou of curly hair, the entire universe of mobiles and immobiles, collected together in this body of mine, whatever else thou mayst wish to see.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na tu māṃ śakyase draṣṭum anenaiva svacakṣuṣā | divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me yogam aiśvaram
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुम्अनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा । दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगम्ऐश्वरम् ॥
verses.english: Thou art, however, not competent to behold me with this eye of thine. I give thee celestial sight. Behold my sovereign mystic nature.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit_iast: evam uktvā tato rājan mahāyogeśvaro hariḥ | darśayām āsa pārthāya paramaṃ rūpam aiśvaram
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एवम्उक्त्वा ततो राजन्महायोगेश्वरो हरिः । दर्शयाम्आस पार्थाय परमं रूपम्ऐश्वरम् ॥
verses.english: Having said this, O monarch, Hari, the mighty Lord of mystic power, then revealed to the son of Pritha his Supreme sovereign form,

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit_iast: anekavaktranayanam anekādbhutadarśanam | anekadivyābharaṇaṃ divyānekodyatāyudham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अनेकवक्त्रनयनम्अनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम् । अनेकदिव्याभरणं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम् ॥
verses.english: with many mouths and eyes, many wonderous aspects, many celestial ornaments, many celestial weapons uplifted,

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit_iast: divyamālyāmbaradharaṃ divyagandhānulepanam | sarvāścaryamayaṃ devam anantaṃ viśvatomukham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम् । सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवम्अनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम् ॥
verses.english: wearing celestial garlands and robes, (and) with unguents of celestial fragrance, full of every wonder, resplendent, infinite, with faces turned on all sides.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit_iast: divi sūryasahasrasya bhaved yugapad utthitā | yadi bhāḥ sadṛśī sā syād bhāsas tasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपद्उत्थिता । यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः ॥
verses.english: If the splendour of a thousand suns were to burst forth at once in the sky, (then) that would be like the splendour of that Mighty One.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit_iast: tatraikasthaṃ jagat kṛtsnaṃ pravibhaktam anekadhā | apaśyad devadevasya śarīre pāṇḍavas tadā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तम्अनेकधा । अपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा ॥
