verses.english: The son of Pandu then beheld there in the body of that God of gods the entire universe divided and sub-divided into many parts, all collected together.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit_iast: tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo hṛṣṭaromā dhanaṃjayaḥ | praṇamya śirasā devaṃ kṛtāñjalir abhāṣata
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनंजयः । प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिर्अभाषत ॥
verses.english: Then Dhananjaya, filled with amazement, (and) with hair standing on end, bowing with (his) head, with joined hands addressed the God.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: paśyāmi devāṃs tava deva dehe | sarvāṃs tathā bhūtaviśeṣasaṃghān | brahmāṇam īśaṃ kamalāsanastham | ṛṣīṃś ca sarvān uragāṃś ca divyān
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे । सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसंघान् । ब्रह्माणम्ईशं कमलासनस्थम् । ऋषींश्च सर्वान्उरगांश्च दिव्यान् ॥
verses.english: I behold all the gods, O God, as also all the varied hosts of creatures, (and) Brahman seated on (his) lotus seat, and all the Rishis and the celestial snakes.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: anekabāhūdaravaktranetraṃ | paśyāmi tvā sarvato 'nantarūpam | nāntaṃ na madhyaṃ na punas tavādiṃ | paśyāmi viśveśvara viśvarūpa
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं । पश्यामि त्वा सर्वतो ऽनन्तरूपम् । नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं । पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप ॥
verses.english: I behold Thee with innumerable arms, stomachs, mouths, (and) eyes, on every side, O thou of infinite forms. Neither end nor middle, nor also beginning of thine do I behold, O Lord of the universe, O thou of universal form.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakriṇaṃ ca | tejorāśiṃ sarvato dīptimantam | paśyāmi tvāṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ samantād | dīptānalārkadyutim aprameyam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं च । तेजोराशिं सर्वतो दीप्तिमन्तम् । पश्यामि त्वां दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ताद् । दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिम्अप्रमेयम् ॥
verses.english: Bearing (thy) diadem, mace, and discus, a mass of energy, glowing on all sides, do I behold thee that art hard to look at, endued on all sides with the effulgence of the blazing fire or the Sun, (and) immeasurable.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tvam akṣaraṃ paramaṃ veditavyaṃ | tvam asya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam | tvam avyayaḥ śāśvatadharmagoptā | sanātanas tvaṃ puruṣo mato me
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: त्वम्अक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं । त्वम्अस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् । त्वम्अव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता । सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे ॥
verses.english: Thou art indestructible, (and) the Supreme object of this universe. Thou art without decay, the guardian of eternal virtue. I regard thee to be the eternal (male) Being.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: anādimadhyāntam anantavīryam | anantabāhuṃ śaśisūryanetram | paśyāmi tvāṃ dīptahutāśavaktraṃ | svatejasā viśvam idaṃ tapantam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अनादिमध्यान्तम्अनन्तवीर्यम् । अनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम् । पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रं । स्वतेजसा विश्वम्इदं तपन्तम् ॥
verses.english: I behold thee to be without beginning, mean, end, to be of infinite prowess, of innumerable arms, having the Sun and the Moon for thy eyes, the blazing fire for thy mouth, and heating this universe with energy of thy own.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: dyāvāpṛthivyor idam antaraṃ hi | vyāptaṃ tvayaikena diśaś ca sarvāḥ | dṛṣṭvādbhutaṃ rūpam idaṃ tavograṃ | lokatrayaṃ pravyathitaṃ mahātman
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: द्यावापृथिव्योर्इदम्अन्तरं हि । व्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः । दृष्ट्वाद्भुतं रूपम्इदं तवोग्रं । लोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन् ॥
verses.english: For the space betwixt heaven and earth is pervaded by Thee alone, as also all the points of the horizon. At sight of this marvellous and fierce form of thine, O Supreme Soul, the triple world trembleth.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: amī hi tvā surasaṃghā viśanti | ke cid bhītāḥ prāñjalayo gṛṇanti | svastīty uktvā maharṣisiddhasaṃghāḥ | stuvanti tvāṃ stutibhiḥ puṣkalābhiḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अमी हि त्वा सुरसंघा विशन्ति । के चिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति । स्वस्तीत्य्उक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसंघाः । स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः ॥
verses.english: For these hosts of gods are entering thee. Some, afraid, are praying with joined hands. Saying Hail to Thee—the hosts of great Rishis and Siddhas praise Thee with copious hymns of praise.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: rudrādityā vasavo ye ca sādhyā | viśve 'śvinau marutaś coṣmapāś ca | gandharvayakṣāsurasiddhasaṃghā | vīkṣante tvāṃ vismitāś caiva sarve
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्या । विश्वे ऽश्विनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च । गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसंघा । वीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे ॥
verses.english: The Rudras, the Adityas, the Vasus, they that (called) the Siddhas, the Viswas, the Aswins, the Maruts, also the Ushmapas, the Gandharvas, the Yakshas, the Asuras, the hosts of Siddhyas, behold Thee and are all amazed.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: rūpaṃ mahat te bahuvaktranetraṃ | mahābāho bahubāhūrupādam | bahūdaraṃ bahudaṃṣṭrākarālaṃ | dṛṣṭvā lokāḥ pravyathitās tathāham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं । महाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम् । बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं । दृष्ट्वा लोकाः प्रव्यथितास्तथाहम् ॥
verses.english: Beholding Thy mighty form with many mouths and eyes, O mighty-armed one, with innumerable arms, thighs and feet, many stomachs, (and) terrible in consequence of many tusks, all creatures are frightened and I also.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: nabhaḥspṛśaṃ dīptam anekavarṇaṃ | vyāttānanaṃ dīptaviśālanetram | dṛṣṭvā hi tvāṃ pravyathitāntarātmā | dhṛtiṃ na vindāmi śamaṃ ca viṣṇo
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नभःस्पृशं दीप्तम्अनेकवर्णं । व्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम् । दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा । धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो ॥
verses.english: Indeed, touching the very skies, of blazing radiance, many-hued, mouth wide-open, with eyes that are blazing and large, beholding thee, O Vishnu, with (my) inner soul trembling (in fright), I can no longer command courage and peace of mind.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: daṃṣṭrākarālāni ca te mukhāni | dṛṣṭvaiva kālānalasaṃnibhāni | diśo na jāne na labhe ca śarma | prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानि । दृष्ट्वैव कालानलसंनिभानि । दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्म । प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास ॥
verses.english: Beholding thy mouths that are terrible in consequence of (their) tusks, and that are fierce (as the all-destroying fire at the end of the Yuga), I cannot recognise the points of the horizon nor can I command peace of mind.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: amī ca tvāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāḥ | sarve sahaivāvanipālasaṃghaiḥ | bhīṣmo droṇaḥ sūtaputras tathāsau | sahāsmadīyair api yodhamukhyaiḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः । सर्वे सहैवावनिपालसंघैः । भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथासौ । सहास्मदीयैर्अपि योधमुख्यैः ॥
verses.english: Be gracious, O God of gods, O thou that art the refuge of the Universe. And all these sons of Dhritarashtra, together with the hosts of kings, and Bhishma, and Drona, and also this Suta's son (Karna),

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: vaktrāṇi te tvaramāṇā viśanti | daṃṣṭrākarālāni bhayānakāni | ke cid vilagnā daśanāntareṣu | saṃdṛśyante cūrṇitair uttamāṅgaiḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्ति । दंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि । के चिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषु । संदृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैर्उत्तमाङ्गैः ॥
verses.english: accompanied by even the principal warriors of our side, are quickly entering thy terrible mouths rendered fierce by thy tusks. Some, with their heads crushed, are seen striking at the interstices of (thy) teeth.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yathā nadīnāṃ bahavo 'mbuvegāḥ | samudram evābhimukhā dravanti | tathā tavāmī naralokavīrā | viśanti vaktrāṇy abhivijvalanti
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यथा नदीनां बहवो ऽम्बुवेगाः । समुद्रम्एवाभिमुखा द्रवन्ति । तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा । विशन्ति वक्त्राण्य्अभिविज्वलन्ति ॥
verses.english: As many currents of water flowing through different channels roll rapidly towards the ocean, so these heroes of the world of men enter thy mouths that flame all around.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yathā pradīptaṃ jvalanaṃ pataṃgā | viśanti nāśāya samṛddhavegāḥ | tathaiva nāśāya viśanti lokās | tavāpi vaktrāṇi samṛddhavegāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतंगा । विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः । तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोकास् । तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः ॥
verses.english: As moths with increasing speed rush for (their own) destruction to the blazing fire, so also do (these) people, with unceasing speed, enter thy mouths for (their) destruction.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: lelihyase grasamānaḥ samantāl | lokān samagrān vadanair jvaladbhiḥ | tejobhir āpūrya jagat samagraṃ | bhāsas tavogrāḥ pratapanti viṣṇo
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ताल् । लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः । तेजोभिर्आपूर्य जगत्समग्रं । भासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो ॥
verses.english: Swallowing all these men from every side, thou lickest them with thy flaming mouths. Filling the whole universe with (thy) energy, thy fierce splendours, O Vishnu, are heating (everything). Tell me who thou art of (such) fierce form.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ākhyāhi me ko bhavān ugrarūpo | namo 'stu te devavara prasīda | vijñātum icchāmi bhavantam ādyaṃ | na hi prajānāmi tava pravṛttim
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: आख्याहि मे को भवान्उग्ररूपो । नमो ऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद । विज्ञातुम्इच्छामि भवन्तम्आद्यं । न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम् ॥
verses.english: I bow to thee, O chief of the gods, be gracious to me. I desire to know thee that art the Primeval One, I do not understand thy action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kālo 'smi lokakṣayakṛt pravṛddho | lokān samāhartum iha pravṛttaḥ | ṛte 'pi tvā na bhaviṣyanti sarve | ye 'vasthitāḥ pratyanīkeṣu yodhāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कालो ऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो । लोकान्समाहर्तुम्इह प्रवृत्तः । ऋते ऽपि त्वा न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे । ये ऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः ॥
verses.english: I am Death, the destroyer of the worlds, fully developed. I am now engaged in slaying the race of men. Without thee all these warriors standing in the different divisions shall cease to be.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tasmāt tvam uttiṣṭha yaśo labhasva | jitvā śatrūn bhuṅkṣva rājyaṃ samṛddham | mayaivaite nihatāḥ pūrvam eva | nimittamātraṃ bhava savyasācin
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तस्मात्त्वम्उत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व । जित्वा शत्रून्भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम् । मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वम्एव । निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन् ॥
verses.english: Wherefore, arise, gain glory, (and) vanquishing the foe, enjoy (this) swelling kingdom. By me have all these been already slain. Be only (my) instrument. O thou that can'st draw the bow with (even) the left hand.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: droṇaṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca jayadrathaṃ ca | karṇaṃ tathānyān api yodhavīrān | mayā hatāṃs tvaṃ jahi mā vyathiṣṭhā | yudhyasva jetāsi raṇe sapatnān
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च । कर्णं तथान्यान्अपि योधवीरान् । मया हतांस्त्वं जहि मा व्यथिष्ठा । युध्यस्व जेतासि रणे सपत्नान् ॥
verses.english: Drona and Bhishma, and Jayadratha, and Karna, and also other heroic warriors, (already) slain by me, do thou slay. Be not dismayed, fight; thou shalt conquer in battle (thy) foes.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit_iast: etac chrutvā vacanaṃ keśavasya | kṛtāñjalir vepamānaḥ kirīṭī | namaskṛtvā bhūya evāha kṛṣṇaṃ | sagadgadaṃ bhītabhītaḥ praṇamya
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्य । कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी । नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं । सगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य ॥
verses.english: Hearing these words of Kesava, the diadem-decked (Arjuna), trembling, (and) with joined hands, bowed (unto him); and once more said unto Krishna, with voice choked up and overwhelmed with fear, and making his salutations (to him).

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sthāne hṛṣīkeśa tava prakīrtyā | jagat prahṛṣyaty anurajyate ca | rakṣāṃsi bhītāni diśo dravanti | sarve namasyanti ca siddhasaṃghāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्या । जगत्प्रहृष्यत्य्अनुरज्यते च । रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्ति । सर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसंघाः ॥
verses.english: It is meet, Hrishikesa, that the universe is delighted and charmed in uttering thy praise, and the Rakshasas flee in fear in all directions, and the hosts of the Siddhas bow down (to thee).

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kasmāc ca te na nameran mahātman | garīyase brahmaṇo 'py ādikartre | ananta deveśa jagannivāsa | tvam akṣaraṃ sad asat tatparaṃ yat
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन् । गरीयसे ब्रह्मणो ऽप्य्आदिकर्त्रे । अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवास । त्वम्अक्षरं सद्असत्तत्परं यत् ॥
verses.english: And why should they not bow down to thee, O Supreme Soul, that are greater than even Brahman (himself), and the primal cause? O thou that art Infinite, O God of the gods, O thou that art the refuge of the universe, thou art indestructible, thou art that which is, and that which is not and that which is beyond (both).

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tvam ādidevaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇas | tvam asya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam | vettāsi vedyaṃ ca paraṃ ca dhāma | tvayā tataṃ viśvam anantarūpa
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: त्वम्आदिदेवः पुरुषः पुराणस् । त्वम्अस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् । वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धाम । त्वया ततं विश्वम्अनन्तरूप ॥
verses.english: Thou art the First God, the ancient (male) Being, thou art the Supreme refuge of this universe. Thou art the Knower, thou art the Object to be known, thou art the highest abode. By thee is pervaded this universe, O thou of infinite form.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: vāyur yamo 'gnir varuṇaḥ śaśāṅkaḥ | prajāpatis tvaṃ prapitāmahaś ca | namo namas te 'stu sahasrakṛtvaḥ | punaś ca bhūyo 'pi namo namas te
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: वायुर्यमो ऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कः । प्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च । नमो नमस्ते ऽस्तु सहस्रकृत्वः । पुनश्च भूयो ऽपि नमो नमस्ते ॥
verses.english: Thou art Vayu, Yama, Agni, Varuna, Moon, Prajapati, and Grandsire. Obeisance be to thee a thousand times, and again and yet again obeisance to thee. Obeisance to thee in front, and also from behind.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: namaḥ purastād atha pṛṣṭhatas te | namo 'stu te sarvata eva sarva | anantavīryāmitavikramas tvaṃ | sarvaṃ samāpnoṣi tato 'si sarvaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नमः पुरस्ताद्अथ पृष्ठतस्ते । नमो ऽस्तु ते सर्वत एव सर्व । अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वं । सर्वं समाप्नोषि ततो ऽसि सर्वः ॥
verses.english: Let obeisance be to thee from every side, O thou that art all. Thou art all, of energy that is infinite, and prowess that is immeasurable. Thou embracest the All.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sakheti matvā prasabhaṃ yad uktaṃ | he kṛṣṇa he yādava he sakheti | ajānatā mahimānaṃ tavedaṃ | mayā pramādāt praṇayena vāpi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यद्उक्तं । हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति । अजानता महिमानं तवेदं । मया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि ॥
verses.english: Regarding (thee) a friend whatever hath been said by me carelessly, such as—"O Krishna, O Yadava, O friend,"—not knowing this thy greatness from want of judgement or from love either, whatever disrespect hath been shown thee for purpose of mirth, on occasions of play, lying, sitting, (or) at meals, while alone or in the presence of others, O undeteriorating one, I beg thy pardon for it, that art immeasurable.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yac cāvahāsārtham asatkṛto 'si | vihāraśayyāsanabhojaneṣu | eko 'tha vāpy acyuta tatsamakṣaṃ | tat kṣāmaye tvām aham aprameyam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यच्चावहासार्थम्असत्कृतो ऽसि । विहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु । एको ऽथ वाप्य्अच्युत तत्समक्षं । तत्क्षामये त्वाम्अहम्अप्रमेयम् ॥
verses.english: Thou art the father of this universe of mobiles and immobiles. Thou art the great master deserving of worship. There is none equal to thee, how can there be one greater?

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: pitāsi lokasya carācarasya | tvam asya pūjyaś ca gurur garīyān | na tvatsamo 'sty abhyadhikaḥ kuto 'nyo | lokatraye 'py apratimaprabhāva
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्य । त्वम्अस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान् । न त्वत्समो ऽस्त्य्अभ्यधिकः कुतो ऽन्यो । लोकत्रये ऽप्य्अप्रतिमप्रभाव ॥
verses.english: O thou whose power is unparalleled in even three worlds? Therefore bowing (to thee) prostrating (my) body, I ask thy grace, O Lord, O adorable one.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tasmāt praṇamya praṇidhāya kāyaṃ | prasādaye tvām aham īśam īḍyam | piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuḥ | priyaḥ priyāyārhasi deva soḍhum
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायं । प्रसादये त्वाम्अहम्ईशम्ईड्यम् । पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्युः । प्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम् ॥
verses.english: It behoveth thee, O God, to bear (my faults) as a father (his) son's, a friend (his) friend's, a lover (his) loved one's.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ hṛṣito 'smi dṛṣṭvā | bhayena ca pravyathitaṃ mano me | tad eva me darśaya deva rūpaṃ | prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषितो ऽस्मि दृष्ट्वा । भयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे । तद्एव मे दर्शय देव रूपं । प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास ॥
verses.english: Beholding (thy) form (unseen) before, I have been joyful, (yet) my mind hath been troubled, with fear. Show me that (other ordinary) form, O God. Be gracious, O Lord of the gods, O thou that art the refuge of the universe.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakrahastam | icchāmi tvāṃ draṣṭum ahaṃ tathaiva | tenaiva rūpeṇa caturbhujena | sahasrabāho bhava viśvamūrte
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रहस्तम् । इच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुम्अहं तथैव । तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेन । सहस्रबाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते ॥
verses.english: (Decked) in diadem, and (armed) with mace, discus in hand, as before, I desire to behold thee. Be of that same four-armed form, O thou of a thousand arms, thou of universal form.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mayā prasannena tavārjunedaṃ | rūpaṃ paraṃ darśitam ātmayogāt | tejomayaṃ viśvam anantam | ādyaṃ yan me tvadanyena na dṛṣṭapūrvam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदं । रूपं परं दर्शितम्आत्मयोगात् । तेजोमयं विश्वम्अनन्तम् । आद्यं यन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम् ॥
verses.english: Pleased with thee, O Arjuna, I have, by my (own) mystic power, shown thee this supreme form, full of glory, Universal, Infinite, Primeval, which hath been seen before by none save thee.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na veda yajñādhyayanair na dānair | na ca kriyābhir na tapobhir ugraiḥ | evaṃrūpaḥ śakya ahaṃ nṛloke | draṣṭuṃ tvadanyena kurupravīra
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न वेद यज्ञाध्ययनैर्न दानैर् । न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिर्उग्रैः । एवंरूपः शक्य अहं नृलोके । द्रष्टुं त्वदन्येन कुरुप्रवीर ॥
verses.english: Except by thee alone, hero of Kuru's race, I cannot be seen in this form in the world of men by any one else, (aided) even by the study of the Vedas and of sacrifices, by gifts, by actions, (or) by the severest austerities.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mā te vyathā mā ca vimūḍhabhāvo | dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ ghoram īdṛṅ mamedam | vyapetabhīḥ prītamanāḥ punas tvaṃ | tad eva me rūpam idaṃ prapaśya
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो । दृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरम्ईदृङ्ममेदम् । व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वं । तद्एव मे रूपम्इदं प्रपश्य ॥
verses.english: Let no fear be thine, nor perplexity of mind at seeing this awful form of mine. Freed from fear with a joyful heart, thou again see Me assuming that other form.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit_iast: ity arjunaṃ vāsudevas tathoktvā | svakaṃ rūpaṃ darśayām āsa bhūyaḥ | āśvāsayām āsa ca bhītam enaṃ | bhūtvā punaḥ saumyavapur mahātmā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इत्य्अर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा । स्वकं रूपं दर्शयाम्आस भूयः । आश्वासयाम्आस च भीतम्एनं । भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा ॥
verses.english: Vasudeva, having said all this to Arjuna, once more showed (him) his own (ordinary) form, and that High-Souled one, assuming once more (his) gentle form, comforted him who had been afflicted.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: dṛṣṭvedaṃ mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ tava saumyaṃ janārdana | idānīm asmi saṃvṛttaḥ sacetāḥ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: दृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तव सौम्यं जनार्दन । इदानीम्अस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः ॥
verses.english: Beholding this gentle human form of thine, O Janardana, I have now become of right mind and have come to my normal state.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sudurdarśam idaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭavān asi yan mama | devā apy asya rūpasya nityaṃ darśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सुदुर्दर्शम्इदं रूपं दृष्टवान्असि यन्मम । देवा अप्य्अस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः ॥
verses.english: This form of mine which thou hast seen is difficult of being seen. Even the gods are always desirous of becoming spectators of this (my) form.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: nāhaṃ vedair na tapasā na dānena na cejyayā | śakya evaṃvidho draṣṭuṃ dṛṣṭavān asi māṃ yathā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया । शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवान्असि मां यथा ॥
verses.english: Not by the Vedas, nor by austerities, nor by gifts, nor by sacrifices, can I be seen in this form of mine which thou hast seen.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: bhaktyā tv ananyayā śakya aham evaṃvidho 'rjuna | jñātuṃ draṣṭuṃ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṃ ca paraṃtapa
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: भक्त्या त्व्अनन्यया शक्य अहम्एवंविधो ऽर्जुन । ज्ञातुं द्रष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परंतप ॥
verses.english: By reverence, however, that is exclusive (in its objects), O Arjuna, I can in this form be known, seen truly, and attained to, O chastiser of foes.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: matkarmakṛn matparamo madbhaktaḥ saṅgavarjitaḥ | nirvairaḥ sarvabhūteṣu yaḥ sa mām eti pāṇḍava
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः । निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स माम्एति पाण्डव ॥
verses.english: He who doth everything for me, who hath me for his supreme object, who is freed from attachment, who is without enmity towards all beings, even he, O Arjuna, cometh to me.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: evaṃ satatayuktā ye bhaktās tvāṃ paryupāsate | ye cāpy akṣaram avyaktaṃ teṣāṃ ke yogavittamāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते । ये चाप्य्अक्षरम्अव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः ॥
verses.english: Of those worshippers who, constantly devoted, adore thee, and those who (meditate) on thee as the Immutable and Unmanifest, who are best acquainted with devotion?

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mayy āveśya mano ye māṃ nityayuktā upāsate | śraddhayā parayopetās te me yuktatamā matāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मय्य्आवेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते । श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः ॥
verses.english: Fixing (their) mind on me, they that constantly adore me, being endued (besides) with the highest faith, are deemed by me to be the most devoted.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ye tv akṣaram anirdeśyam avyaktaṃ paryupāsate | sarvatragam acintyaṃ ca kūṭastham acalaṃ dhruvam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ये त्व्अक्षरम्अनिर्देश्यम्अव्यक्तं पर्युपासते । सर्वत्रगम्अचिन्त्यं च कूटस्थम्अचलं ध्रुवम् ॥
verses.english: They, however, who worship the Immutable, the Unmanifest, the All-pervading, the Inconceivable, the Indifferent, the Immutable, the Eternal, who, restraining the entire group of the senses,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: saṃniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ sarvatra samabuddhayaḥ | te prāpnuvanti mām eva sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: संनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः । ते प्राप्नुवन्ति माम्एव सर्वभूतहिते रताः ॥
verses.english: are equal-minded in respect of all around and are engaged in the good of all creatures, (also) attain to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kleśo 'dhikataras teṣām avyaktāsaktacetasām | avyaktā hi gatir duḥkhaṃ dehavadbhir avāpyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: क्लेशो ऽधिकतरस्तेषाम्अव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम् । अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिर्अवाप्यते ॥
verses.english: The trouble is the greater for those whose minds are fixed on the Unmanifest; for the path to the Unmanifest is hard to find by those that are embodied.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparāḥ | ananyenaiva yogena māṃ dhyāyanta upāsate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः । अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते ॥
verses.english: They (again) who, reposing all action on me (and) regarding me as their highest object (of attainment), worship me, meditating on me with devotion undirected to anything else,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: teṣām ahaṃ samuddhartā mṛtyusaṃsārasāgarāt | bhavāmi nacirāt pārtha mayy āveśitacetasām
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तेषाम्अहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात् । भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्य्आवेशितचेतसाम् ॥
verses.english: of them whose minds are (thus) fixed on me, I, without delay, become the deliverer from the ocean of (this) mortal world.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mayy eva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṃ niveśaya | nivasiṣyasi mayy eva ata ūrdhvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मय्य्एव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय । निवसिष्यसि मय्य्एव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः ॥
verses.english: Fix thy heart on me alone, place thy understanding on me, Hereafter then shalt thou dwell in me. (There is) no doubt (in this).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: atha cittaṃ samādhātuṃ na śaknoṣi mayi sthiram | abhyāsayogena tato mām icchāptuṃ dhanaṃjaya
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम् । अभ्यासयोगेन ततो माम्इच्छाप्तुं धनंजय ॥
verses.english: If however, thou art unable to fix thy heart steadily on me, then, O Dhananjaya, strive to obtain me by devotion (arising) from continuous application.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: abhyāse 'py asamartho 'si matkarmaparamo bhava | madartham api karmāṇi kurvan siddhim avāpsyasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अभ्यासे ऽप्य्असमर्थो ऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव । मदर्थम्अपि कर्माणि कुर्वन्सिद्धिम्अवाप्स्यसि ॥
verses.english: If thou beest unequal to even (this) continuous application, then let actions performed for me be thy highest aim. Even performing all thy acts for my sake, thou wilt obtain perfection.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: athaitad apy aśakto 'si kartuṃ madyogam āśritaḥ | sarvakarmaphalatyāgaṃ tataḥ kuru yatātmavān
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अथैतद्अप्य्अशक्तो ऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगम्आश्रितः । सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान् ॥
verses.english: If even this thou art unable to do, then resorting to devotion in me, (and) subduing thy soul, abandon the fruit of all actions.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śreyo hi jñānam abhyāsāj jñānād dhyānaṃ viśiṣyate | dhyānāt karmaphalatyāgas tyāgāc chāntir anantaram
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: श्रेयो हि ज्ञानम्अभ्यासाज्ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते । ध्यानात्कर्मफलत्यागस्त्यागाच्छान्तिर्अनन्तरम् ॥
verses.english: Knowledge is superior to application (in devotion); meditation is better than knowledge; the abandonment of the fruit of reaction (is better) than meditation; and tranquillity (results) immediately from abandonment.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: adveṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca | nirmamo nirahaṃkāraḥ samaduḥkhasukhaḥ kṣamī
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च । निर्ममो निरहंकारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी ॥
verses.english: He who hath no hatred for any creature, who is friendly and compassionate also, who is free from egoism, who hath no vanity, attachment, who is alike in pleasure and pain,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: saṃtuṣṭaḥ satataṃ yogī yatātmā dṛḍhaniścayaḥ | mayy arpitamanobuddhir yo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: संतुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः । मय्य्अर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥
verses.english: who is forgiving, contented, always devoted, of subdued soul, firm of purpose, with heart and understanding fixed on me, even he is dear to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yasmān nodvijate loko lokān nodvijate ca yaḥ | harṣāmarṣabhayodvegair mukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः । हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः ॥
verses.english: He through whom the world is not troubled, (and) who is not troubled by the world, who is free from joy, wrath, fear and anxieties, even he is dear to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: anapekṣaḥ śucir dakṣa udāsīno gatavyathaḥ | sarvārambhaparityāgī yo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः । सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥
verses.english: That devotee of mine who is unconcerned, pure, diligent, unconnected (with worldly objects), and free from distress (of mind), and who renounceth every action (for fruit), even he is dear to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yo na hṛṣyati na dveṣṭi na śocati na kāṅkṣati | śubhāśubhaparityāgī bhaktimān yaḥ sa me priyaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति । शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्तिमान्यः स मे प्रियः ॥
verses.english: He who hath no joy, no aversion, who neither grieveth nor desireth, who renounceth both good and evil, (and) who is full of faith in me, even he is dear to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥ | śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkheṣu samaḥ saṅgavivarjitaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः । शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः ॥
verses.english: He who is alike to friend and foe, as also in honour and dishonour, who is alike in cold and heat, (and pleasure and pain), who is free from attachment,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tulyanindāstutir maunī saṃtuṣṭo yena kena cit | aniketaḥ sthiramatir bhaktimān me priyo naraḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी संतुष्टो येन केन चित् । अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान्मे प्रियो नरः ॥
verses.english: to whom censure and praise are equal, who is taciturn, who is contented with anything that cometh (to him), who is homeless, of steady mind and full of faith, even that man is dear to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ye tu dharmyāmṛtam idaṃ yathoktaṃ paryupāsate | śraddadhānā matparamā bhaktās te 'tīva me priyāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ये तु धर्म्यामृतम्इदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते । श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्ते ऽतीव मे प्रियाः ॥
verses.english: They who resort to this righteousness (leading to) immortality which hath been (already) declared,—those devotees full of faith and regarding me as the highest object (of their acquisition) are the dearest to me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: idaṃ śarīraṃ kaunteya kṣetram ity abhidhīyate | etad yo vetti taṃ prāhuḥ kṣetrajña iti tadvidaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रम्इत्य्अभिधीयते । एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः ॥
verses.english: This body, O son of Kunti, is called Kshetra. Him who knoweth it, the learned call Kshetrajna.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi sarvakṣetreṣu bhārata | kṣetrakṣetrajñayor jñānaṃ yat taj jñānaṃ mataṃ mama
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत । क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम ॥
verses.english: Know me, O Bharata, to be Kshetras. The knowledge of Kshetra and Kshetrajna I regard to be (true) knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tat kṣetraṃ yac ca yādṛk ca yadvikāri yataś ca yat | sa ca yo yatprabhāvaś ca tat samāsena me śṛṇu
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक्च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत् । स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे शृणु ॥
verses.english: What that Kshetra (is), and what (it is) like, and what changes it undergoes, and whence (it comes), what is he (viz., Kshetrajna), and what his powers are, hear from me in brief.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ṛṣibhir bahudhā gītaṃ chandobhir vividhaiḥ pṛthak | brahmasūtrapadaiś caiva hetumadbhir viniścitaiḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक् । ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्चितैः ॥
verses.english: All this hath in many ways been sung separately, by Rishis in various verses, in well-settled texts fraught with reason and giving indications of Brahman.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mahābhūtāny ahaṃkāro buddhir avyaktam eva ca | indriyāṇi daśaikaṃ ca pañca cendriyagocarāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: महाभूतान्य्अहंकारो बुद्धिर्अव्यक्तम्एव च । इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः ॥
verses.english: The great elements, egoism, intellect, the unmanifest (viz., Prakriti), also the ten senses, the one (manas), the five objects of sense, desire, aversion,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: icchā dveṣaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃghātaś cetanā dhṛtiḥ | etat kṣetraṃ samāsena savikāram udāhṛtam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं संघातश्चेतना धृतिः । एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारम्उदाहृतम् ॥
verses.english: pleasure, pain, body consciousness, courage,—all this in brief hath been declared to be Kshetra in its modified form.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: amānitvam adambhitvam ahiṃsā kṣāntir ārjavam | ācāryopāsanaṃ śaucaṃ sthairyam ātmavinigrahaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अमानित्वम्अदम्भित्वम्अहिंसा क्षान्तिर्आर्जवम् । आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यम्आत्मविनिग्रहः ॥
verses.english: Absence of vanity, absence of ostentation, abstention from injury, forgiveness, uprightness, devotion to preceptor, purity, constancy,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: indriyārtheṣu vairāgyam anahaṃkāra eva ca | janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiduḥkhadoṣānudarśanam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यम्अनहंकार एव च । जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम् ॥
verses.english: self-restraint, indifference to objects of sense, absence of egoism, perception of the misery and evil of birth, death, decrepitude and disease, freedom from attachment,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: asaktir anabhiṣvaṅgaḥ putradāragṛhādiṣu | nityaṃ ca samacittatvam iṣṭāniṣṭopapattiṣu
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: असक्तिर्अनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु । नित्यं च समचित्तत्वम्इष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु ॥
verses.english: absence of sympathy for son, wife, home, and the rest, and constant equanimity of heart on attainment of good and evil,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mayi cānanyayogena bhaktir avyabhicāriṇī | viviktadeśasevitvam aratir janasaṃsadi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्तिर्अव्यभिचारिणी । विविक्तदेशसेवित्वम्अरतिर्जनसंसदि ॥
verses.english: unswerving devotion to me without meditation on anything else, frequenting of lonely places, distaste for concourse of men, constancy in the knowledge of the relation of the individual self to the supreme,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: adhyātmajñānanityatvaṃ tattvajñānārthadarśanam | etaj jñānam iti proktam ajñānaṃ yad ato 'nyathā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम् । एतज्ज्ञानम्इति प्रोक्तम्अज्ञानं यद्अतो ऽन्यथा ॥
verses.english: perception of the object of the knowledge of truth,—all this is called Knowledge; all that which is contrary to this is Ignorance.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: jñeyaṃ yat tat pravakṣyāmi yaj jñātvāmṛtam aśnute | anādimat paraṃ brahma na sat tan nāsad ucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वामृतम्अश्नुते । अनादिमत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासद्उच्यते ॥
verses.english: That which is the object of knowledge I will (now) declare (to thee), knowing which one obtaineth immortality.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tat sarvato 'kṣiśiromukham | sarvataḥ śrutimal loke sarvam āvṛtya tiṣṭhati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतो ऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् । सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वम्आवृत्य तिष्ठति ॥
verses.english: It is the Supreme Brahma having no beginning, who is said to be neither existent nor non-existent; whose hands and feet are on all sides,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam | asaktaṃ sarvabhṛc caiva nirguṇaṃ guṇabhoktṛ ca
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम् । असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च ॥
verses.english: whose eyes, heads and faces are on all sides, who dwells pervading everything in the world, who is possessed of all the qualities of the senses (though) devoid of the senses,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: bahir antaś ca bhūtānām acaraṃ caram eva ca | sūkṣmatvāt tad avijñeyaṃ dūrasthaṃ cāntike ca tat
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: बहिर्अन्तश्च भूतानाम्अचरं चरम्एव च । सूक्ष्मत्वात्तद्अविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत् ॥
verses.english: without attachment (yet) sustaining all things, without attributes (yet) enjoying (a) all attributes, without and within all creatures, immobile and mobile, not knowable because of (his) subtlety, remote yet near,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: avibhaktaṃ ca bhūteṣu vibhaktam iva ca sthitam | bhūtabhartṛ ca taj jñeyaṃ grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तम्इव च स्थितम् । भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च ॥
verses.english: undistributed in all beings, (yet) remaining as if distributed, who is the sustainer of (all) beings, the absorber and the creator (of all); who is the light of all luminous bodies,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: jyotiṣām api taj jyotis tamasaḥ param ucyate | jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya viṣṭhitam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ज्योतिषाम्अपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परम्उच्यते । ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम् ॥
verses.english: who is said to be beyond all darkness; who is knowledge, the Object of knowledge, the End of knowledge and seated in the hearts of all.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: iti kṣetraṃ tathā jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ coktaṃ samāsataḥ | madbhakta etad vijñāya madbhāvāyopapadyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः । मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते ॥
verses.english: Thus Kshetra, and Knowledge, and the Object of Knowledge, have been declared (to thee) in brief. My devotee, knowing (all) this, becomes one in spirit with me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva viddhy anādī ubhāv api | vikārāṃś ca guṇāṃś caiva viddhi prakṛtisaṃbhavān
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्य्अनादी उभाव्अपि । विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसंभवान् ॥
verses.english: Know that Nature and Spirit are both without beginning (and) know (also) that all modifications and all qualities spring from Nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kāryakāraṇakartṛtve hetuḥ prakṛtir ucyate | puruṣaḥ sukhaduḥkhānāṃ bhoktṛtve hetur ucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कार्यकारणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिर्उच्यते । पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुर्उच्यते ॥
verses.english: Nature is said to be the source of the capacity of enjoying pleasures and pains.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: puruṣaḥ prakṛtistho hi bhuṅkte prakṛtijān guṇān | kāraṇaṃ guṇasaṅgo 'sya sadasadyonijanmasu
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान् । कारणं गुणसङ्गो ऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु ॥
verses.english: For Spirit, dwelling in nature enjoyeth the qualities born of Nature. The cause of its births in good or evil wombs is (its) connection with the qualities.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: upadraṣṭānumantā ca bhartā bhoktā maheśvaraḥ | paramātmeti cāpy ukto dehe 'smin puruṣaḥ paraḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: उपद्रष्टानुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः । परमात्मेति चाप्य्उक्तो देहे ऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः ॥
verses.english: The Supreme Purusha in this body is said to be surveyor, approver, supporter, enjoyer, the mighty lord, and also the Supreme Soul.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ya evaṃ vetti puruṣaṃ prakṛtiṃ ca guṇaiḥ saha | sarvathā vartamāno 'pi na sa bhūyo 'bhijāyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैः सह । सर्वथा वर्तमानो ऽपि न स भूयो ऽभिजायते ॥
verses.english: He who thus knows Spirit, and Nature, with the qualities, in whatever state he may be, is never born again.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: dhyānenātmani paśyanti ke cid ātmānam ātmanā | anye sāṃkhyena yogena karmayogena cāpare
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति के चिद्आत्मानम्आत्मना । अन्ये सांख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे ॥
verses.english: Some by meditation behold the self in the self by the self; others by devotion according to the Sankhya system; and others (again), by devotion through works.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: anye tv evam ajānantaḥ śrutvānyebhya upāsate | te 'pi cātitaranty eva mṛtyuṃ śrutiparāyaṇāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अन्ये त्व्एवम्अजानन्तः श्रुत्वान्येभ्य उपासते । ते ऽपि चातितरन्त्य्एव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः ॥
verses.english: Others yet not knowing this, worship, hearing of it from others. Even these, devoted to what is heard, cross over death.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yāvat saṃjāyate kiṃ cit sattvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam | kṣetrakṣetrajñasaṃyogāt tad viddhi bharatarṣabha
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यावत्संजायते किं चित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम् । क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ ॥
verses.english: Whatever entity, immobile or mobile, cometh into existence, know that, O bull of Bharata's race, to be from the connection of Kshetra and Kshetrajna (matter and spirit).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: samaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhantaṃ parameśvaram | vinaśyatsv avinaśyantaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम् । विनश्यत्स्व्अविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति ॥
verses.english: He seeth the Supreme Lord dwelling alike in all beings, the Imperishable in the Perishable.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: samaṃ paśyan hi sarvatra samavasthitam īśvaram | na hinasty ātmanātmānaṃ tato yāti parāṃ gatim
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितम्ईश्वरम् । न हिनस्त्य्आत्मनात्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
verses.english: For seeing the Lord dwelling alike everywhere, one doth not destroy himself by himself, and then reacheth the highest goal.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: prakṛtyaiva ca karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni sarvaśaḥ | yaḥ paśyati tathātmānam akartāraṃ sa paśyati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः । यः पश्यति तथात्मानम्अकर्तारं स पश्यति ॥
verses.english: He seeth (truly) who seeth all actions to be wrought by nature alone in every way and the self likewise to be not the doer.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yadā bhūtapṛthagbhāvam ekastham anupaśyati | tata eva ca vistāraṃ brahma saṃpadyate tadā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यदा भूतपृथग्भावम्एकस्थम्अनुपश्यति । तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म संपद्यते तदा ॥
verses.english: When one seeth the diversity of entities as existing in one, and the issue (everything) from that (One), then is one said to attain to Brahma.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: anāditvān nirguṇatvāt paramātmāyam avyayaḥ | śarīrastho 'pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायम्अव्ययः । शरीरस्थो ऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते ॥
verses.english: This inexhaustible Supreme Self, O son of Kunti, being without beginning and without attributes, doth not act, nor is stained even when stationed in the body.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yathā sarvagataṃ saukṣmyād ākāśaṃ nopalipyate | sarvatrāvasthito dehe tathātmā nopalipyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्याद्आकाशं नोपलिप्यते । सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथात्मा नोपलिप्यते ॥
verses.english: As space, which is ubiquitous, is never, in consequence of its subtlety tainted, so the soul, stationed in every body, is never tainted.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yathā prakāśayaty ekaḥ kṛtsnaṃ lokam imaṃ raviḥ | kṣetraṃ kṣetrī tathā kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati bhārata
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यथा प्रकाशयत्य्एकः कृत्स्नं लोकम्इमं रविः । क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत ॥
verses.english: As the single Sun lights up the entire world, so the Spirit, O Bharata, lights up the entire (sphere of) matters.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kṣetrakṣetrajñayor evam antaraṃ jñānacakṣuṣā | bhūtaprakṛtimokṣaṃ ca ye vidur yānti te param
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्एवम्अन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा । भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम् ॥
verses.english: They that, by the eye of knowledge, know the distinction between matter and spirit, and the deliverance from the nature of all entities, attain to the Supreme.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: paraṃ bhūyaḥ pravakṣyāmi jñānānāṃ jñānam uttamam | yaj jñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṃ siddhim ito gatāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: परं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानम्उत्तमम् । यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिम्इतो गताः ॥
verses.english: I will again declare (to thee) that supernal science of sciences, that excellent science, knowing which all the munis have attained to the highest perfection from (the fetters of) this body.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: idaṃ jñānam upāśritya mama sādharmyam āgatāḥ | sarge 'pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti ca
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इदं ज्ञानम्उपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यम्आगताः । सर्गे ऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च ॥
verses.english: Resorting to this science, and attaining to my nature, they are not reborn even on (the occasion of) a (new) creation and are not disturbed at the universal dissolution.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mama yonir mahad brahma tasmin garbhaṃ dadhāmy aham | saṃbhavaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tato bhavati bhārata
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मम योनिर्महद्ब्रह्म तस्मिन्गर्भं दधाम्य्अहम् । संभवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत ॥
verses.english: The mighty Brahma is a womb for me. Therein I place the (living) germ. Thence, O Bharata, the birth of all beings taketh place.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sarvayoniṣu kaunteya mūrtayaḥ saṃbhavanti yāḥ | tāsāṃ brahma mahad yonir ahaṃ bījapradaḥ pitā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः संभवन्ति याः । तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिर्अहं बीजप्रदः पिता ॥
verses.english: Whatever (bodily) forms, O son of Kunti, are born in all wombs, of them Brahma is the mighty womb, (and) I the seed-imparting Sire.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sattvaṃ rajas tama iti guṇāḥ prakṛtisaṃbhavāḥ | nibadhnanti mahābāho dehe dehinam avyayam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसंभवाः । निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनम्अव्ययम् ॥
verses.english: Goodness, passion, darkness, these qualities, born of nature, bind down, O thou of mighty arms, the eternal embodied soul in the body.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tatra sattvaṃ nirmalatvāt prakāśakam anāmayam | sukhasaṅgena badhnāti jñānasaṅgena cānagha
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकम्अनामयम् । सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ ॥
verses.english: Amongst these, Goodness, from its unsullied nature, being enlightening and free from misery, bindeth (the soul), O sinless one, with the attainment of happiness and of knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: rajo rāgātmakaṃ viddhi tṛṣṇāsaṅgasamudbhavam | tan nibadhnāti kaunteya karmasaṅgena dehinam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम् । तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम् ॥
verses.english: Know that passion, having desire for its essence, is born of thirst and attachment. That, O son of Kunti, bindeth the embodied (soul) by the attachment of work.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tamas tv ajñānajaṃ viddhi mohanaṃ sarvadehinām | pramādālasyanidrābhis tan nibadhnāti bhārata
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तमस्त्व्अज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम् । प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत ॥
verses.english: Darkness, however, know, is born of ignorance, (and) bewilders all embodied soul. That bindeth, O Bharata, by error, indolence, and sleep.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sattvaṃ sukhe saṃjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata | jñānam āvṛtya tu tamaḥ pramāde saṃjayaty uta
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सत्त्वं सुखे संजयति रजः कर्मणि भारत । ज्ञानम्आवृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे संजयत्य्उत ॥
verses.english: Goodness uniteth (the soul) with pleasure; Passion, O Bharata, uniteth with work; but darkness, veiling knowledge, uniteth with error.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: rajas tamaś cābhibhūya sattvaṃ bhavati bhārata | rajaḥ sattvaṃ tamaś caiva tamaḥ sattvaṃ rajas tathā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत । रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा ॥
verses.english: Passion and darkness, being repressed, Goodness remaineth, O Bharata. Passion and goodness (being repressed), darkness (remaineth); (and) darkness and goodness (being repressed), passion (remaineth).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sarvadvāreṣu dehe 'smin prakāśa upajāyate | jñānaṃ yadā tadā vidyād vivṛddhaṃ sattvam ity uta
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वद्वारेषु देहे ऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते । ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वम्इत्य्उत ॥
verses.english: When in this body, in all its gates, the light of knowledge is produced, then should one know that goodness hath been developed there.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: lobhaḥ pravṛttir ārambhaḥ karmaṇām aśamaḥ spṛhā | rajasy etāni jāyante vivṛddhe bharatarṣabha
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: लोभः प्रवृत्तिर्आरम्भः कर्मणाम्अशमः स्पृहा । रजस्य्एतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ ॥
verses.english: Avarice, activity, performance of works, want of tranquillity, desire,—these, O bull of Bharata's race, are born when passion is developed.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: aprakāśo 'pravṛttiś ca pramādo moha eva ca | tamasy etāni jāyante vivṛddhe kurunandana
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अप्रकाशो ऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च । तमस्य्एतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन ॥
verses.english: Gloom, inactivity, error, and delusion also,—these, O son of Kuru's race, are born when darkness is developed.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yadā sattve pravṛddhe tu pralayaṃ yāti dehabhṛt | tadottamavidāṃ lokān amalān pratipadyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत् । तदोत्तमविदां लोकान्अमलान्प्रतिपद्यते ॥
verses.english: When the holder of a body goeth to dissolution while goodness is developed, then he attaineth to the spotless regions of those that know the Supreme.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: rajasi pralayaṃ gatvā karmasaṅgiṣu jāyate | tathā pralīnas tamasi mūḍhayoniṣu jāyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते । तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते ॥
verses.english: Going to dissolution when passion prevails, one is born among those that are attached to work. Likewise, dissolved during darkness, one is born in wombs that beget the ignorant.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: karmaṇaḥ sukṛtasyāhuḥ sāttvikaṃ nirmalaṃ phalam | rajasas tu phalaṃ duḥkham ajñānaṃ tamasaḥ phalam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम् । रजसस्तु फलं दुःखम्अज्ञानं तमसः फलम् ॥
verses.english: The fruit of good action is said to be good and untainted. The fruit, however, of passion, is misery; (and) the fruit of Darkness is ignorance.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sattvāt saṃjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lobha eva ca | pramādamohau tamaso bhavato 'jñānam eva ca
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सत्त्वात्संजायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च । प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतो ऽज्ञानम्एव च ॥
verses.english: From goodness is produced knowledge; from passion, avarice; (and) from darkness are error and delusion, and also ignorance.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti sattvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ | jaghanyaguṇavṛttasthā adho gacchanti tāmasāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः । जघन्यगुणवृत्तस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः ॥
verses.english: They that dwell in goodness go on high; they that are addicted to passion dwell in the middle; (while) they that are of darkness, being addicted to the lowest quality, go down.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: nānyaṃ guṇebhyaḥ kartāraṃ yadā draṣṭānupaśyati | guṇebhyaś ca paraṃ vetti madbhāvaṃ so 'dhigacchati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति । गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सो ऽधिगच्छति ॥
verses.english: When an observer recognises none else to be an agent save the qualities, and knows that which is beyond (the qualities), he attaineth to my nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: guṇān etān atītya trīn dehī dehasamudbhavān | janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair vimukto 'mṛtam aśnute
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: गुणान्एतान्अतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान् । जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तो ऽमृतम्अश्नुते ॥
verses.english: The embodied soul, by transcending these three qualities which constitute the source of all bodies, enjoyeth immortality, being freed from birth, death, decrepitude, and misery.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kair liṅgais trīn guṇān etān atīto bhavati prabho | kimācāraḥ kathaṃ caitāṃs trīn guṇān ativartate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कैर्लिङ्गैस्त्रीन्गुणान्एतान्अतीतो भवति प्रभो । किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणान्अतिवर्तते ॥
verses.english: What are indications, O Lord, of one who hath transcended these three qualities? What is his conduct? How also doth one transcend these three qualities?

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: prakāśaṃ ca pravṛttiṃ ca moham eva ca pāṇḍava | na dveṣṭi saṃpravṛttāni na nivṛttāni kāṅkṣati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहम्एव च पाण्डव । न द्वेष्टि संप्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति ॥
verses.english: He who hath no aversion for light, activity, and even delusion, O son of Pandu,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: udāsīnavad āsīno guṇair yo na vicālyate | guṇā vartanta ity eva yo 'vatiṣṭhati neṅgate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: उदासीनवद्आसीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते । गुणा वर्तन्त इत्य्एव यो ऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते ॥
verses.english: when they are present, nor desireth them when they are absent, who, seated as one unconcerned, is not shaken by those qualities; who sitteth and moveth not,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: samaduḥkhasukhaḥ svasthaḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ | tulyapriyāpriyo dhīras tulyanindātmasaṃstutiḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः । तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः ॥
verses.english: thinking that it is the qualities (and not he) that are engaged (in their respective functions); to whom pain and pleasure are alike, who is self-contained, and to whom a sod of earth,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mānāpamānayos tulyas tulyo mitrāripakṣayoḥ | sarvārambhaparityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa ucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः । सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते ॥
verses.english: a stone, and gold are alike; to whom the agreeable and the disagreeable are the same; who hath discernment; to whom censure and praise are the same; to whom honour and dishonour are the same; who regardeth friend and foe alike; who hath renounced all exertion—is said to have transcended the qualities.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: māṃ ca yo 'vyabhicāreṇa bhaktiyogena sevate | sa guṇān samatītyaitān brahmabhūyāya kalpate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मां च यो ऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते । स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान्ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥
verses.english: He also who worshippeth Me with exclusive devotion, he, transcending those qualities, becometh fit for admission into the nature of Brahma.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: brahmaṇo hi pratiṣṭhāham amṛtasyāvyayasya ca | śāśvatasya ca dharmasya sukhasyaikāntikasya ca
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाहम्अमृतस्याव्ययस्य च । शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च ॥
verses.english: For I am the stay of Brahma, of immortality, of undestructibility, of eternal piety, and of unbroken felicity.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ūrdhvamūlam adhaḥśākham aśvatthaṃ prāhur avyayam | chandāṃsi yasya parṇāni yas taṃ veda sa vedavit
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ऊर्ध्वमूलम्अधःशाखम्अश्वत्थं प्राहुर्अव्ययम् । छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित् ॥
verses.english: They say that the Aswattha, having its roots above and branches below, is eternal, its leaves are the Chhandas. He who knoweth it, knoweth the Vedas.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: adhaś cordhvaṃ prasṛtās tasya śākhā | guṇapravṛddhā viṣayapravālāḥ | adhaś ca mūlāny anusaṃtatāni | karmānubandhīni manuṣyaloke
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा । गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः । अधश्च मूलान्य्अनुसंततानि । कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके ॥
verses.english: Downwards and upwards are stretched its branches which are enlarged by the qualities; its sprouts are the objects of senses.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na rūpam asyeha tathopalabhyate | nānto na cādir na ca saṃpratiṣṭhā | aśvattham enaṃ suvirūḍhamūlam | asaṅgaśastreṇa dṛḍhena chittvā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न रूपम्अस्येह तथोपलभ्यते । नान्तो न चादिर्न च संप्रतिष्ठा । अश्वत्थम्एनं सुविरूढमूलम् । असङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा ॥
verses.english: Downwards its roots, leading to action, are extended to this world of men. Its form cannot here (below) be thus known, nor (its) end, nor (its) beginning, nor (its) support.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tataḥ padaṃ tatparimārgitavyaṃ | yasmin gatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥ | tam eva cādyaṃ puruṣaṃ prapadye | yataḥ pravṛttiḥ prasṛtā purāṇī
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्यं । यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः । तम्एव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये । यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी ॥
verses.english: Cutting, with the hard weapon of unconcern, this Aswattha of roots firmly fixed, then should one seek for that place repairing whither one returneth not again (thinking)—"I will seek the protection of that Primeval Sire from whom the ancient course of (worldly) life hath flowed."—Those that are free from pride and delusion,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: nirmānamohā jitasaṅgadoṣā | adhyātmanityā vinivṛttakāmāḥ | dvandvair vimuktāḥ sukhaduḥkhasaṃjñair | gacchanty amūḍhāḥ padam avyayaṃ tat
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा । अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः । द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञैर् । गच्छन्त्य्अमूढाः पदम्अव्ययं तत् ॥
verses.english: that have subdued the evil of attachment, that are steady in the contemplation of the relation of the Supreme to the individual self, from whom desire hath departed, freed from the pairs of opposites known by the names of pleasure and pain (and the like), repair, undeluded, to that eternal seat.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na tad bhāsayate sūryo na śaśāṅko na pāvakaḥ | yad gatvā na nivartante tad dhāma paramaṃ mama
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः । यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ॥
verses.english: The sun lighteth not that seat, nor the moon, nor fire. Whither going none returneth, that is my supreme seat.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mamaivāṃśo jīvaloke jīvabhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ | manaḥṣaṣṭhānīndriyāṇi prakṛtisthāni karṣati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः । मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति ॥
verses.english: An eternal portion of Me is that which, becoming an individual soul in the world of life, draweth to itself the (five) senses with the mind as the sixth which all depend on nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śarīraṃ yad avāpnoti yac cāpy utkrāmatīśvaraḥ | gṛhītvaitāni saṃyāti vāyur gandhān ivāśayāt
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: शरीरं यद्अवाप्नोति यच्चाप्य्उत्क्रामतीश्वरः । गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धान्इवाशयात् ॥
verses.english: When the sovereign (of this bodily frame) assumeth or quitteth (a) body, it departeth taking away these, like the wind (taking away) perfumes from their seats.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śrotraṃ cakṣuḥ sparśanaṃ ca rasanaṃ ghrāṇam eva ca | adhiṣṭhāya manaś cāyaṃ viṣayān upasevate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणम्एव च । अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयान्उपसेवते ॥
verses.english: Presiding over the ear, the eye, (the organs of) touch, taste, and smell, and also over the mind, he enjoyeth all objects of senses.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: utkrāmantaṃ sthitaṃ vāpi bhuñjānaṃ vā guṇānvitam | vimūḍhā nānupaśyanti paśyanti jñānacakṣuṣaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम् । विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः ॥
verses.english: They that are deluded do not see (him) when quitting or abiding in (the body), when enjoying or joined to the qualities. They (however) see that have the eye of knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yatanto yoginaś cainaṃ paśyanty ātmany avasthitam | yatanto 'py akṛtātmāno nainaṃ paśyanty acetasaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्य्आत्मन्य्अवस्थितम् । यतन्तो ऽप्य्अकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्य्अचेतसः ॥
verses.english: Devotees exerting (towards that end) behold him dwelling in themselves. They (however) that are senseless and whose minds are not restrained, behold him not, even while exerting (themselves).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yad ādityagataṃ tejo jagad bhāsayate 'khilam | yac candramasi yac cāgnau tat tejo viddhi māmakam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यद्आदित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयते ऽखिलम् । यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम् ॥
verses.english: That splendour dwelling in the sun which illumines the vast universe, that (which is) in the moon, and that (which is) in the fire, know that splendour to be mine.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: gām āviśya ca bhūtāni dhārayāmy aham ojasā | puṣṇāmi cauṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: गाम्आविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्य्अहम्ओजसा । पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः ॥
verses.english: Entering into the earth I uphold creatures by my force; and becoming the juicy moon I nourish all herbs.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ahaṃ vaiśvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṃ deham āśritaḥ | prāṇāpānasamāyuktaḥ pacāmy annaṃ caturvidham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहम्आश्रितः । प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्य्अन्नं चतुर्विधम् ॥
verses.english: Myself becoming the vital heat (Vaiswanara) residing in the bodies of creatures that breathe, (and) uniting with the upward and the downward life-breaths, I digest the four kinds of food.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sarvasya cāhaṃ hṛdi saṃniviṣṭo | mattaḥ smṛtir jñānam apohanaṃ ca | vedaiś ca sarvair aham eva vedyo | vedāntakṛd vedavid eva cāham
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि संनिविष्टो । मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानम्अपोहनं च । वेदैश्च सर्वैर्अहम्एव वेद्यो । वेदान्तकृद्वेदविद्एव चाहम् ॥
verses.english: I am seated in the hearts of all. From Me are memory and knowledge and the loss of both. I am the objects of knowledge to be known by (the aid of) all the Vedas.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: dvāv imau puruṣau loke kṣaraś cākṣara eva ca | kṣaraḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭastho 'kṣara ucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: द्वाव्इमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च । क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थो ऽक्षर उच्यते ॥
verses.english: I am the author of the Vedantas, and I alone am the knower of the Vedas.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: uttamaḥ puruṣas tv anyaḥ paramātmety udāhṛtaḥ | yo lokatrayam āviśya bibharty avyaya īśvaraḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्व्अन्यः परमात्मेत्य्उदाहृतः । यो लोकत्रयम्आविश्य बिभर्त्य्अव्यय ईश्वरः ॥
verses.english: There are these two entities in the world, viz., the mutable and the immutable. The mutable is all (these) creatures. The unchangeable one is called the immutable.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yasmāt kṣaram atīto 'ham akṣarād api cottamaḥ | ato 'smi loke vede ca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यस्मात्क्षरम्अतीतो ऽहम्अक्षराद्अपि चोत्तमः । अतो ऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
verses.english: But there is another, the Supreme Being, called Paramatman, who was the Eternal Lord, pervading the three worlds, sustaineth (them) (and) since I transcend the mutable, and am higher than even the immutable; for this I am celebrated in the world (among men) and in the Veda as Purushottama (the Highest Being).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yo mām evam asaṃmūḍho jānāti puruṣottamam | sa sarvavid bhajati māṃ sarvabhāvena bhārata
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यो माम्एवम्असंमूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम् । स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत ॥
verses.english: He who, without being deluded, knoweth Me as this Highest Being,—he knowing all, O Bharata, worshippeth Me in every way.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: iti guhyatamaṃ śāstram idam uktaṃ mayānagha | etad buddhvā buddhimān syāt kṛtakṛtyaś ca bhārata
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रम्इदम्उक्तं मयानघ । एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत ॥
verses.english: Thus, O sinless one, hath this knowledge, forming the greatest of mysteries, been declared by Me (to thee). Knowing this, O Bharata, one will become gifted with intelligence, and will have done all he needs do.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: abhayaṃ sattvasaṃśuddhir jñānayogavyavasthitiḥ | dānaṃ damaś ca yajñaś ca svādhyāyas tapa ārjavam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानयोगव्यवस्थितिः । दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम् ॥
verses.english: Fearlessness, purity of heart, perseverance in (the pursuit of) knowledge and Yoga meditation, gifts, self-restraint, sacrifice, study of the Vedas,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ahiṃsā satyam akrodhas tyāgaḥ śāntir apaiśunam | dayā bhūteṣv aloluptvaṃ mārdavaṃ hrīr acāpalam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अहिंसा सत्यम्अक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिर्अपैशुनम् । दया भूतेष्व्अलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीर्अचापलम् ॥
verses.english: ascetic penances, uprightness, abstention from injury, truth, freedom from anger, renunciation, tranquillity, freedom from reporting other's faults, compassion for all creatures, absence of covetousness,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tejaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ śaucam adroho nātimānitā | bhavanti saṃpadaṃ daivīm abhijātasya bhārata
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचम्अद्रोहो नातिमानिता । भवन्ति संपदं दैवीम्अभिजातस्य भारत ॥
verses.english: gentleness, modesty, absence of restlessness, vigour, forgiveness, firmness, cleanliness, absence of quarrelsomeness, freedom from vanity,—these become his, O Bharata, who is born to godlike possessions.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: dambho darpo 'timānaś ca krodhaḥ pāruṣyam eva ca | ajñānaṃ cābhijātasya pārtha saṃpadam āsurīm
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: दम्भो दर्पो ऽतिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यम्एव च । अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ संपदम्आसुरीम् ॥
verses.english: Hypocrisy, pride, conceit, wrath, rudeness and ignorance, are, O son of Pritha, his who is born to demoniac possessions.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: daivī saṃpad vimokṣāya nibandhāyāsurī matā | mā śucaḥ saṃpadaṃ daivīm abhijāto 'si pāṇḍava
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: दैवी संपद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता । मा शुचः संपदं दैवीम्अभिजातो ऽसि पाण्डव ॥
verses.english: God-like possessions are deemed to be for deliverance; the demoniac for bondage. Grieve not, O son of Pandu, for thou art born to god-like possessions.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: dvau bhūtasargau loke 'smin daiva āsura eva ca | daivo vistaraśaḥ prokta āsuraṃ pārtha me śṛṇu
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोके ऽस्मिन्दैव आसुर एव च । दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे शृणु ॥
verses.english: (There are) two kinds of created beings in this world, viz., the god-like and the demoniac. The god-like have been described at length. Hear now, from me, O son of Pritha, about the demoniac.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca janā na vidur āsurāḥ | na śaucaṃ nāpi cācāro na satyaṃ teṣu vidyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुर्आसुराः । न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते ॥
verses.english: Persons of demoniac nature know not inclination or disinclination. Neither purity, nor good conduct, nor truth exist in them.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: asatyam apratiṣṭhaṃ te jagad āhur anīśvaram | aparasparasaṃbhūtaṃ kim anyat kāmahaitukam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: असत्यम्अप्रतिष्ठं ते जगद्आहुर्अनीश्वरम् । अपरस्परसंभूतं किम्अन्यत्कामहैतुकम् ॥
verses.english: They say that the universe is void of truth, of guiding principle, (and) of ruler; produced by the union of one another (male and female) from lust, and nothing else.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: etāṃ dṛṣṭim avaṣṭabhya naṣṭātmāno 'lpabuddhayaḥ | prabhavanty ugrakarmāṇaḥ kṣayāya jagato 'hitāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एतां दृष्टिम्अवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानो ऽल्पबुद्धयः । प्रभवन्त्य्उग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतो ऽहिताः ॥
verses.english: Depending on this view, these men of lost selves, little intelligence, and fierce deeds, these enemies (of the world), are born for the destruction of the universe.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kāmam āśritya duṣpūraṃ dambhamānamadānvitāḥ | mohād gṛhītvāsadgrāhān pravartante 'śucivratāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कामम्आश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः । मोहाद्गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्ते ऽशुचिव्रताः ॥
verses.english: Cherishing desires that are insatiable, and endued with hypocrisy, conceit and folly, they adopt false notions through delusion and engage in unholy practices.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: cintām aparimeyāṃ ca pralayāntām upāśritāḥ | kāmopabhogaparamā etāvad iti niścitāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: चिन्ताम्अपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्ताम्उपाश्रिताः । कामोपभोगपरमा एतावद्इति निश्चिताः ॥
verses.english: Cherishing boundless thoughts limited by death (alone), and regarding the enjoyment of (their) desires as the highest end, they are persuaded that that is all.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: āśāpāśaśatair baddhāḥ kāmakrodhaparāyaṇāḥ | īhante kāmabhogārtham anyāyenārthasaṃcayān
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः । ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थम्अन्यायेनार्थसंचयान् ॥
verses.english: Fettered by the hundred nooses of hope, addicted to lust and wrath, they covet to obtain this wealth to-day,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: idam adya mayā labdham idaṃ prāpsye manoratham | idam astīdam api me bhaviṣyati punar dhanam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इदम्अद्य मया लब्धम्इदं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम् । इदम्अस्तीदम्अपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम् ॥
verses.english: This I will obtain later,—This wealth I have,—This (wealth) will be mine in addition,—This foe hath been slain by me,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: asau mayā hataḥ śatrur haniṣye cāparān api | īśvaro 'ham ahaṃ bhogī siddho 'haṃ balavān sukhī
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरान्अपि । ईश्वरो ऽहम्अहं भोगी सिद्धो ऽहं बलवान्सुखी ॥
verses.english: I will slay even others,—I am lord,—I am the enjoyer,—I am successful, powerful, happy,—I am rich and of noble birth,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: āḍhyo 'bhijanavān asmi ko 'nyo 'sti sadṛśo mayā | yakṣye dāsyāmi modiṣya ity ajñānavimohitāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: आढ्यो ऽभिजनवान्अस्मि को ऽन्यो ऽस्ति सदृशो मया । यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्य्अज्ञानविमोहिताः ॥
verses.english: Who else is there that is like me?—I will sacrifice,—I will make gifts,—I will be merry,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: anekacittavibhrāntā mohajālasamāvṛtāḥ | prasaktāḥ kāmabhogeṣu patanti narake 'śucau
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः । प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरके ऽशुचौ ॥
verses.english: thus deluded by ignorance, tossed about by numerous thoughts, enveloped in the meshes of delusion, attached to the enjoyment of objects of desire, they sink into foul hell.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ātmasaṃbhāvitāḥ stabdhā dhanamānamadānvitāḥ | yajante nāmayajñais te dambhenāvidhipūrvakam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: आत्मसंभाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः । यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम् ॥
verses.english: Self-conceited, stubborn, filled with the pride and intoxication of wealth, they perform sacrifices that are nominally so, with hypocrisy and against the (prescribed) ordinance.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ahaṃkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca saṃśritāḥ | mām ātmaparadeheṣu pradviṣanto 'bhyasūyakāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः । माम्आत्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तो ऽभ्यसूयकाः ॥
verses.english: Wedded to vanity, power, pride, lust and wrath, these revilers hate Me in their own bodies and those of others.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tān ahaṃ dviṣataḥ krūrān saṃsāreṣu narādhamān | kṣipāmy ajasram aśubhān āsurīṣv eva yoniṣu
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तान्अहं द्विषतः क्रूरान्संसारेषु नराधमान् । क्षिपाम्य्अजस्रम्अशुभान्आसुरीष्व्एव योनिषु ॥
verses.english: These haters (of Me), cruel, the vilest among men, and unholy, I hurl continually down into demoniac wombs.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: āsurīṃ yonim āpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani | mām aprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yānty adhamāṃ gatim
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: आसुरीं योनिम्आपन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि । माम्अप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्य्अधमां गतिम् ॥
verses.english: Coming into demoniac wombs, deluded birth after birth, they, O son of Kunti, without attaining to Me go down to the vilest state.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: trividhaṃ narakasyedaṃ dvāraṃ nāśanam ātmanaḥ | kāmaḥ krodhas tathā lobhas tasmād etat trayaṃ tyajet
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनम्आत्मनः । कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्माद्एतत्त्रयं त्यजेत् ॥
verses.english: Three-fold is the way to hell, ruinous to the self, viz., lust, wrath, likewise avarice. Therefore, these three, one should renounce.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: etair vimuktaḥ kaunteya tamodvārais tribhir naraḥ | ācaraty ātmanaḥ śreyas tato yāti parāṃ gatim
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः । आचरत्य्आत्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम् ॥
verses.english: Freed from these three gates of darkness, a man, O son of Kunti, works out his own welfare, and then repairs to his highest goal.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yaḥ śāstravidhim utsṛjya vartate kāmakārataḥ | na sa siddhim avāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यः शास्त्रविधिम्उत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः । न स सिद्धिम्अवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम् ॥
verses.english: He who, abandoning the ordinances of the scriptures, acts only under the impulses of desire, never attains to perfection, nor happiness, nor the highest goal.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tasmāc chāstraṃ pramāṇaṃ te kāryākāryavyavasthitau | jñātvā śāstravidhānoktaṃ karma kartum ihārhasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ । ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुम्इहार्हसि ॥
verses.english: Therefore, the scriptures should be thy authority in determining what should be done and what should not be done. It behoveth thee to do work here, having ascertained what hath been declared by the ordinances of the scriptures.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ye śāstravidhim utsṛjya yajante śraddhayānvitāḥ | teṣāṃ niṣṭhā tu kā kṛṣṇa sattvam āho rajas tamaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ये शास्त्रविधिम्उत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः । तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वम्आहो रजस्तमः ॥
verses.english: What is the state, O Krishna, of those who abandoning the ordinance of the scriptures, perform sacrifices endued with faith? It is one of Goodness, or Passion, or Darkness?

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: trividhā bhavati śraddhā dehināṃ sā svabhāvajā | sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti tāṃ śṛṇu
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: त्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा । सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां शृणु ॥
verses.english: The faith of embodied (creatures) is of three kinds. It is (also) born of their (individual) natures. It is good, passionate, and dark. Hear now these.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sattvānurūpā sarvasya śraddhā bhavati bhārata | śraddhāmayo 'yaṃ puruṣo yo yacchraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत । श्रद्धामयो ऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः ॥
verses.english: The faith of one, O Bharata, is conformable to his own nature. A being here is full of faith; and whatever is one's faith, one is even that.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yajante sāttvikā devān yakṣarakṣāṃsi rājasāḥ | pretān bhūtagaṇāṃś cānye yajante tāmasā janāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः । प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः ॥
verses.english: They that are of the quality of goodness worship the gods; they that are of the quality of passion (worship) the Yakshas and the Rakshasas; other people that are of the quality of darkness worship departed spirits and hosts of Bhutas.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: aśāstravihitaṃ ghoraṃ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ | dambhāhaṃkārasaṃyuktāḥ kāmarāgabalānvitāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः । दम्भाहंकारसंयुक्ताः कामरागबलान्विताः ॥
verses.english: Those people who practise severe ascetic austerities not ordained by the scriptures, are given up to hypocrisy and pride, and endued with desire of attachment, and violence,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: karśayantaḥ śarīrasthaṃ bhūtagrāmam acetasaḥ | māṃ caivāntaḥśarīrasthaṃ tān viddhy āsuraniścayān
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कर्शयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्रामम्अचेतसः । मां चैवान्तःशरीरस्थं तान्विद्ध्य्आसुरनिश्चयान् ॥
verses.english: those persons possessed of no discernment, torturing the groups of organs in (their) bodies and Me also seated within (those) bodies,—should be known to be of demoniac resolves.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: āhāras tv api sarvasya trividho bhavati priyaḥ | yajñas tapas tathā dānaṃ teṣāṃ bhedam imaṃ śṛṇu
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: आहारस्त्व्अपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः । यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदम्इमं शृणु ॥
verses.english: Food which is dear to all is of three kinds. Sacrifice, penance, and gifts are likewise (of three kinds). Listen to their distinctions as follows.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: āyuḥsattvabalārogyasukhaprītivivardhanāḥ | rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛdyā āhārāḥ sāttvikapriyāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: आयुःसत्त्वबलारोग्यसुखप्रीतिविवर्धनाः । रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः ॥
verses.english: Those kinds of food that increase life's period, energy, strength, health, well-being, and joy, which are savoury, oleaginous, nutritive, and agreeable, are liked by God.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kaṭvamlalavaṇātyuṣṇatīkṣṇarūkṣavidāhinaḥ | āhārā rājasasyeṣṭā duḥkhaśokāmayapradāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः । आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः ॥
verses.english: Those kinds of food which are bitter, sour, salted, over-hot, pungent, dry, and burning, and which produce pain, grief and disease, are desired by the passionate.
