verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yātayāmaṃ gatarasaṃ pūti paryuṣitaṃ ca yat | ucchiṣṭam api cāmedhyaṃ bhojanaṃ tāmasapriyam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत् । उच्छिष्टम्अपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम् ॥
verses.english: The food which is cold, without savour, stinking and corrupt, and which is even refuse, and filthy, is dear to men of darkness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: aphalākāṅkṣibhir yajño vidhidṛṣṭo ya ijyate | yaṣṭavyam eveti manaḥ samādhāya sa sāttvikaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्यज्ञो विधिदृष्टो य इज्यते । यष्टव्यम्एवेति मनः समाधाय स सात्त्विकः ॥
verses.english: That sacrifice is good which, being prescribed by the ordinance, is performed by persons, without any longing for the fruit (thereof) and the mind being determined (to it under the belief) that its performance is a duty.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: abhisaṃdhāya tu phalaṃ dambhārtham api caiva yat | ijyate bharataśreṣṭha taṃ yajñaṃ viddhi rājasam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थम्अपि चैव यत् । इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम् ॥
verses.english: But that which is performed in expectation of fruit and even for the sake of ostentation, know that sacrifice, O chief of the sons of Bharata, to be of the quality of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: vidhihīnam asṛṣṭānnaṃ mantrahīnam adakṣiṇam | śraddhāvirahitaṃ yajñaṃ tāmasaṃ paricakṣate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: विधिहीनम्असृष्टान्नं मन्त्रहीनम्अदक्षिणम् । श्रद्धाविरहितं यज्ञं तामसं परिचक्षते ॥
verses.english: That sacrifice which is against the ordinance, in which no food is dealt out, which is devoid of mantras (sacred verse), in which no fees are paid to the brahmanas assisting to it, and which is void of faith, is said to be of the quality of darkness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: devadvijaguruprājñapūjanaṃ śaucam ārjavam | brahmacaryam ahiṃsā ca śārīraṃ tapa ucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: देवद्विजगुरुप्राज्ञपूजनं शौचम्आर्जवम् । ब्रह्मचर्यम्अहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते ॥
verses.english: Reverence to the gods, regenerate ones, preceptors, and men of knowledge, purity, uprightness, the practices of a Brahmacharin, and abstention from injury, are said to constitute the penance of the body.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: anudvegakaraṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ priyahitaṃ ca yat | svādhyāyābhyasanaṃ caiva vāṅmayaṃ tapa ucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत् । स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते ॥
verses.english: The speech which causeth no agitation, which is true, which is agreeable and beneficial, and the diligent study of the Vedas, are said to be the penance of speech.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: manaḥprasādaḥ saumyatvaṃ maunam ātmavinigrahaḥ | bhāvasaṃśuddhir ity etat tapo mānasam ucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मनःप्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनम्आत्मविनिग्रहः । भावसंशुद्धिर्इत्य्एतत्तपो मानसम्उच्यते ॥
verses.english: Serenity of the mind, gentleness, taciturnity, self-restraint, and purity of the disposition,—these are said to be the penance of the mind.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śraddhayā parayā taptaṃ tapas tat trividhaṃ naraiḥ | aphalākāṅkṣibhir yuktaiḥ sāttvikaṃ paricakṣate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत्त्रिविधं नरैः । अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्युक्तैः सात्त्विकं परिचक्षते ॥
verses.english: This three-fold penance performed with perfect faith, by men without desire of fruit, and with devotion, is said to be of the quality of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: satkāramānapūjārthaṃ tapo dambhena caiva yat | kriyate tad iha proktaṃ rājasaṃ calam adhruvam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत् । क्रियते तद्इह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलम्अध्रुवम् ॥
verses.english: That penance which is performed for the sake of (gaining) respect, honour, and reverence, with hypocrisy, (and) which is unstable and transient is said to be of the quality of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: mūḍhagrāheṇātmano yat pīḍayā kriyate tapaḥ | parasyotsādanārthaṃ vā tat tāmasam udāhṛtam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः । परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत्तामसम्उदाहृतम् ॥
verses.english: That penance which is performed under a deluded conviction, with torture of one's self, and for the destruction of another, is said to be of the quality of darkness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: dātavyam iti yad dānaṃ dīyate 'nupakāriṇe | deśe kāle ca pātre ca tad dānaṃ sāttvikaṃ smṛtam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: दातव्यम्इति यद्दानं दीयते ऽनुपकारिणे । देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम् ॥
verses.english: That gift which is given because it ought to be given, to one who cannot return any service for it, in a proper time, and to a proper person, is said to be of the quality of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yat tu pratyupakārārthaṃ phalam uddiśya vā punaḥ | dīyate ca parikliṣṭaṃ tad dānaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यत्तु प्रत्युपकारार्थं फलम्उद्दिश्य वा पुनः । दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम् ॥
verses.english: That, however, which is given reluctantly, for return of services (past or expected), or even with an eye to fruit,—that gift is said to be of the quality of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: adeśakāle yad dānam apātrebhyaś ca dīyate | asatkṛtam avajñātaṃ tat tāmasam udāhṛtam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अदेशकाले यद्दानम्अपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते । असत्कृतम्अवज्ञातं तत्तामसम्उदाहृतम् ॥
verses.english: In an unfit place and at an unfit time, the gift that is made to an unworthy object, without respect, and with contempt, is said to be of the quality of darkness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: oṃ tat sad iti nirdeśo brahmaṇas trividhaḥ smṛtaḥ | brāhmaṇās tena vedāś ca yajñāś ca vihitāḥ purā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ॐ तत्सद्इति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः । ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा ॥
verses.english: OM, TAT, SAT, this is said to be the three-fold designation of Brahma. By that (Brahma), the Brahmanas and the Vedas, and the Sacrifices, were ordained of old.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tasmād om ity udāhṛtya yajñadānatapaḥkriyāḥ | pravartante vidhānoktāḥ satataṃ brahmavādinām
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तस्माद्ॐ इत्य्उदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपःक्रियाः । प्रवर्तन्ते विधानोक्ताः सततं ब्रह्मवादिनाम् ॥
verses.english: Therefore, uttering the syllable OM, the sacrifices, gifts, and penances, prescribed by the ordinance, of all utterers of Brahma begin.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tad ity anabhisaṃdhāya phalaṃ yajñatapaḥkriyāḥ | dānakriyāś ca vividhāḥ kriyante mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तद्इत्य्अनभिसंधाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः । दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षिभिः ॥
verses.english: Uttering TAT, the various rites of sacrifice, penance, and gifts, without expectation of fruit, are performed by those that are desirous of deliverance.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sadbhāve sādhubhāve ca sad ity etat prayujyate | praśaste karmaṇi tathā sacchabdaḥ pārtha yujyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सद्भावे साधुभावे च सद्इत्य्एतत्प्रयुज्यते । प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते ॥
verses.english: SAT is employed to denote existence and goodness. Likewise, O son of Pritha, the word SAT is used in any auspicious act.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yajñe tapasi dāne ca sthitiḥ sad iti cocyate | karma caiva tadarthīyaṃ sad ity evābhidhīyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सद्इति चोच्यते । कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सद्इत्य्एवाभिधीयते ॥
verses.english: Constancy in sacrifices, in penances and in gifts, is also called SAT, and an act, too, for the sake of That is called SAT.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: aśraddhayā hutaṃ dattaṃ tapas taptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat | asad ity ucyate pārtha na ca tat pretya no iha
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत् । असद्इत्य्उच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह ॥
verses.english: Whatever oblation is offered (to the fire), whatever is given away, whatever penance is performed, whatever is done, without faith, is, O son of Pritha, said to be the opposite of SAT; and that is nought both here and hereafter.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: saṃnyāsasya mahābāho tattvam icchāmi veditum | tyāgasya ca hṛṣīkeśa pṛthak keśiniṣūdana
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वम्इच्छामि वेदितुम् । त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक्केशिनिषूदन ॥
verses.english: Of renunciation, O thou of mighty arms, I desire to know the true nature, and also of abandonment, O lord of the senses distinctly, O slayer of Kesi.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ nyāsaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ kavayo viduḥ | sarvakarmaphalatyāgaṃ prāhus tyāgaṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः । सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः ॥
verses.english: The rejection of the works with desire is known by the learned as renunciation. The abandonment of the fruit of all work, the discerning call abandonment.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tyājyaṃ doṣavad ity eke karma prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ | yajñadānatapaḥkarma na tyājyam iti cāpare
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: त्याज्यं दोषवद्इत्य्एके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः । यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यम्इति चापरे ॥
verses.english: Some wise men say that work (itself) should be abandoned as evil; others (say) that the works of sacrifice, gifts, and penance, should not be abandoned.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: niścayaṃ śṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharatasattama | tyāgo hi puruṣavyāghra trividhaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: निश्चयं शृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम । त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः संप्रकीर्तितः ॥
verses.english: As to that abandonment, listen to my decision, O best of the sons of Bharata, for abandonment, O tiger among men, hath been declared to be of three kinds.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yajñadānatapaḥkarma na tyājyaṃ kāryam eva tat | yajño dānaṃ tapaś caiva pāvanāni manīṣiṇām
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यम्एव तत् । यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम् ॥
verses.english: The works of sacrifice, gifts, and penance should not be abandoned. They should, indeed, be done. Sacrifice, gift, and penance, are the purifications of the wise.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: etāny api tu karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalāni ca | kartavyānīti me pārtha niścitaṃ matam uttamam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: एतान्य्अपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च । कर्तव्यानीति मे पार्थ निश्चितं मतम्उत्तमम् ॥
verses.english: But even those works should be done, abandoning attachment and fruit. This, O son of Pritha, is my excellent and decided opinion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: niyatasya tu saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇo nopapadyate | mohāt tasya parityāgas tāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नियतस्य तु संन्यासः कर्मणो नोपपद्यते । मोहात्तस्य परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः ॥
verses.english: The renunciation of an act prescribed (in the scriptures) is not proper. Its abandonment (is) from delusion, (and) is (therefore,) declared to be of the quality of darkness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: duḥkham ity eva yat karma kāyakleśabhayāt tyajet | sa kṛtvā rājasaṃ tyāgaṃ naiva tyāgaphalaṃ labhet
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: दुःखम्इत्य्एव यत्कर्म कायक्लेशभयात्त्यजेत् । स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत् ॥
verses.english: (Regarding it) as (a source of) sorrow, when work is abandoned from (fear of) bodily pain, one making such an abandonment which is of the quality of passion never obtaineth the fruit of abandonment.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kāryam ity eva yat karma niyataṃ kriyate 'rjuna | saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalaṃ caiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कार्यम्इत्य्एव यत्कर्म नियतं क्रियते ऽर्जुन । सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः ॥
verses.english: (Regarding it) as one that should be done, when work that is prescribed (in the scriptures) is done, O Arjuna, abandoning attachment and fruit also, that abandonment is deemed to be of the quality of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na dveṣṭy akuśalaṃ karma kuśale nānuṣajjate | tyāgī sattvasamāviṣṭo medhāvī chinnasaṃśayaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न द्वेष्ट्य्अकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते । त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः ॥
verses.english: Possessed of intelligence and with doubts dispelled, an abandoner that is endowed with the quality of goodness hath no aversion for an unpleasant action and no attachment to pleasant (ones).

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na hi dehabhṛtā śakyaṃ tyaktuṃ karmāṇy aśeṣataḥ | yas tu karmaphalatyāgī sa tyāgīty abhidhīyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्य्अशेषतः । यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्य्अभिधीयते ॥
verses.english: Since actions cannot be absolutely abandoned by an embodied person, (therefore) he who abandons the fruit of actions is truly said to be an abandoner.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: aniṣṭam iṣṭaṃ miśraṃ ca trividhaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam | bhavaty atyāgināṃ pretya na tu saṃnyāsināṃ kva cit
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अनिष्टम्इष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम् । भवत्य्अत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्व चित् ॥
verses.english: Evil, good and mixed-action hath (this) three-fold fruit hereafter for those that do not abandon. But there is none whatever for the renouncer.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: pañcaitāni mahābāho kāraṇāni nibodha me | sāṃkhye kṛtānte proktāni siddhaye sarvakarmaṇām
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे । सांख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम् ॥
verses.english: Listen from me, O thou of mighty arms, to those five causes for the completion of all actions, declared in the Sankhya treating of the annihilation of actions.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: adhiṣṭhānaṃ tathā kartā karaṇaṃ ca pṛthagvidham | vividhāś ca pṛthakceṣṭā daivaṃ caivātra pañcamam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम् । विविधाश्च पृथक्चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम् ॥
verses.english: (They are) substratum, agent, the diverse kinds of organs, the diverse efforts severally, and with them the deities as the fifth.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śarīravāṅmanobhir yat karma prārabhate naraḥ | nyāyyaṃ vā viparītaṃ vā pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: शरीरवाङ्मनोभिर्यत्कर्म प्रारभते नरः । न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः ॥
verses.english: With body, speech, or mind, whatever work, just or the reverse, a man undertakes, these five are its causes.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tatraivaṃ sati kartāram ātmānaṃ kevalaṃ tu yaḥ | paśyaty akṛtabuddhitvān na sa paśyati durmatiḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारम्आत्मानं केवलं तु यः । पश्यत्य्अकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः ॥
verses.english: That being so, he that, owing to an unrefined understanding, beholdeth his own self as solely the agent, he, dull in mind, beholdeth not.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yasya nāhaṃkṛto bhāvo buddhir yasya na lipyate | hatvāpi sa imāṁl lokān na hanti na nibadhyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते । हत्वापि स इमाꣳल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते ॥
verses.english: He that hath no feeling of egoism, whose mind is not sullied, he, even killing all these people, killeth not, nor is fettered (by action).—Knowledge,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ parijñātā trividhā karmacodanā | karaṇaṃ karma karteti trividhaḥ karmasaṃgrahaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना । करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः ॥
verses.english: the object of knowledge, and the knower, form the three-fold impulse of action. Instrument, action, and the agent, form the three-fold complement of action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: jñānaṃ karma ca kartā ca tridhaiva guṇabhedataḥ | procyate guṇasaṃkhyāne yathāvac chṛṇu tāny api
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः । प्रोच्यते गुणसंख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्य्अपि ॥
verses.english: Knowledge, action, and agent, are declared in the enumeration of qualities to be three-fold, according to the difference of qualities. Listen to those also duly.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sarvabhūteṣu yenaikaṃ bhāvam avyayam īkṣate | avibhaktaṃ vibhakteṣu taj jñānaṃ viddhi sāttvikam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावम्अव्ययम्ईक्षते । अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम् ॥
verses.english: That by which One Eternal Essence is viewed in all things, undivided in the divided, know that to be knowledge having the quality of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: pṛthaktvena tu yaj jñānaṃ nānābhāvān pṛthagvidhān | vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu taj jñānaṃ viddhi rājasam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान् । वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम् ॥
verses.english: That knowledge which discerneth all things as diverse essences of different kinds in consequence of their separateness, know that that knowledge hath the quality of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yat tu kṛtsnavad ekasmin kārye saktam ahaitukam | atattvārthavad alpaṃ ca tat tāmasam udāhṛtam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यत्तु कृत्स्नवद्एकस्मिन्कार्ये सक्तम्अहैतुकम् । अतत्त्वार्थवद्अल्पं च तत्तामसम्उदाहृतम् ॥
verses.english: But that which is attached to (each) single object as if it were the whole, which is without reason, without truth, and mean, that knowledge hath been said to be of the quality of darkness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: niyataṃ saṅgarahitam arāgadveṣataḥ kṛtam | aphalaprepsunā karma yat tat sāttvikam ucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नियतं सङ्गरहितम्अरागद्वेषतः कृतम् । अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकम्उच्यते ॥
verses.english: The action which is prescribed (by the scriptures), (done) without attachment, performed without desires and aversion, by one who longeth not for (its) fruit, is said to be of the quality of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yat tu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṃkāreṇa vā punaḥ | kriyate bahulāyāsaṃ tad rājasam udāhṛtam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहंकारेण वा पुनः । क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसम्उदाहृतम् ॥
verses.english: But that action which is done by one seeking objects of desire, or by one filled with egoism, and which is attended with great trouble, is said to be of the quality of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: anubandhaṃ kṣayaṃ hiṃsām anapekṣya ca pauruṣam | mohād ārabhyate karma yat tat tāmasam ucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसाम्अनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम् । मोहाद्आरभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसम्उच्यते ॥
verses.english: That action which is undertaken from delusion, without regard to consequences, loss, injury (to others), and (one's own) power also, is said to be of the quality of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: muktasaṅgo 'nahaṃvādī dhṛtyutsāhasamanvitaḥ | siddhyasiddhyor nirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvika ucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मुक्तसङ्गो ऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः । सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते ॥
verses.english: The agent who is free from attachment, who never speaketh of himself, who is endued with constancy and energy, and is unmoved by success and defeat, is said to be of the quality of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: rāgī karmaphalaprepsur lubdho hiṃsātmako 'śuciḥ | harṣaśokānvitaḥ kartā rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मको ऽशुचिः । हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः ॥
verses.english: The agent who is full of affections, who wisheth for the fruit of actions, who is covetous, endued with cruelty, and impure, and who feeleth joy and sorrow, is declared to be of the quality of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ayuktaḥ prākṛtaḥ stabdhaḥ śaṭho naikṛtiko 'lasaḥ | viṣādī dīrghasūtrī ca kartā tāmasa ucyate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैकृतिको ऽलसः । विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते ॥
verses.english: The agent who is void of application, without discernment, obstinate, deceitful, malicious, slothful, desponding, and procrastinating, is said to be of the quality of darkness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: buddher bhedaṃ dhṛteś caiva guṇatas trividhaṃ śṛṇu | procyamānam aśeṣeṇa pṛthaktvena dhanaṃjaya
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं शृणु । प्रोच्यमानम्अशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनंजय ॥
verses.english: Hear now, O Dhananjaya, the three-fold division of intellect and constancy, according to their qualities, which I am about to declare exhaustively and distinctly.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca kāryākārye bhayābhaye | bandhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये । बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी ॥
verses.english: The intellect which knoweth action and inaction, what ought to be done and what ought not to be done, fear and fearlessness, bondage and deliverance, is, O son of Pritha, of the quality of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yayā dharmam adharmaṃ ca kāryaṃ cākāryam eva ca | ayathāvat prajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यया धर्मम्अधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यम्एव च । अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी ॥
verses.english: The intellect by which one imperfectly discerneth right and wrong, that which ought to be done and that which ought not to be done, is, O son of Pritha, of the quality of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: adharmaṃ dharmam iti yā manyate tamasāvṛtā | sarvārthān viparītāṃś ca buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अधर्मं धर्मम्इति या मन्यते तमसावृता । सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी ॥
verses.english: That intellect which, shrouded by darkness, regardeth wrong to be right, and all things as reversed, is, O son of Pritha, of the quality of darkness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: dhṛtyā yayā dhārayate manaḥprāṇendriyakriyāḥ | yogenāvyabhicāriṇyā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः । योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी ॥
verses.english: That unswerving constancy by which one controls the functions of the mind, the life-breaths, and the senses, through devotion, that constancy, is, O son of Pritha, of the quality of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yayā tu dharmakāmārthān dhṛtyā dhārayate 'rjuna | prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣī dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यया तु धर्मकामार्थान्धृत्या धारयते ऽर्जुन । प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी ॥
verses.english: But that constancy, O Arjuna, by which one holds to religion, desire, and profit, through attachment, desiring fruit, that constancy, O son of Pritha, is of the quality of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yayā svapnaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ viṣādaṃ madam eva ca | na vimuñcati durmedhā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदम्एव च । न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी ॥
verses.english: That through which an undiscerning person abandons not sleep, fear, sorrow, despondency, and folly, that constancy is deemed to be of the quality of darkness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sukhaṃ tv idānīṃ trividhaṃ śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha | abhyāsād ramate yatra duḥkhāntaṃ ca nigacchati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सुखं त्व्इदानीं त्रिविधं शृणु मे भरतर्षभ । अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति ॥
verses.english: Hear now from me, O bull of Bharata's race, of the three kinds of happiness. That in which one findeth pleasure from repetition (of enjoyment), which bringeth an end to pain, which is like poison first but resembleth nectar in the end,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yat tadagre viṣam iva pariṇāme 'mṛtopamam | tat sukhaṃ sāttvikaṃ proktam ātmabuddhiprasādajam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यत्तदग्रे विषम्इव परिणामे ऽमृतोपमम् । तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तम्आत्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम् ॥
verses.english: that happiness born of the serenity produced by a knowledge of self, is said to be of the quality of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: viṣayendriyasaṃyogād yat tadagre 'mṛtopamam | pariṇāme viṣam iva tat sukhaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदग्रे ऽमृतोपमम् । परिणामे विषम्इव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम् ॥
verses.english: That which is from the contact of the senses with their objects which resembleth nectar first but is like poison in the end, that happiness is held to be of the quality of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yad agre cānubandhe ca sukhaṃ mohanam ātmanaḥ | nidrālasyapramādotthaṃ tat tāmasam udāhṛtam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यद्अग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनम्आत्मनः । निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसम्उदाहृतम् ॥
verses.english: That happiness which in the beginning and its consequences deludeth the soul, and springeth from sleep, indolence, and stupidity, that is described to be of the quality of darkness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na tad asti pṛthivyāṃ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ | sattvaṃ prakṛtijair muktaṃ yad ebhiḥ syāt tribhir guṇaiḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न तद्अस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः । सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यद्एभिः स्यात्त्रिभिर्गुणैः ॥
verses.english: There is not, either on earth or heaven among the gods, the entity that is free from these three qualities born of nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca paraṃtapa | karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāvaprabhavair guṇaiḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परंतप । कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः ॥
verses.english: The duties of Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, and Vaisyas, and of Sudras also, O chastiser of foes, are distinguished by (these three) qualities born of nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śamo damas tapaḥ śaucaṃ kṣāntir ārjavam eva ca | jñānaṃ vijñānam āstikyaṃ brahmakarma svabhāvajam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिर्आर्जवम्एव च । ज्ञानं विज्ञानम्आस्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम् ॥
verses.english: Tranquillity, self-restraint, ascetic austerities, purity, forgiveness, rectitude, knowledge, experience, and belief (in an existence hereafter),—these are the duties of Brahmanas, born of (their proper) nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śauryaṃ tejo dhṛtir dākṣyaṃ yuddhe cāpy apalāyanam | dānam īśvarabhāvaś ca kṣātraṃ karma svabhāvajam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्य्अपलायनम् । दानम्ईश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम् ॥
verses.english: Bravery, energy, firmness, skill, not flying away from battle, liberality, the bearing of a ruler,—these are the duties of Kshatriyas, born of (their proper) nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kṛṣigorakṣyavāṇijyaṃ vaiśyakarma svabhāvajam | paricaryātmakaṃ karma śūdrasyāpi svabhāvajam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कृषिगोरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम् । परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम् ॥
verses.english: Agriculture, tending of cattle, and trade, are the natural duties of Vaisyas. Of Sudras also, the natural duty consists in servitude.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sve sve karmaṇy abhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate naraḥ | svakarmanirataḥ siddhiṃ yathā vindati tac chṛṇu
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: स्वे स्वे कर्मण्य्अभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः । स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु ॥
verses.english: Every man, engaged in his own duties, attains to perfection. Hear now how one obtains perfection by application to his duties.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yataḥ pravṛttir bhūtānāṃ yena sarvam idaṃ tatam | svakarmaṇā tam abhyarcya siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वम्इदं ततम् । स्वकर्मणा तम्अभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः ॥
verses.english: Him from whom are the movements of all beings, Him by whom all this is pervaded, worshipping him by (the performance of) one's own duty, one obtaineth perfection.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śreyān svadharmo viguṇaḥ paradharmāt svanuṣṭhitāt | svabhāvaniyataṃ karma kurvan nāpnoti kilbiṣam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् । स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् ॥
verses.english: Better is one's own duty though performed faultily than another's duty well-performed. Performing the duty prescribed by (one's own) nature, one incurreth no sin.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sahajaṃ karma kaunteya sadoṣam api na tyajet | sarvārambhā hi doṣeṇa dhūmenāgnir ivāvṛtāḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषम्अपि न त्यजेत् । सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निर्इवावृताः ॥
verses.english: One must not abandon, O son of Kunti, one's natural duty though tainted with evil, for all actions are enveloped by evil like fire by smoke.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: asaktabuddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigataspṛhaḥ | naiṣkarmyasiddhiṃ paramāṃ saṃnyāsenādhigacchati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः । नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति ॥
verses.english: He whose mind is unattached everywhere, who hath subdued his self, and whose desire hath departed, obtaineth, through renunciation, the supreme perfection of freedom from work.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: siddhiṃ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me | samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे । समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा ॥
verses.english: Learn from me, only in brief, O son of Kunti, how one, having obtained (this kind of) perfection, attaineth to Brahma which is the supreme end of knowledge.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: buddhyā viśuddhayā yukto dhṛtyātmānaṃ niyamya ca | śabdādīn viṣayāṃs tyaktvā rāgadveṣau vyudasya ca
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: बुद्ध्या विशुद्धया युक्तो धृत्यात्मानं नियम्य च । शब्दादीन्विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च ॥
verses.english: Endued with a pure mind, and restraining his self by constancy, renouncing sound and other objects of sense, and casting off affection and aversion, he who resideth in a lonely place,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: viviktasevī laghvāśī yatavākkāyamānasaḥ | dhyānayogaparo nityaṃ vairāgyaṃ samupāśritaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः । ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः ॥
verses.english: eateth little, and restraineth speech, body, and mind, who is ever intent on meditation and abstraction, who hath recourse to indifference, who, abandoning egoism,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ahaṃkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham | vimucya nirmamaḥ śānto brahmabhūyāya kalpate
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम् । विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥
verses.english: violence, pride, lust, wrath, and (all) surroundings, hath been freed from selfishness and is tranquil (in mind), becometh fit for assimilation with Brahma.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati | samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu madbhaktiṃ labhate parām
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति । समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम् ॥
verses.english: Becoming one with Brahma, tranquil in spirit, (such a) one grieveth not, desireth not; alike to all beings, he obtaineth the highest devotion to Me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: bhaktyā mām abhijānāti yāvān yaś cāsmi tattvataḥ | tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: भक्त्या माम्अभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः । ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम् ॥
verses.english: By (that) devotion he truly understandeth Me. What I am, and who I am; then understanding Me truly, he entereth into Me forthwith.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sarvakarmāṇy api sadā kurvāṇo madvyapāśrayaḥ | matprasādād avāpnoti śāśvataṃ padam avyayam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वकर्माण्य्अपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः । मत्प्रसादाद्अवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदम्अव्ययम् ॥
verses.english: Even performing all actions at all times having refuge in Me, he obtaineth, through my favour, the seat that is eternal and imperishable.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: cetasā sarvakarmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparaḥ | buddhiyogam upāśritya maccittaḥ satataṃ bhava
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः । बुद्धियोगम्उपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव ॥
verses.english: Dedicating in thy heart all actions to Me, being devoted to Me, resorting to mental abstraction, fix thy thoughts constantly on Me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: maccittaḥ sarvadurgāṇi matprasādāt tariṣyasi | atha cet tvam ahaṃkārān na śroṣyasi vinaṅkṣyasi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि । अथ चेत्त्वम्अहंकारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि ॥
verses.english: Fixing thy thoughts on Me, thou wilt surmount all difficulties through my grace. But if from self-conceit thou wilt not listen, thou wilt (then) utterly perish.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: yad ahaṃkāram āśritya na yotsya iti manyase | mithyaiṣa vyavasāyas te prakṛtis tvāṃ niyokṣyati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यद्अहंकारम्आश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे । मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति ॥
verses.english: If, having recourse to self-conceit, thou thinkest—I will not fight,—that resolution of thine would be vain, (for) Nature will constrain thee.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: svabhāvajena kaunteya nibaddhaḥ svena karmaṇā | kartuṃ necchasi yan mohāt kariṣyasy avaśo 'pi tat
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा । कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्य्अवशो ऽपि तत् ॥
verses.english: That which, from delusion, thou dost not wish to do, thou wilt do involuntarily, bound by thy own duty springing from (thy own) nature.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hṛddeśe 'rjuna tiṣṭhati | bhrāmayan sarvabhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशे ऽर्जुन तिष्ठति । भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया ॥
verses.english: The Lord, O Arjuna, dwelleth in the region of the heart of beings, turning all beings as if mounted on a machine, by his illusive power.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: tam eva śaraṇaṃ gaccha sarvabhāvena bhārata | tatprasādāt parāṃ śāntiṃ sthānaṃ prāpsyasi śāśvatam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तम्एव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत । तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम् ॥
verses.english: Seek shelter with Him in every way, O Bharata. Through his grace thou wilt obtain supreme tranquillity, the eternal seat.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: iti te jñānam ākhyātaṃ guhyād guhyataraṃ mayā | vimṛśyaitad aśeṣeṇa yathecchasi tathā kuru
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इति ते ज्ञानम्आख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया । विमृश्यैतद्अशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु ॥
verses.english: Thus hath been declared to thee by Me the knowledge that is more mysterious than any (other) matter. Reflecting on it fully, act as thou likest.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ | iṣṭo 'si me dṛḍham iti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः शृणु मे परमं वचः । इष्टो ऽसि मे दृढम्इति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम् ॥
verses.english: Once more, listen to my supernal words, the most mysterious of all. Exceedingly dear art thou to Me, therefore, I will declare what is for thy benefit.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru | mām evaiṣyasi satyaṃ te pratijāne priyo 'si me
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु । माम्एवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियो ऽसि मे ॥
verses.english: Set thy heart on Me, become My devotee, sacrifice to Me, bow down to Me. Then shalt thou come to Me. I declare to thee truly, (for) thou art dear to Me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: sarvadharmān parityajya mām ekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja | ahaṃ tvā sarvapāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य माम्एकं शरणं व्रज । अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः ॥
verses.english: Forsaking all (religious) duties, come to Me as thy sole refuge. I will deliver thee from all sins. Do not grieve.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: idaṃ te nātapaskāya nābhaktāya kadā cana | na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo 'bhyasūyati
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदा चन । न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां यो ऽभ्यसूयति ॥
verses.english: This is not to be ever declared by thee to one who practiseth no austerities, to one who is not a devotee, to one who never waiteth on a preceptor, nor yet to one who calumniateth Me.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: ya idaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ madbhakteṣv abhidhāsyati | bhaktiṃ mayi parāṃ kṛtvā mām evaiṣyaty asaṃśayaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: य इदं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्व्अभिधास्यति । भक्तिं मयि परां कृत्वा माम्एवैष्यत्य्असंशयः ॥
verses.english: He who shall inculcate this supreme mystery to those that are devoted to Me, offering Me the highest devotion, will come to Me, freed from (all his) doubts.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: na ca tasmān manuṣyeṣu kaś cin me priyakṛttamaḥ | bhavitā na ca me tasmād anyaḥ priyataro bhuvi
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः । भविता न च मे तस्माद्अन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि ॥
verses.english: Amongst men there is none who can do Me a dearer service than he, nor shall any other on earth be dearer to Me than he.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: adhyeṣyate ca ya imaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃvādam āvayoḥ | jñānayajñena tenāham iṣṭaḥ syām iti me matiḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादम्आवयोः । ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहम्इष्टः स्याम्इति मे मतिः ॥
verses.english: And he who will study this holy converse between us, by him will have been offered to Me the sacrifice of knowledge. Such is my opinion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: śraddhāvān anasūyaś ca śṛṇuyād api yo naraḥ | so 'pi muktaḥ śubhāṁl lokān prāpnuyāt puṇyakarmaṇām
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: श्रद्धावान्अनसूयश्च शृणुयाद्अपि यो नरः । सो ऽपि मुक्तः शुभाꣳल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम् ॥
verses.english: Even the man who, with faith and without cavil, will hear it (read), even he freed (from re-birth), will obtain of the blessed regions of those that perform pious acts.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.sanskrit_iast: kac cid etac chrutaṃ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa cetasā | kac cid ajñānasaṃmohaḥ pranaṣṭas te dhanaṃjaya
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: कच्चिद्एतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा । कच्चिद्अज्ञानसंमोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनंजय ॥
verses.english: Hath this, O son of Pritha, been heard by thee with mind undirected to any other objects? Hath thy delusion, (caused) by ignorance, been destroyed, O Dhananjaya?

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit_iast: naṣṭo mohaḥ smṛtir labdhā tvatprasādān mayācyuta | sthito 'smi gatasaṃdehaḥ kariṣye vacanaṃ tava
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत । स्थितो ऽस्मि गतसंदेहः करिष्ये वचनं तव ॥
verses.english: My delusion hath been destroyed, and the recollection (of what I am) hath been gained by me, O Undeteriorating one, through thy favour. I am now firm. My doubts have been dispelled. I will do thy bidding.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit_iast: ity ahaṃ vāsudevasya pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ | saṃvādam imam aśrauṣam adbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: इत्य्अहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः । संवादम्इमम्अश्रौषम्अद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम् ॥
verses.english: Thus I heard this converse between Vasudeva and the high-souled son of Pritha, (that is) wonderful and causeth the hair to stand on end.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit_iast: vyāsaprasādāc chrutavān etad guhyam ahaṃ param | yogaṃ yogeśvarāt kṛṣṇāt sākṣāt kathayataḥ svayam
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवान्एतद्गुह्यम्अहं परम् । योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम् ॥
verses.english: Through Vyasa's favour heard I this supreme mystery, this (doctrine of) Yoga, from Krishna himself, the Lord of Yoga, who declared it in person.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit_iast: rājan saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya saṃvādam imam adbhutam | keśavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṃ hṛṣyāmi ca muhur muhuḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादम्इमम्अद्भुतम् । केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
verses.english: O King recollecting and (again) recollecting this wonderful (and) holy converse of Kesava and Arjuna, I rejoice over and over again.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit_iast: tac ca saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya rūpam atyadbhutaṃ hareḥ | vismayo me mahān rājan hṛṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपम्अत्यद्भुतं हरेः । विस्मयो मे महान्राजन्हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः ॥
verses.english: Recollecting again and again that wonderful form also of Hari, great is my amazement, O king, and I rejoice ever more.

verses.speaker: Sanjaya
verses.sanskrit_iast: yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ | tatra śrīr vijayo bhūtir dhruvā nītir matir mama
verses.sanskrit_devanagari: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः । तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम ॥
verses.english: Thither where Krishna, the Lord of Yoga (is), thither where the great bowman (Partha) is, thither, in my opinion, are prosperity, and victory, and greatness, and eternal justice
